jobs.title: AI Content Producer — Multi-Brand
jobs.description:
Location:
Remote

Schedule:
Full-time, aligned with Eastern Time business hours

Compensation:
C$28,800–C$36,000 annually, based on experience, portfolio quality and technical capabilities

Turn Limited Material Into Great Content

Langford Staffing is hiring an AI Content Producer to create publish-ready content across a portfolio of technology and service businesses.

You’ll work on brands in property management, leasing, real estate brokerage, home maintenance, property technology, staffing and related industries.

These companies will not always have professional footage or someone available to appear on camera. You’ll turn ideas, articles, photographs, screen recordings, property images and raw phone footage into polished videos and other engaging content.

This is a hands-on production role. We need someone who can create finished work—not someone who only writes prompts or produces unedited AI output.

How To Apply

Apply with your résumé and an accessible portfolio link.

Your portfolio should include three to five strong examples of AI-assisted content. Briefly explain what you personally created and which tools you used.

If your background and portfolio align with the role, you’ll receive an email within 24–48 hours of applying with a link to complete a short pre-recorded interview.

Please allow one to two weeks after completing the interview for us to review all applications. Selected candidates will then be invited to a live video interview.

What You’ll Create

Short-form and long-form videos.
AI-generated footage, images, presenters and voiceovers.
Product videos using screenshots and screen recordings.
Videos created from property photographs and raw field footage.
Content series developed from articles and other long-form material.
Carousels, graphics, thumbnails and supporting visual content.
Platform-specific versions for Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, LinkedIn and X.

What You’ll Do

Turn approved ideas and briefs into finished content.
Develop hooks, scripts and simple storyboards.
Generate and edit AI video, images, avatars and voiceovers.
Add captions, music, motion, graphics and brand elements.
Repurpose source material into multiple content formats.
Create content that supports inquiries, bookings, listings and platform use.
Maintain a different voice and visual style for every brand.
Improve raw or limited source materials using AI and professional editing.
Check AI output for visual mistakes, inaccurate details and unnatural results.
Build reusable templates, prompts and production workflows.
Organize project files and maintain a clear content library.
Complete revisions and meet production deadlines.
Test new AI tools and recommend better production methods.

What We’re Looking For

At least two years of experience in content creation, video production, digital media or a related creative role.
A strong portfolio of AI-assisted videos and visual content.
Hands-on experience with tools such as HeyGen, Higgsfield, Runway, Kling, Midjourney, Adobe Firefly, ElevenLabs or comparable platforms.
Strong editing skills using CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve or comparable software.
A good understanding of hooks, pacing, storytelling and calls to action.
The ability to turn limited source material into engaging finished content.
The ability to create for several brands without making their content look or sound the same.
Strong visual judgment and attention to detail.
Excellent written and spoken English.
Strong organization and the ability to work independently.
Reliable availability during Eastern Time business hours.

Experience creating content for technology, property management, real estate, home services or other service businesses is an advantage.

Who Will Succeed

The right person is creative, fast and highly practical.

You understand that AI can increase production speed, but strong content still requires judgment, storytelling and quality control. You can follow an approved direction, contribute better ideas and turn incomplete source material into content people will actually want to watch.

You are comfortable working across multiple brands, accepting feedback, meeting production expectations and improving your work based on results.

Remote-Work Requirements

You must have:

A computer capable of running modern AI and editing tools.
At least 16 GB of RAM.
Two monitors.
Reliable internet of at least 100 Mbps.
Backup internet connectivity or power.
A noise-cancelling headset.
A professional webcam.
A quiet and professional workspace.

jobs.title: Sr. Creative Strategist – Paid Social (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
About HOLY

HOLY is the soft drink revolution: With our product lines Energy®, Iced Tea®, Hydration®, Milkshake®, and our newest innovation, the HOLY Syrup Bottle®, you get amazing taste across 50+ flavors while maintaining a good conscience—for your body & the environment.
Over 2M loyal customers: Started in a shared apartment by three best friends, we have scaled to Europe's fastest-growing consumer brand—and our cult-like community, the HOLY Squad, loves it: 4.6 stars on reviews.io speak for themselves.
From D2C to Global Omnichannel: In less than four years, we've profitably scaled HOLY to more than €200M D2C revenue in DACH, FR, UK, and PL. Now scaling our retail business, we're on an exciting transition to becoming a true omnichannel rocketship.
We are still just getting started: Backed by the world's best consumer investors, we aim to revolutionize the soft drink industry and build a generational love brand: tastier, healthier & more sustainable. Our team of 200+ people aims high (Coca-Cola, we're coming for you!).

About The Position

Paid social is one of HOLY’s most important growth channels, helping us reach new audiences and build the most loved soft drink brand.

We’re looking for a Sr. Creative Strategist – Paid Social
to own the creative strategy behind our evergreen testing engine and campaign calendar across HOLY’s four markets.

Sitting at the intersection of brand and paid social, you’ll turn customer insights, performance learnings, and platform trends into unmistakably HOLY concepts, briefs, and creative tests that unlock new audiences and help scale HOLY’s paid social engine beyond €3m in monthly spend. You will report to Bella, our Head of Brand, and work closely with our Paid Social team.

Responsibilities:

Own global paid social creative strategy: Own the creative strategy across HOLY’s evergreen testing engine and campaign calendar across all four core markets, primarily on Meta. Set a global creative direction that can be adapted locally, with particular focus on DACH as HOLY’s core market, while building an approach that can scale as the business expands.
Deliver high-quality briefs at scale: Produce a consistent baseline of at least 10 execution-ready creative briefs per week once fully ramped, aligned with the Paid Social testing roadmap and the Creative Studio’s production capacity. Prioritize quality, clarity, and learning value, ensuring each brief can move efficiently from hypothesis to production and testing.
Turn insights into a creative testing roadmap: Translate customer insights, performance learnings, market and competitor research, and platform trends into clear creative hypotheses, benefit-led concepts, hooks, and visual ideas. Decide what to test, why, and when, balancing new concepts with iterations of winning ideas and setting priorities across formats, channels, and markets in collaboration with the Paid Social team.
Write clear creative briefs: Establish what a high-quality paid social brief looks like and ensure the executional team has the strategic context needed to produce strong work. Briefs should clearly define the funnel stage, category or product focus, messaging angle, target audience, core hypothesis, market relevance, execution ideas, and supporting references.
Lead creative brainstorming and debriefs: Own the monthly creative brainstorming and debrief sessions with channel/market owners, media buyers, and the Creative Studio. Turn collective ideas and performance learnings into clear creative priorities and strong briefs for the next testing cycle.
Enable creative excellence through strategic briefing: Give designers, copywriters, content creators, and video editors the context they need to produce work that is unmistakably HOLY and built for paid social. Stay close to the work throughout production to clarify the brief and check strategic alignment, while leaving discipline-specific craft decisions to the relevant team leads.
Partner with the Paid Social team: Work closely with Media Buyers and the wider Paid Social team to understand creative performance, channel strategy, scale requirements, and budget priorities. Use these inputs to identify new creative opportunities, improve underperforming concepts, and inform future iterations.

About You

Conceptual and creative thinking: Strong ability to develop distinctive, commercially relevant concepts and identify what makes an idea, hook, script, or execution genuinely strong.
Performance mindset: Understands the paid social funnel and how creative contributes at each stage. Comfortable working with hard metrics such as spend, CAC, and CVR, as well as creative signals such as hook rate and watch time, using these inputs to develop stronger concepts, hooks, angles and visual ideas.
Copywriting and scripting: Strong direct-response copywriting background, with the ability to write and improve hooks, headlines, scripts, calls to action, and messaging frameworks. Comfortable working hands-on with copywriters and the wider executional team to strengthen concepts and improve conversion.
Make insights usable: Able to distill complex customer psychology, market context, competitor activity, and performance learnings into clear, accessible inputs for the wider creative team. Builds practical insight libraries, frameworks, or other lightweight systems that make learnings easy to understand, reuse, and apply in future concept development.
Creative direction and feedback: Communicates a clear creative point of view in briefs and assesses final outputs against them, giving focused feedback on strategic alignment, concept strength, and performance potential while leaving craft decisions to the relevant team leads.
Global and local mindset: Proven experience developing paid social creative for the DACH market, combined with a global mindset suited to building scalable evergreen creative systems. Able to develop concepts with cross-market potential and know when to involve local teams to adapt language, formats, cultural references, or insights. Experience across France, the UK, or Poland is a strong plus.
Ownership and collaboration: Proactive, structured, and comfortable leading brainstorming and debrief sessions, aligning different cross-functional stakeholders, making decisions, and moving from insight to execution in a fast-moving environment.
Communication: Fluent in English; German is a plus.

Our Offering

In today's job market, A-players have many options to choose from. As part of our offer, we prioritize providing a productive working environment and opportunities for growth. In addition to competitive compensation, including company shares, you can expect:

A successful and growing company: Join a company that has been growing profitably and quickly for the last 36+ months and has raised a Series B, while many other e-commerce companies are struggling.
Huge impact: Enjoy huge impact to shape HOLY's internationalization in a top market.
Awesome team: Join an awesome team of colleagues who are ambitious, funny, down-to-earth, and authentic. Get to know us and see for yourself!
Top product: Marketing is important, but a good product is essential. Our differentiated soft drinks have won over customers. Check out our reviews.io reviews or contact us for free samples.
Startup culture: Join a startup culture that values flat hierarchies, fast pace, and personal development. With us, you can make a real impact.
Perfect setup: Enjoy a perfect setup that includes all the requirements of a modern employer, such as a central office in Berlin Prenzlauer Berg, flexible working hours, and much more.
Competitive comp. + equity: Join us at a pivotal stage of hypergrowth. We offer a strong salary and meaningful equity — giving you the chance to share in our current success and benefit from the massive upside as we scale.
How we support your growth: flexible hours, 28 vacation days, 30 work-from-abroad days, €1,500 learning budget, Urban Sports Club membership, public transport subsidy, and biannual 360° feedback tied to your compensation.

Find out more about HOLY and our team on our careers page.

The Process

As we are experiencing rapid growth and have ambitious plans, the optimal start date for the position is today. Nonetheless, we are prepared to patiently await the arrival of the ideal candidate, recognizing that quality ultimately yields the best results.

Getting to know you: We will have a 30-minute screening interview where we will talk to you more about HOLY and the position to see if our expectations match.
Hiring Manager interview with Bella: We will dive a bit deeper into your experience and details of the role.
Case study & on-site interview: As soon as you have successfully completed the first interviews, you will receive a case study. In a second meeting at our office, the team will discuss your case study with you and answer questions about our workspace, the HOLY Temple.
Reference calls: At this stage, we’d like to connect with 1–2 former colleagues or managers who have worked closely with you. These conversations help us better understand your working style and strengths from those who know you professionally.
Interview with Matze: As a strong cultural fit is important to us, you will have a final meeting with Matze, one of our HOLY Founders. This gives both you and us the opportunity for a final check.
Job offer and decision: If everything goes well, you will receive an offer, and we are ready to embark on this journey together with you!

Typically, this process should take around 2-3 weeks.

Any questions or concerns?

If you have any questions or feedback, please send an email to jobs@holy.com.

jobs.description:
Role Purpose:

The Marketing Campaign Lead
is responsible for translating du Pay's commercial and product strategies into integrated, measurable customer campaigns that drive activation, engagement, retention and cross-sell. The role owns end-to-end campaign planning and execution across performance, paid and owned media, CRM, affiliates, influencers, SEO, content and offline channels, including agency coordination, marketing-budget allocation and campaign-performance optimisation. Working closely with Commercial, Product, Marketing Strategy, Analytics and other internal teams, the role uses customer segmentation, campaign data, experimentation and performance insights to continuously improve conversion from onboarding to active usage, retain customers and increase adoption of multiple du Pay products

Onboarding → activation | Retention | Cross-sell

Key Accountabilities for the Role

Campaign Planning and Go-to-Market Execution

Own the end-to-end campaign calendar and launch plans, translating agreed commercial, product and marketing strategies into executable campaigns.
Define campaign objectives, target audiences, messaging requirements, channel mix, budgets, timelines and success measures.
Coordinate campaign and launch readiness across Commercial, Product, Analytics, Technology, Operations, Legal and Compliance.
Manage multiple product and customer campaigns simultaneously, prioritising activity against agreed commercial objectives.

Integrated Multi-Channel Campaign Execution

Execute acquisition, activation, engagement, retention and cross-sell campaigns across paid and owned digital media, in-app placements, push notifications, email, SMS and landing pages.
Coordinate ATL and BTL activities, including outdoor, broadcast, retail and field activations, where relevant.
Manage performance marketing activities across relevant paid digital channels and coordinate affiliate, influencer, SEO and content-led activation.
Adapt campaigns to relevant customer segments, languages, communication preferences and channels.

Customer Activation, Retention and Cross-Sell

Develop and execute campaigns that improve conversion from customer onboarding to active usage.
Design engagement and retention campaigns that increase active customer participation and reduce preventable churn.
Drive cross-sell and upsell campaigns that encourage customers to adopt additional du Pay products and services.
Use approved customer segments, behavioural data and campaign insights to define audiences, targeting and personalisation.
Develop lifecycle campaigns that move customers from onboarding through activation, repeat usage, multi-product adoption and retention.

Campaign Performance, Experimentation and Optimization

Define campaign KPIs and measurement requirements prior to launch.
Track performance across conversion, activation, engagement, retention, cross-sell and relevant commercial measures.
Apply campaign attribution, funnel analysis and A/B testing to evaluate audience, channel, offer, messaging and creative performance.
Test campaign variations and optimise live campaigns based on performance data.
Conduct structured post-campaign reviews and apply learning to future campaigns and launches.
Share campaign and customer-response insights with Marketing Strategy, Product and Commercial teams to support future proposition and product decisions.

Marketing Budget and Commercial Performance

Manage an annual marketing and campaign budgets in millions, including campaign planning, allocation, forecasting and spend tracking.
Allocate investment across performance marketing, paid media, affiliates, influencers, content, ATL, BTL and other campaign channels based on agreed commercial priorities.
Monitor budget utilisation, campaign effectiveness and return on marketing investment, recommending reallocation of spend based on performance.
Track campaign results against agreed KPIs, with particular focus on onboarding-to-activation conversion, customer retention and cross-sell.
Use campaign attribution, funnel analysis and performance data to identify underperforming activity and optimise investment.
Partner with Commercial, Analytics and Finance on campaign performance reporting, budget governance and commercial outcome.

Creative, Agency and Content Delivery

Lead campaign briefs for external agencies in coordination with du Group Marketing and Communications.
Translate agreed audience, proposition, positioning and messaging into actionable creative, media and content briefs.
Review campaign concepts, customer communications and creative executions against campaign objectives and audience requirements.
Manage agency deliverables, production schedules, campaign assets and deadlines.
Ensure campaign communications are adapted appropriately for customer segments, languages, communication preferences and channels.

Governance, Brand and Cross-Functional Delivery

Coordinate with du Group Marketing and Communications to ensure campaigns align with brand standards, communication requirements and relevant du channels.
Partner with Product, Commercial, Analytics, Technology and Operations to deliver campaigns against agreed priorities.
Work with Legal, Compliance and relevant control functions to validate campaign offers, claims, terms, conditions and disclosures before release.
Maintain campaign governance, approvals and delivery milestones from campaign brief through launch and post-campaign review.

Must have required Qualifications

Minimum bachelor’s degree (psychology is preferred) or any other business marketing and communication.
MBA is preferred.

Must have required Experience

Proven experience of at least 5 years in growth marketing, customer segmentation, and retention, preferably in the fintech, e-commerce, or other consumer digital business, or mobile wallet industry.

Must have Skills

A track record of leading multi-channel product launches spanning paid digital, CRM or in-app marketing, and offline activations.

Able to manage multiple launches and coordinate effectively across commercial, product, creative, and compliance teams.

jobs.title: Micro-Drama Director (Creative Director) | 100% Remote
jobs.location: Armenia, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Bulgaria, Croatia, Cyprus, Czechia, Estonia, Georgia, Greece, Italy, Kosovo, Latvia, Malaysia, Malta, Moldova, Montenegro, Netherlands, North Macedonia, Poland, Portugal, Romania, Serbia, Slovakia, Slovenia, South Africa, Spain, Turkey, United Kingdom
jobs.description:
Please be informed that Foxelli Group hires exclusively in-house and doesn't work with any external recruitment agencies. Any company or individual claiming to recruit on behalf of Foxelli Group is not affiliated with us.

At Foxelli, we’re building more than e-commerce brands - we’re building a tribe of thoughtful humans: AI enthusiasts, curious builders, and ambitious minds who care about doing meaningful work together. Ten years in, our D2C brands reach millions and generate over $20M annually. Our focus stays simple: create products customers love and a team that actually enjoys building them.

If you love to learn, experiment, think boldly, make decisions, and build things that matter -you’ll feel at home with us.

THE ROLE

We're building an AI-powered entertainment studio producing addictive vertical micro-drama series for US audiences, primarily women aged 35–55.

We're looking for a creative director with exceptional storytelling instincts, strong cinematic taste, and a deep understanding of human emotions.

Your mission is simple: turn good scripts into emotionally powerful episodes that people can't stop watching.

You'll work with screenwriters, AI video creators, and editors, taking creative ownership from script review to the final finished episode.

You won't need to write the scripts or generate every video yourself. Your role is to guide the creative execution, identify what needs improvement, and ensure every episode meets our standards.

No AI experience? No problem. We’re looking for exceptional storytellers and filmmakers, not AI experts. If you’re a talented screenwriter or director, we’ll teach you everything you need to know about AI filmmaking technologies.

We believe AI is opening up incredible new opportunities for creative professionals, allowing them to bring their ideas to life faster and with fewer traditional production limitations. You’ll have the opportunity to learn cutting-edge tools, develop valuable new skills, and become part of the next generation of filmmaking.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

1. Script Review & Creative Direction

  • Review season storylines and individual episode screenplays.

  • Evaluate storytelling, emotional impact, character motivations, hooks, and cliffhangers.

  • Approve scripts or provide specific, actionable feedback to screenwriters.

  • Add directing instructions only when necessary. If the script is already strong and production-ready, approve it without unnecessary changes.

2. Direct AI Video Production

  • Establish the visual style and creative standards for each series.

  • Guide AI video creators on cinematography, framing, character performance, lighting, and emotional delivery.

  • Review generated footage and identify scenes or shots that need improvement.

  • Maintain visual consistency and quality across episodes.

3. Editing & Final Approval

  • Review episode edits for pacing, tension, emotional impact, music, sound design, and visual storytelling.

  • Give clear, prioritized feedback to editors.

  • Approve final episodes before release.

  • Ensure the finished video delivers the intended emotional experience.

4. Production Quality & Efficiency

  • Work with multiple AI video creators and editors.

  • Help the team increase production speed without sacrificing creative quality.

  • Identify recurring production problems and improve workflows.

  • Use audience feedback and retention data to improve future episodes.

About Black Forest Labs

We’re the team building the foundational layer for visual intelligence: multimodal models trained jointly on images, video, audio, and action to see, generate, and understand the world.

Our founding team pioneered latent diffusion and Stable Diffusion, the breakthroughs that made generative AI accessible to millions. With FLUX, we're pushing into generative media at scale, machines that act in the physical world, and emerging applications in computer use.

Our FLUX models top public benchmarks and run in production in some of the world's biggest platforms. We're a small, fast growing research lab competing with the largest companies in the world. From our labs in Freiburg to San Francisco, we're building what comes next.

Why This Role

Our models need someone who knows them inside out — not just what they can do today, but what nobody has tried yet. You'll create the work that makes people realize what's possible with generative media: original pieces, experiments, and creative assets that set the standard for what FLUX can do, and show it to the world.

What You'll Work On

Build end-to-end production workflows that push FLUX to its limits — experiments, visual explorations, and pieces tailored to brand, agency, and entertainment use cases that show what's possible before anyone else figures it out.
Test and explore models, endpoints, and features that are still in development — you're the one figuring out what they can actually do, and turning that into new insights for image, video generation and more
Create and maintain a library of demo boards, templates, and pipelines that make the product's value obvious in live pitches. Partner with Sales and FDEs on discovery and demo prep, and document what works so it scales across the team.
Support customer enablement - help define what's feasible for custom projects, fine-tuning, and creative workflows.
Work with DevRel, Product, Marketing and Growth to turn experiments into shareable, reproducible examples and insights.

What We're Looking For

3+ years in creative technology, digital art, or experimental media.
You use generative AI for image and video every day, deeply and practically — enough to know intuitively where it breaks down and where it delivers.
A portfolio that demonstrates strong taste, solid craft, and versatility across mediums and tools.
Background in brand, agency, or film/VFX work — you understand the real process behind shipping professional creative.
You move easily through the FLUX ecosystem and the tools around it, from ComfyUI to AI Toolkit and beyond.
Deep understanding of generative AI, agents, and diffusion models.
Working knowledge of Python for scripting and rapid prototyping.

Nice to Have

Active presence in the creative AI community (X, Discord, YouTube) — you're already someone people follow for generative AI work.
Experience creating content that got real traction in the AI/creative space.
Experience supporting Sales or GTM teams with creative assets and technical feasibility assessments.

How We Work Together

We’re a distributed team with real offices that people actually use. You’ll be based in Freiburg or SF and work from the office at least 2 days a week.

Everything we do is grounded in four values:

Obsessed. We are a frontier research lab. The science has to be right, the understanding deep, the product beautiful.
Low Ego. The work speaks. The best idea wins, no matter who said it. Credit is shared. Nobody is above any task.
Bold. We take the ambitious bet. We ship, we do not wait for conditions to be perfect.
Kind. People over politics. We treat each other with genuine warmth. Agency without empathy creates chaos.

If this sounds like work you’d enjoy, we’d love to hear from you.

jobs.description:
Creative Strategist – D2C

Dubai, UAE · Full-time, on site

Reports to:
Head of E-commerce

About the company

Our client is a leading home and kitchen brand headquartered in Dubai, with a fast-growing direct-to-consumer business and international expansion planned for 2027. Their own D2C channel is already a meaningful part of the business, and the aim is to multiply it. Creative is the single biggest lever they have. It's a lean team, so if you own something, you genuinely own it.

Why this role exists

The ceiling on their D2C growth is the ads. Too much of the current creative is AI-generated and looks it, there isn't enough of it, and nobody owns it. They want ads built on real insight about real people, made properly, and in enough volume to keep testing and keep winning. You won't inherit a creative engine. You'll build it.
What this job is, and what it isn't

You own the idea: what we say, to whom, and why it will make them stop and buy.
You direct, you don't edit. You'll brief and manage the creators and editors who make the work.
You build the bench of creators, editors and freelancers.
You don't buy media. The agency runs the buying; you own what they run.
You don't make brand films. This is direct response. Every ad has one job: to sell.

What you'll do

Understand the customer:
know the products inside out, and mine reviews, returns, customer service tickets and competitor reviews for real objections and moments of delight. Build and maintain a hook library.
Build the creative engine:
write clear briefs (hook, angle, objection, proof, format), then source, cast and direct UGC creators. Manage production end to end, ship a steady stream of genuinely new concepts, and grow the active ad library to 200+.
Test and iterate:
run structured tests with a stated hypothesis, and read hook rate, hold rate, CTR and conversion by creative. Kill what isn't working fast, scale what is, and work with the agency on ROAS.
On-site conversion:
make sure landing pages deliver on what the ad promises, and run simple CRO tests on product and landing pages.

Requirements

3+ years owning performance ad creative for a D2C/DTC brand or an agency serving them.
A portfolio of ads you personally conceived and briefed, and you can explain the insight, the hypothesis and the results.
Hands-on experience briefing and directing UGC creators.
Fluency in creative data: hook rate, hold rate, CTR, CVR and cost per result.
Strong writing: hooks, scripts and ad copy.
A track record of shipping volume, meaning dozens of concepts a quarter.
A strong bias for action.

Nice to have

Experience with home, kitchen, food or other everyday products.
Confidence using AI tools to speed up production, while knowing their limits.
Arabic, or experience creating for the region.
Experience using the Meta and TikTok ad libraries for research.
Enough design and motion literacy to art-direct.

This role isn't for you if:

Your ads have been mostly AI-made with light human direction.
You've run social content rather than direct-response ads.
You need a creative director above you to set the angle.
You brief an agency and leave them to it.

Role Summary

We are looking for an experienced and visionary Creative Director

jobs.title: Creative Strategist (M/W/D)
jobs.description:
Deine Mission
Wir organisieren echte Abenteuer-Touren abseits vom Massentourismus — für Menschen, die keinen Bock auf Pauschalreisen und Touristenmassen haben, sondern Gleichgesinnte, neue Erfahrungen und Orte suchen, an die sonst kaum jemand geht.

Wir suchen einen Creative Strategist, der den Kern unseres In-House-Performance-Marketings bildet und unsere Creative Factory verantwortet.
Diese Creative Factory beginnt beim strategischen Ansatz: Welche Zielgruppe sprechen wir an? Welcher Angle ist relevant? Welche Hook erzeugt Aufmerksamkeit? Welche Botschaft baut Vertrauen auf? Und wie übersetzen wir das in Creatives, die auf Meta, Google und im E-Mail-Marketing funktionieren?
Du arbeitest direkt mit den Gründern zusammen, bist aber in der operativen Umsetzung der verantwortliche Owner. Du entwickelst Angles, Hooks, Botschaften und Briefings und steuerst anschließend die Umsetzung mit Video-Editoren, Grafikern, Freelancern oder Agenturen, damit daraus performante Creatives für unsere Kanäle entstehen.

DEINE AUFGABEN
Creative Strategy (weiter)entwickeln: Aus Zielgruppe, Angebot, Markt, Teilnehmerfeedback und Performance-Daten klare Creative-Hypothesen ableiten.
Angles, Hooks und Botschaften konzipieren: Du verstehst was von Awareness Stages und bist in der Lage das Messaging logisch anhand von iterativen Testing-Routen aufzubauen.
Creatives briefen: Klare Briefings und Skripte für Reels, UGC-Ads, Founder-Ads, Testimonials, Statics, Motion Designs und Landingpage-Elemente schreiben.
Wöchentliche Creative-Produktion steuern: Mit Video-Editoren, Grafikern, Creators, Freelancern oder Agenturen zusammenarbeiten und sicherstellen, dass aus Ideen testbare Meta-Creatives werden.
Creative Testing & Learnings verantworten: Tests strukturieren, Ergebnisse auswerten, Muster erkennen und daraus neue Iterationen, Varianten und Creative-Angles ableiten.

Das solltest du mitbringen:
Mind. 3 Jahre Erfahrung mit eigenverantwortlicher Erstellung Performance Creatives für Meta aber gerne auch Google: Du hast schon den Erstellung von Creatives am Fließband angeleitet.
Sicheres Verständnis von Performance-KPIs: Du kannst Kennzahlen wie CTR, CPA, CAC, ROAS, Conversion Rate und Creative Fatigue lesen und daraus sinnvolle Creative-Learnings ableiten.
Starkes Gespür für Hooks und Angles: Du kannst verstehst unsere Brand und die Bedürfnisse unserer Teilnehmer.
Erfahrung im Briefing und in der Creative-Produktion: Du kannst Video-Editoren, Grafikern, Creators, Freelancern oder Agenturen klare Briefings geben und Ideen in testbare Creatives übersetzen.

Was wir dir bieten
Mission: Du arbeitest an einem ganz klaren Ziel: Menschen zu Abenteurern zu machen!
Abenteuer! Wir haben ein paar Kriterien dafür, aber die Chancen stehen gut, dass du dich bald in der Wüste oder an einem anderen Ort in der Welt wiederfinden wirst!
Unser Büro mit Wohnzimmer-Atmosphäre liegt direkt am Brüsseler Platz im Herzen von Köln.
Homeoffice: Arbeiten vom Homeoffice ist natürlich möglich, wobei wir dich lieber im Büro haben.
Perfomance: Wir sind ein kleines Startup mit flachen Hierarchien, hochmotivierten Kollegen, die wirklich etwas bewegen wollen.
Dein Impact: Du wirst den Erfolg deiner Arbeit sehen, weil du nicht nur ein kleines Rädchen im Großen System bist.
Verpflegung: Wir versorgen dich mit Kaffee und kalten Getränken, Obst etc im Büro.

design and digital across four businesses within a privately owned, PE/VC-style investment portfolio.

In the early 1900s, Sergei Diaghilev transformed ballet by bringing together extraordinary artists across disciplines. He paired Stravinsky with Picasso, Coco Chanel with choreographers, composers with painters. He wasn’t the person on stage, but he created the conditions that made extraordinary work possible. Every production demanded creative ambition, difficult tradeoffs, relentless coordination, and uncompromising standards. 

Great creative production feels a lot like that.

Mercury is building a financial company that people genuinely love to use. We’re combining thoughtful design, technology, and AI to make financial workflows simpler, more powerful, and more human. Our Brand Creative team exists to bring that ambition to life through everything we make.

We’re looking for our first Executive Producer to establish Creative Production as a core capability within Brand Creative. You’ll lead production across our most ambitious campaigns and projects while building the systems and external network that allow exceptional creative work to happen again and again.

You see production as a creative discipline. You know how to protect bold ideas, challenge underdeveloped briefs, make difficult tradeoffs, and bring clarity to complexity. This is a senior, hands-on role for someone who wants to build the function while still personally producing our biggest creative bets.

In this role, you’ll:

  • Own production across Brand Creative campaigns and projects, balancing priorities, capacity, staffing, budgets, timelines, and risk across multiple concurrent initiatives.
  • Personally lead our most ambitious campaigns and selected projects from concept through delivery across film, photography, motion, experiential, digital, and integrated work.
  • Partner with creative leaders to turn ambitious ideas into production plans that hold up against timing, budget, and reality, challenging underdeveloped briefs and protecting the creative idea through execution.
  • Build and lead an exceptional network of agencies, directors, studios, photographers, freelancers, and production partners that expands our capacity without lowering the bar.
  • Establish how Brand Creative prioritizes, staffs, greenlights, reviews, and delivers projects, creating a production system that makes exceptional work more repeatable.
  • Bring clarity to complex projects by keeping creative leaders and cross-functional partners grounded in the real state of the work, decisions, constraints, tradeoffs, and risks.
  • Work directly with Brand Creative leadership to continually raise the quality of the work and build one of the strongest in-house creative teams in the industry.

What you’ll bring:

  • Significant experience leading complex, multidisciplinary creative production, with a track record of independently owning large-scale campaigns and multiple concurrent creative projects.
  • Deep production experience across film, photography, motion, experiential, digital, and integrated brand work, with the judgment to choose the right production model for the idea.

Lead complex photography, film, video, and hybrid productions, bringing together agencies, directors, photographers, studios, and specialist production partners.

Translate complex business and creative requirements into clear production plans, ensuring alignment across teams and disciplines.

Job Title

Integrated Producer

Job Description

Bring great ideas to life. Create content that travels the world.

As an Integrated Producer
, you'll help bring our Personal Health portfolio to life through exciting photo, video, and digital productions that reach millions of consumers around the world.

You'll join our Global Production Excellence team
, a seasoned group of creative production experts working across photography, film, video, 3D, animation, and emerging technologies like Generative AI.

From ambitious live-action shoots to innovative digital production workflows, you'll help deliver high-quality content for global product launches and marketing campaigns, creating assets and toolkits that are used across markets, platforms, and consumer touchpoints worldwide.

This is an opportunity for a hands-on, curious, and resourceful producer who loves the creative process, enjoys making things happen, and wants to grow their expertise in an environment where creativity, technology, and production excellence come together.

What You'll Do

Bring creative productions to life

Manage end-to-end production projects, from initial brief and planning through shoots, postproduction, and final delivery.
Coordinate photography, video, and hybrid productions, working with talented directors, photographers, agencies, studios, and postproduction partners.
Help create compelling global content for new product launches, marketing campaigns, e-commerce, and always-on communications.
Ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to the highest creative and technical standards.

Connect creativity with technology

Work across physical and digital production disciplines, including photography, film, 3D, animation, product visualization, and AI-assisted workflows.
Explore new production technologies, automation, and smarter ways to create content at scale.
Help develop modular content and production approaches that allow creative assets to be adapted and reused across channels and markets.
Contribute to the evolution of our global content production capabilities, making production faster, smarter, and more efficient.

Make complex projects run smoothly

Translate creative ambitions into clear, actionable production plans.
Coordinate stakeholders across Marketing, Product Development, Creative, Regulatory, Legal, and external production partners.
Manage production schedules, resources, budgets, and supplier deliverables, keeping projects moving and stakeholders aligned.
Anticipate challenges, identify risks, and find practical solutions that keep productions on track.
Evaluate supplier proposals and production budgets, working with Procurement to deliver the best value without compromising quality.

Champion quality and creative excellence

Ensure every production delivers content that meets Philips brand guidelines, creative expectations, and technical specifications.
Safeguard consumer and product safety, regulatory requirements, and production standards, both on set and throughout the production process.
Make sure final assets are properly approved, organized, and ready for global distribution.
Help improve production workflows, tools, and ways of working, sharing ideas and learnings with the wider team.

You bring

Experience & Background

5+ years of relevant working experience in physical / live-action content production, ideally within a production company, creative agency, studio, or multinational organization.
A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Film, Photography, Digital Media, Media Technology, Marketing, Communications, or a related field—or equivalent practical experience.
Hands-on knowledge of photography and video production, from pre-production planning and shoot execution to postproduction and delivery.
Experience coordinating suppliers, production budgets, schedules, and multiple stakeholders.
An understanding of digital content production and an interest in emerging technologies such as 3D, automation, and Generative AI.
You are currently living in The Netherlands

What Makes You Stand Out

You're a maker at heart. You love seeing creative ideas become real, and understand what it takes to deliver great work.
You're organized without being rigid. You can manage moving parts, shifting priorities, and complex timelines while keeping the bigger picture in focus.
You're a natural collaborator. You enjoy working with creative talent, business stakeholders, and technical specialists, bringing people together to achieve a common goal.
You're commercially minded. You understand that great production is about finding the right balance between creative ambition, quality, time, and investment.
You're curious about what's next. New technologies, production techniques, and smarter workflows excite you, and you're eager to learn and experiment.
You take ownership. You're proactive, solutions-oriented, and comfortable making things happen in a fast-moving environment.

Why join Philips?

Create work with global impact.

Contribute to campaigns and product launches for brands that reach millions of consumers, with content distributed across markets and channels worldwide.

Learn From Experienced Production Experts.

Join a highly skilled and collaborative global team with deep expertise across creative production, technology, and content operations.

Work at the intersection of creativity and innovation.

Be part of an evolving production environment where traditional filmmaking and photography meet 3D, automation, and Generative AI.

Grow your career and your craft.

Build your experience across disciplines, production models, and international projects, with opportunities to expand your responsibilities and develop new capabilities.

Help shape the future of content production.

Contribute to a global transformation in how creative content is developed, produced, and delivered—making it more impactful, efficient, and scalable.

At Philips, you'll do more than manage productions. You'll help turn ideas into experiences that connect our innovations with people around the world.

Compensation & Benefits

Doing meaningful work should come with fair, transparent rewards. The base salary range for this role is € 61,185 – € 101,976. We determine pay within the range using objective factors, like the skills the role requires, your relevant experience and the responsibility you'll have in this role, alongside internal equity and local market considerations.

This role is eligible for 3% annual bonus with your rewards linked to KPIs and the company’s performance. We’ll share the full approach with you during the interview process, so you can make a clear, informed decision. Benefits include generous paid leave, paid parental leave, employer pension contributions, health and wellbeing programs and discounts on Philips products. Discuss in more detail with your recruiter.

How We Work Together

This is an office based role and, this means working in-person at least 3 days per week.

About Philips

Are you ready to do the work of your life to help the lives of others? Learn more about our business, discover our rich and exciting history and learn more about our purpose.

If you’re interested in this role and have many, but not all, of the experiences needed, we encourage you to apply. You may still be the right candidate for this or other opportunities at Philips. Learn more about our culture of impact with care.

jobs.title: Senior Creative Strategist - Paid Social (w/m/d)
jobs.description:
Was Du Bei Uns Machen Wirst

Wie bringt man Menschen dazu, sich freiwillig mit ihrer Steuererklärung zu beschäftigen?

Genau das ist deine Aufgabe.

Als Senior Creative Strategist bei Zasta bringst du Menschen, die beim Wort „Steuererklärung“ sofort weiterscrollen, dazu, anzuhalten, die App zu laden und loszulegen. Wie? Mit Ads auf TikTok und Instagram, die mutig, lustig und auch mal provokant sind.

Das Beste daran:
Wir bauen gerade unsere Inhouse Agency auf und du gestaltest sie von Grund auf mit – von Prozessen über Formate bis zur Arbeitsweise.

Du bekommst viel kreativen Freiraum, entwickelst neue Creative Angles, testest, was wirklich funktioniert, und bringst große Ideen auch mal ins TV.

Du arbeitest bereits eigenständig in der Creative Strategy und bist bereit für den nächsten Schritt auf Senior-Level? Dann bist du bei uns genauso richtig wie jemand, der den Senior-Titel bereits trägt.

Deine Aufgaben

Paid Social ist dein Zuhause: Rund 80 % deiner Zeit drehen sich um Ads auf TikTok und Instagram. Du entwickelst laufend neue Ideen, Hooks und Formate und bringst sie schnell live.
Zielgruppe verstehen: Du weißt, was unsere Zielgruppe scrollt, teilt und kommentiert. Du erkennst Trends früh und machst daraus Creatives, die sich nicht wie Werbung anfühlen.
Ideen in Serie: Du machst auch langweilige Themen interessant. Steuer sind nicht unbedingt ein Scroll-Stopper. Deine Ads schon!"
Daten, Tests, Learnings: Du schaust täglich, was performt. Du testest Varianten gegeneinander und lässt jedes Learning direkt ins nächste Konzept fließen.
Eng im Team: Du bist die Brücke zwischen Performance Marketing, Data und Agenturen, also zwischen „Was sagen die Daten?“ und „Was machen wir jetzt Geiles daraus?“.
Produktion: Du begleitest dein kleines Creative Team bei der Produktion deiner Konzepte von Anfang bis Ende mit, bist bei Drehs dabei und führst Regie. Mit deinem Feedback zu den fertigen Assets stellst du sicher, dass Konzept, Tonalität und Umsetzung stimmen.
Und manchmal: TV. Auch das Fernsehen ist für uns ein wichtiger Kanal. Du entwickelst kreative Konzepte, mit denen wir neue Zielgruppen erschließen und unsere bestehenden Zielgruppen weiter ausbauen.

Was Du Idealerweise Mitbringst

Creative Strategy: Du hast fundierte Erfahrung in Creative Strategy, Concepting oder Kampagnenentwicklung – idealerweise im digitalen Performance-Umfeld.
Paid Social: Du kennst TikTok und Instagram, hast bereits erfolgreiche Paid-Social-Creatives entwickelt und kannst uns deine Arbeit anhand eines Portfolios zeigen.
Performance-Verständnis: Du kennst den Meta und TikTok Ads Manager und weißt, wie du Daten, Insights und Zielgruppenpsychologie in kreative Ideen übersetzt, die Leads bringen.
Social-First-Mindset: Du bist immer auf dem neuesten Stand der Social-Trends, denkst in Umsetzung statt in Slides und probierst lieber heute drei Ideen aus, als nächsten Monat eine perfekte zu präsentieren.
Sprache: Du sprichst Deutsch auf mindestens C1-Niveau und bist sicher im Umgang mit englischen Marketing-Begriffen.

Nice to have:
Du bringst bereits Erfahrung mit TV-Kampagnen mit. Das ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss.

Was Wir Dir Bieten

Gesundes Wachstum & Stabilität: Wir sind profitabel und wachsen nachhaltig aus eigener Stärke – für langfristige Perspektiven und ambitionierte Ziele.
Nah dran statt weit weg: Bei uns arbeiten Teams und Management eng zusammen – mit kurzen Wegen, direktem Austausch und Zusammenarbeit auf Augenhöhe.
Mit Büros in Rostock und Berlin kannst du frische Seeluft schnuppern oder dich vom Großstadtdschungel mitreißen lassen. Regelmäßige Besuche und Team-Events sorgen für das Gemeinschaftsgefühl.
Flexibles hybrides Arbeiten: Wir treffen uns an zwei Tagen pro Woche im Büro – dienstags und mittwochs in Rostock, mittwochs und donnerstags in Berlin. Die übrigen Tage gestaltest du flexibel. Für Ausnahmen an Präsenztagen gibt es unsere Jokertage.
Ein Gehalt, das deiner Erfahrung gerecht wird. Wir bieten dir ein attraktives Gehalt, das zu deiner Erfahrung und der Verantwortung der Rolle passt.
30 Tage Urlaub: Damit neben ambitionierten Zielen auch genügend Zeit zum Abschalten bleibt.
Workation in Europa: Du möchtest zwischendurch den Arbeitsplatz wechseln? Bei Zasta kannst du bis zu vier Wochen am Stück innerhalb der EU arbeiten.

Du bist dir nicht sicher, ob du alle Anforderungen für diese Stelle erfüllst? Wir freuen uns trotzdem über deine Bewerbung. Vielleicht bringst du etwas Besonderes in das Team ein, das wir bisher nicht in Betracht gezogen haben.

Dein Kontakt Bei Zasta

Wenn du Fragen zur Stelle hast, kannst du uns jederzeit über jobs@zasta.de schreiben. Bewerbungen können wir nur online über die Plattform akzeptieren und werden auf anderem Wege nicht beachtet
. Wir freuen uns, von dir zu lesen!

Über uns

Zasta wurde 2017 gegründet und ist die führende Steuer-App in den deutschen App-Stores. Unsere Software ermöglicht es jedem Steuerzahler ohne großen Aufwand eine professionelle Steuererklärung einzureichen. Unsere Plattform arbeitet mit echten Steuerberatern zusammen, um sicherzustellen, dass jeder das beste Ergebnis erhält - auch ohne Steuerwissen. Über 2 Millionen Nutzer vertrauen bereits in unsere App. Komm auch du mit auf unsere Reise, ein nerviges Finanzthema in einen freudigen Geldregen zu verwandeln.

jobs.title: Senior Creative (Hybrid) - Design Studios
jobs.description:
What You'll Do

You are a creative coder, an inventor, and a technical artist. You are the person who hears an ambitious idea and immediately starts thinking about how to build it. As a Senior Creative (Hybrid) at BCG Design Studios, you sit at the heart of the creative team, working with directors, designers, and strategists to apply technology in ways that change what the work can be. Code is your primary craft.

You build the prototypes, experiences, and tools that bring our most imaginative concepts to life. You move fluidly from fast, AI-assisted “vibe-coding” for quick conceptual sketches to production-ready frameworks like React and Next.js when structure matters. You are driven by creative curiosity, thrive on collaboration, and are tuned into what is happening at the edges of technology, brand, and culture.

You contribute to the studio’s creative and technical exploration. You proactively explore, test, and develop working knowledge of emerging technologies, from generative AI and creative coding frameworks to AR/VR and physical computing, and share what you discover with the team around you. You are developing a sharp instinct for where technology makes the work better and where it gets in the way. That instinct is what makes you genuinely useful, not just technically capable.

You also work alongside clients and BCG case teams, supported by senior team members. You translate technical possibilities into ideas people get excited about. You contribute to workshops, help shape narratives, and support organisations in understanding not just what AI can do but how to make it work inside their actual creative process.

Day To Day, You Will

Build and manage end-to-end creative pipelines, not single artefacts, using prompt chains, agentic workflows, and node-based systems to generate high-fidelity, on-brand creative at scale. You know the difference between a tool and a pipeline and you build the latter
Design AI-enabled systems where the output improves with every run. That means defining evaluation criteria, building quality gates, and creating feedback loops between what gets made and what actually works
Audit and redesign creative workflows end-to-end, finding the places where a well-built system saves hours of manual work without sacrificing craft
Translate creative and strategic briefs into working prototypes, whether that is a real-time 3D visualisation, a prompt-driven generative tool for designers, an interactive brand experience, or something that did not exist as a category until you built it
Bring new capabilities into the studio before anyone asks for them. You evaluate models, APIs, and platforms, form a view on what matters, and build the proof of concept that makes the case
Support live project teams on technically complex client work, developing bespoke digital solutions and AI-powered tools in direct response to what the brief demands
Contribute to building capability across the studio. You participate in workshops, share discoveries, and help designers, producers, and consultants understand what is possible and how to use it well
Communicate complex ideas clearly and with enthusiasm, to creative directors, to clients, to a room full of people who have never touched a model. You make the technical feel accessible without making it feel smaller

You're Good At

Turning a vague brief into a working prototype before the meeting is over
Writing inventive code across the full range, from a fast vibe-coded sketch in Cursor or Claude Code to a production-grade React or Next.js application, and knowing which mode the moment calls for
Working with current frontier-model tooling across text, image, video, and audio, Claude, GPT, Gemini, Flux, Veo, Runway, ComfyUI, v0, and connecting them into systems rather than reaching for them one at a time
Building agentic workflows where models, APIs, and tools are stitched together into something that reasons, evaluates, and iterates. You are at home in node-based systems and you can explain why the architecture is clever
Knowing when to prompt-engineer, when to fine-tune, and when to build a deterministic step. You understand the trade-offs and you make the call
Moving between creative and technical contexts without losing the thread of either. You think like a maker in both rooms
Explaining what is technically possible in a way that gets non-technical people genuinely interested, not just nodding along
Balancing experimentation with delivery, knowing when to push and when to ship

What You'll Bring

A degree in Computer Science, Creative Technology, Engineering, Media Arts, or a related field
4 to 6 years working in creative technology, digital innovation, or a hybrid role, ideally in an agency, innovation lab, or media and technology environment
Fluency in Python, JavaScript, or similar, with a track record of building things from idea to working execution
Real, working experience with generative AI tools and platforms, such as Runway, Flux, ComfyUI, or similar, applied in a creative context

Job Purpose

This position sits in our Marketing & Technology service, working with our UK teams from Hungary. We combine data, technology, creative and paid media to crack brands’ business problems & drive revenue through a variety of digital marketing solutions like social, influencer, TTL ad campaigns, augmented reality, AI and innovation. We are looking for an AI Designer & Creative Technologist to join our creative team. The role has two halves: delivering AI-led creative work on live client projects, and building the tools and workflows that make the wider agency faster at it. The client work is varied, from fast-turnaround BAU creative responses to in-person creative sprints and full campaign productions across global markets, and generative AI now runs through most of it.

On the delivery side, you will take briefs from early thinking through to finished, client-ready work using generative image, video and audio tools alongside the Adobe suite, working with designers, motion designers, art directors and producers to make AI output on brand, consistent, and following legal specifications. On the technology side, you will spot the repetitive, manual parts of how our designers work and build things that remove them: automation pipelines, scripts, plugins and small internal tools.

This is a hands-on role and we are open to all levels of experience: what matters is the quality of your work and your judgement about when and how to use these tools. The scope of the role, from how much you lead to how much you guide others, will be shaped around the experience you bring. You will work day to day with creative directors, account teams and clients in the UK, mostly remotely, and contribute to creative sprints and workshops, in person where possible.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

Keep brand and character consistency across generated assets using references, style guides and custom models
Produce rapid concepts, styleframes and visual explorations to help teams pitch and iterate faster

Work with producers to scope AI-led deliverables accurately, flagging where AI isn’t the right route

Present work internally and externally to an excellent standard
Stay close to new tools and models, testing them against real briefs and recommending what we adopt

WHAT YOU BRING:

A portfolio of AI-generated or AI-enhanced work finished to a professional standard, for brands, agencies or personal projects
Solid design fundamentals: composition, typography, colour and an eye for what looks right on screen
Hands-on experience building work in node-based AI workflows (e.g. Figma Weave, ComfyUI, Flora) that chain models like Flux, Veo, Kling and Sora with editing steps, and the judgement to pick the right model and route for the job
Strong Photoshop skills, with working After Effects and/or Premiere Pro to take output through to finish

Understanding of how social, paid and digital assets are specced and delivered (formats, safe zones, aspect ratios, versioning)

Fluent English, with confidence explaining your process and presenting to creative directors, account teams and clients

Curious, experimental and self-directed when a tool or workflow doesn’t exist yet

The opportunity for possibility. We want to enable you to do what you do best and help you develop your skills further with training, development and certifications.
Global annual DEPT® Cares Month in which employees come together and donate their skills to support local charities.

jobs.title: Creative Lead
jobs.description:
Ambition has no passport.
That belief is why LemFi exists. We're the financial engine for people the world wasn't built to serve, the millions who move countries to build something better and find the financial system hasn't caught up with them yet. We started with remittances: the money people send home to the people they love. Now we run multi-currency accounts, Savings, eSIMs and Credit. Because staying connected to home and building somewhere new are not two separate things. They never were.

About The Role

LemFi moves money home for people who live between countries. Behind every transfer there is a real story: school fees, a wedding, a mother's new roof. We have the mission, the communities and the brand platform. What we need now is someone who can find those stories, write them, and make them look unmissable.

You will report to the VP of Brand and Design, and sit at the centre of a lean creative team. You will concept campaigns alongside Isabel, write the words, set the visual direction, and lead the activations that make LemFi feel like it genuinely belongs to the communities it serves. This is not a brief-taking role. You will bring 10 ideas, kill 8, sharpen 2, and then make the 2 real.

What you'll build and own

Find the stories: dig into our customers, corridors and cultures, and turn real lives into campaign ideas that land across markets
Write the work: manifestos, scripts, headlines, social, OOH and launch narratives, copy that is sharp enough to stand alone
Set the visual direction: art-direct campaigns, shoots and brand films so the idea is as strong visually as it is in words
Lead activations: concept and run real-world moments, events, partnerships and cultural drops across our markets, from idea to on-the-ground execution
Brief and direct: brief designers, directors, agencies and creators, push the work until it earns its place
Build the brand platform: grow the creative system so it scales consistently across channels and corridors, using AI tools to move through concept rounds faster
Measure what lands: track reach, engagement and brand lift, iterate fast and feed what you learn back into the work

Your experience

4 or more years at a top creative agency as a copywriter, art director or creative, you know what world-class craft actually takes
2 or more years building or relaunching a brand at a startup or scale-up, shipping with small teams and tight budgets
Portfolio that shows at least 1 strong agency campaign and 1 brand you built or rebuilt in-house, with your specific role on each made clear
Copy and art direction: one is your home craft, the other is genuinely strong, not borrowed from someone else on the brief
Activations shipped: you have taken ideas off the screen into events, partnerships or cultural moments that actually reached people
Real-people storytelling: you have made work from human truths, documentary, testimonials, community voices
Cultural fluency: you understand the communities LemFi serves across its corridors, or you are obsessive about learning them

Nice to have

Fintech, remittance or regulated-category experience, including financial promotions
Rebrand experience end to end: strategy, identity and launch
Directing or writing shoots and brand films, or long-form editorial work

Why join LemFi?

Your work here puts money back into families' pockets. That's the reward, and the weight of it. You'll take on some of the hardest problems in finance alongside people who do their best work when the stakes are real. We move fast and we expect a lot, because our customers can't afford for us to do otherwise. In return you get room to own real problems, global impact you can see, and a team that won't slow you down.

Bring grit and ownership and there's a place for them here. Ambition belongs here, come and show us yours.

Follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram and if you haven't already, download the app on the App Store or Google Play.

Don't feel that you're right for this role, but want to submit your interest in working for LemFi? You can join our talent community to stay in touch for future opportunities.

Recruitment agencies notice

LemFi does not accept unsolicited CVs from recruitment agencies. We work only with agencies on our preferred supplier list, and only when we’ve asked them for their support. Any CVs sent to us outside this arrangement will not incur a fee.

AI in hiring at LemFi

We use AI to cut admin, like notetakers that let interviewers focus on the conversation instead of typing. AI never makes hiring decisions. That responsibility always sits with our hiring teams. Read our AI use policy to see how we use AI and how we expect you to use it too.

**Proposed Role Title: Brand Strategy & Content Lead**

**Role Overview**

Subko is seeking a concept-forward **Brand Strategist + Storyteller** to build and safeguard our brand presence in the UAE (Alserkal Avenue, Dubai). This role bridges big-picture conceptual thinking with high-craft written narrative and agile content execution.

This role requires you to be a strategic architecture (Brand Strategy, Content Ecosystem, and Partnerships Strategy) and also own narrative execution (Tone of Voice, Copywriting, Campaign Storytelling, and Agile Content Creation).

While offline community events and physical venue management are handled by separate operational/community teams, **you are the master narrator**, turning product drops, design choices, craft provenance, and brand partnerships into captivating, world-class content across all digital and brand touchpoints.

**Core Responsibilities**

**Pillar 1: Brand, Content & Partnerships Strategy (65% Focus)**

* **Brand Strategy & Localization:** Adapt Subko’s core positioning for the UAE market—translating South Asian craft and origin stories for Dubai’s design-forward, specialty coffee, and cultural audience without over-explaining or diluting the brand identity.
* **Content Strategy Architecture:** Define and maintain Subko UAE’s multi-platform content strategy (Instagram, TikTok, emerging channels). Build structured content pillars around Product, Craft & Provenance, Culture, and Behind-the-Scenes.
* **Strategic Partnerships:** Identify and shape high-impact brand partnerships, co-branding initiatives, and cultural collaborations in Dubai (design, lifestyle, art, and hospitality entities).
* **Cross-Market Alignment:** Collaborate closely with Subko India’s Brand and Design HQ to ensure global narrative consistency while tailoring GCC-specific content strategies.

**Pillar 2: Content Storytelling, Tone of Voice & Execution (35% Focus)**

* **Master Tone of Voice & Copywriting:** Own all outward-facing written copy across campaigns, product launches, social channels, and in-store collateral; executing high-standard written copy in alignment with Subko’s brand voice and writing guidelines.
* **Product Drop & Narrative Arcs:** Turn every launch into a multi-phase narrative journey (Pre-launch tease Launch moment post-launch depth), tying coffee origins, bakery items, and design drops back into Subko’s broader universe.
* **Creative Direction & Production:** Lead visual and narrative direction for shoots. Write creative briefs for photographers and videographers and build aesthetic reference boards for Subko storytelling.
* **Agile Content Creation:** Independently capture and edit quick-turnaround, high-craft digital content for time-sensitive moments using mobile creative tools (CapCut, Lightroom, Canva, Premiere, or equivalent).
* **Translating Venue to Screen:** Capture authentic & raw moments from Subko's lens and convert them into compelling online stories (without managing the physical offline events/community ops yourself).

**Key Requirements**

* **Experience:** 10-12 years in brand strategy, content strategy, creative direction, editorial writing, or brand communications within specialty coffee, F&B, design, luxury, or culture-led brands.
* **Narrative Mastery:** Exceptional written English skills with a demonstrated ability to write nuanced, engaging brand copy and build cohesive storytelling campaigns.
* **Strategic & Visual Eye:** Proven track record of developing multi-channel content ecosystems and directing visual creative teams (photo/video).
* **UAE Market Nuance:** Deep familiarity with Dubai’s culture, design, and F&B landscape.
* **Hands-on Execution:** Proficient in quick-turnaround content capture/editing (CapCut, Lightroom, Canva, or similar platforms) for rapid digital publishing along with management systems like Notion & Google workspace for process flow management.

Pay: AED22,000.00 - AED25,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Senior AI Artist

We design experiences, products, and communications that captivate audiences and create enduring value for the world’s most ambitious brands. As a generative Senior AI Artist at AKQA, you will stand at the intersection of creative imagination and cutting-edge technology. You will champion the craft of AI-generated visual media, translating nuanced creative direction into striking, campaign-grade imagery while expanding our capabilities into next-generation AI video production.

Working with Google tools and applications alongside the broader generative AI ecosystem, you will take ownership of the generation, refinement, and post-production of client-ready assets. Collaborating closely with Creative Directors, Art Directors, and multidisciplinary project teams, you will guide visual feasibility, push aesthetic boundaries, and establish best-in-class generative workflows.

Role Requirements

Own Image Generation & Finishing: Lead the end-to-end production of complex AI-generated campaign visuals from concepting and prompt engineering through to iteration, compositing, and final polish.
Champion Video Exploration: Actively contribute to AI video production across all stages, including reference gathering, storyboarding, generation, motion consistency, upscaling, and post-production finishing.
Translate Creative Vision: Partner with Associate Creative Directors and Creative Directors to interpret visual references, briefs, and brand guidelines into compelling, aesthetically refined outputs.
Ensure Fidelity and Brand Accuracy: Scrutinise subject likeness, product accuracy, lighting, environment, and textures to deliver near-final, campaign-ready fidelity during client review stages.
Bridge Tech & Creativity: Serve as an informed voice on generative possibilities and constraints, clearly communicating workflows, limitations, and alternative creative solutions to internal teams and clients.
Refine and Retouch: Apply traditional visual craft and post-production techniques (compositing, retouching, colour grading) to ensure outputs meet AKQA’s benchmark for visual excellence.
Experiment and Share: Continually explore, benchmark, and stress-test emerging image and video models, node-based workflows, and creative tooling, actively sharing insights across the studio.

Qualities & Characteristics

Exceptional Aesthetic Craft: A distinguished eye for composition, cinematic lighting, material realism, perspective, and fine detail, substantiated by an outstanding portfolio of generative work.
Generative Fluency: Deep, hands-on experience across state-of-the-art AI image platforms, with demonstrated experience in Google’s generative AI ecosystem and wider production tools.
Motion & Video Acumen: A keen understanding of high-quality video fundamentals: motion coherence, camera movement, temporal consistency, pacing, and continuity.
Technical Versatility: Familiarity with node-based generation workflows (e.g., ComfyUI), advanced high-resolution upscaling, and traditional post-production tools (Adobe Photoshop, Premiere Pro, After Effects).
Craft in Ambiguity: Agile and inventive when problem-solving generative quirks, visual artefacts, and rapid iteration cycles within deadline-driven campaign environments.
Collaborative Communicator: Receptive to creative feedback, articulate in explaining generative nuances to non-technical stakeholders, and eager to elevate the collective standard of the team.
Relentless Curiosity: A self-starter mindset with an appetite to learn, rapidly test new models, and shape the evolving language of AI-driven art direction.

Job Description

What’s the role?

Lead the creative engine: Own the creative system from commercial objective and concept through to variants, live testing and scaled production, creating a model that delivers quality creative at speed and volume.
Build creative for performance: Develop creative with testing in mind from the start, creating clear hooks, angles and formats that can be deliberately tested, measured and improved.
Create scalable creative systems: Build modular approaches that allow strong ideas to flex effectively across customer segments, channels and formats without starting again every time.
Personalise the creative experience: Develop creative for specific audiences, lifecycle moments and channels, moving beyond a one-size-fits-all approach.
Turn insights into better creative: Partner with Product Marketing to bring audience, channel and performance insights into the creative process and use results to continuously improve future work.
Lead the test-and-learn approach: Define what creative variants should be tested, why they are being tested and what the results can teach us, creating a strong learning loop across campaigns.
Stay hands-on: Personally concept and art direct priority campaigns and strategic work, setting the creative standard through what you produce as well as what you review.
Lead and develop Creative Partners: Coach, mentor and develop the Creative Partner team, allocating talent across product streams and ensuring the right creative support is focused on the right priorities.
Set the creative standard: Own the craft bar across the team, provide creative assessment and contribute to hiring and progression decisions while ensuring quality without becoming a delivery bottleneck.
Connect creative across the business: Partner closely with Product Marketing, Marketing Operations and Governance, Brand, Communications and Experiences, and Design to create consistent campaign and customer experiences.
Protect the brand: Ensure strong and consistent brand application across product streams while maintaining high standards of craft across digital, social, video, in-branch, print and colleague channels.
Scale creativity intelligently: Build a production model that increases creative volume and velocity while protecting quality, using AI and automation where they genuinely strengthen the creative process.

What do you bring?

10+ years of creative experience, including at least 3 years leading creative teams.
A strong portfolio of integrated campaign work across digital, social, video and print.
Demonstrated experience in performance or direct-response creative, including variant development, structured testing and using results to improve creative work.
Experience building modular or systemised creative that can scale across audiences, channels and formats.
The ability and willingness to remain hands-on, personally producing, concepting and art directing while leading a team.
Experience working within an embedded or business-partnering creative model.
A strong track record of coaching, mentoring and developing creative talent.
Strong commercial thinking with the confidence to treat creative as a measurable driver of business and customer outcomes.
The ability to maintain high creative standards while enabling a team to move quickly and independently.
Experience in direct-to-consumer, growth or high-volume marketing environments is an advantage.
Experience working within regulated or governed environments is an advantage.
Bilingual Arabic and English creative capability is a strong advantage.

Creative Leadership
Creative Strategy & Concept Development
Art Direction
Integrated Campaign Development
Performance Creative
Creative Testing & Optimisation
Personalised & Targeted Creative
Modular Creative Systems
Digital, Social, Video & Print
Brand & Creative Standards
Commercial Acumen
Team Leadership & Coaching
Cross-Functional Collaboration
Stakeholder Management
AI & Creative Automation

Because great creative should do more than look good. It should move people and drive results.

You’ll build a creative engine designed for personalisation, testing and scale, helping our Cards, Everyday Banking, Wealth and Lending, Business Banking and Moonshots propositions connect with customers in more relevant and impactful ways.

Your creativity. Your impact. Your future.
