jobs.description:
Scopely is looking for an experienced Creative Lead
to join the Stumble Guys team at Flamed, Scopely’s in-house creative agency, in Barcelona on a hybrid basis.

At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play, every day. We are a global team developing, publishing and innovating in the games industry, connecting millions of people around the world.

We are Flamed, the in-house creative agency, an international multidisciplinary team. We produce thousands of creatives each year to support the global marketing needs of all Scopely games.

What You Will Do

Stumble Guys brings millions of players together for chaotic multiplayer races, absurd obstacles and hilarious fails. Our creative work should capture that same energy and humour.

We are looking for a creative leader with proven experience in mobile user acquisition and organic social content, strong creative judgment and a clear understanding of Gen Alpha’s gaming culture, creators, humor and content habits.

Reporting to the Senior Creative Director, you will develop creative concepts for UA, organic and reengagement, informed by performance insights, marketing strategy and relevant trends. You will partner closely with UA, Marketing and production leads to bring those ideas to life, tailoring the storytelling, formats and language to each audience and channel.

Lead research, benchmarking and brainstorms to develop creative concepts for UA, organic and reengagement, informed by marketing objectives, performance insights, audience motivations and relevant trends.
Partner with Marketing, Project Managers and Producers on creative roadmaps, aligning with game updates, events and collaborations, and agreeing realistic priorities, scope and timelines.
Develop creative testing roadmaps with UA partners, defining hypotheses, prioritising new concepts and iterations, and identifying the questions each test should answer.
Develop and present clear pitches and decks, scripts and storyboards, explaining the creative rationale and adapting storytelling, hooks and visual direction to each audience and channel.
Create clear, actionable production briefs and handovers in close partnership with the Arts and Animation team, our production powerhouse, communicating the concept, creative intent, audience and channel requirements. Provide creative input and clarification when consulted during production.
Work with UA, Marketing and Creative Intelligence partners to interpret asset performance, share actionable learnings and improve future concepts and tests.
Partner with Social and Community teams to develop recurring organic formats and content ideas informed by audience behaviour, community feedback and platform trends.
Use AI throughout your workflow to support research, work organisation, performance analysis and roadmap planning, continually identifying practical ways to improve speed and effectiveness.

What We Are Looking For

A strong background in advertising, creative strategy or creative direction, with demonstrated experience leading creative work for mobile products.
Proven experience developing creative for both performance marketing / user acquisition and organic social content, with a clear understanding of their different objectives and measures of success.
Strong understanding of Gen Alpha’s gaming and entertainment culture, including creators, humour, storytelling and platform conventions, with concrete examples of how this informs your creative decisions.
Strong organisation and prioritisation skills, with experience partnering on creative and testing roadmaps and aligning work with marketing calendars and production plans.
Strong concept development and storytelling skills, with an eye for hooks, pacing, visual clarity and the details that make short-form content effective.
Confidence working with UA KPIs and creative dashboards, translating performance data into hypotheses and actionable creative decisions.
Experience collaborating with multidisciplinary teams and external partners through clear briefs, effective handovers and constructive creative input.
Practical understanding of video, gameplay capture, animation and design workflows, sufficient to assess feasibility, brief specialists and collaborate effectively with production partners.
An AI-first approach to work, with demonstrated experience integrating AI tools into everyday workflows, including organisation, research, analysis and planning, and sound judgment when assessing their outputs.
Excellent communication and presentation skills in English, with the ability to explain your thinking, align stakeholders and drive decisions.

Bonus Point

Experience in mobile gaming or entertainment.
Experience creating campaigns or ongoing content for Gen Alpha or other young audiences.
Experience collaborating with creators or developing content inspired by creator formats.

Please include a portfolio, reel or case studies showing both UA and organic social work. Alongside the final assets, explain your contribution, the strategy behind the work, and the results or learnings that informed your next decisions.

About Scopely

Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live-operates one of the most diversified and award-winning portfolios in the games industry — bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play.

Founded in 2011, Scopely is powered by its exceptional team — including thousands of world-class gamemakers around the globe, a distinctive tenet-driven culture, and its proprietary technology platform, Playgami. Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely’s position as the #1 mobile games company in the U.S. and #2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue. Whether building global sensations like “MONOPOLY GO!” from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Scopely Explore games businesses — Scopely consistently delivers experiences players love today and return to for years to come.

Recognized multiple times as one of the "100 Most Influential Companies in the World" by TIME magazine and one of Fast Company's "World's Most Innovative Companies" and “Best Workplaces for Innovators,” Scopely believes that video games can be a force for good — creating meaningful connections, vibrant communities, and making life better through play.

Scopely has global operations and partners across four continents in more than a dozen countries worldwide. For more information, visit: https://www.scopely.com/.

Should you have any questions or encounter any fraudulent requests/emails/websites, please immediately contact recruiting@scopely.com. Our job applicant privacy policies are available here: California Privacy Notice and EEA/UK Privacy Notice.

Employment at Scopely is based solely on a person's merit and qualifications. jobs.description:
About ValidA little about us: We’re Valid, Valid isn’t just a performance or content agency. We’re a product-driven creative company with an in-house engineering team that builds tools to test, learn, and scale what works. We combine strategy, creative, and AI to turn insights into systems, helping brands move faster and make better decisions across every channel.



The RoleThis is a senior leadership role for someone who can sit at the center of client growth, creative performance, and internal execution, and make all three move faster.

Your job is not simply to oversee deliverables.

Your job is to make sure the work we put into client accounts wins.

That means understanding the client’s business deeply, recognizing that what they ask for is not always what they actually need, and having the strategic confidence to redirect, refine, and shape the work into something that outperforms what is already running.

You must be equally comfortable:

leading creative direction,

building testing strategy,

pitching directly to clients,

managing high-level relationships,

pushing back when necessary,

and translating all of that into clear internal execution.

This is a hands-on operator role.

You cannot lead this from above.

You must know how to build strategy, create strong concepts, understand AI production, and step into the work yourself when needed. The team should move faster because your expertise is in the room.

This role sits at the intersection of:

creative leadership, performance strategy, client trust, and speed.

The pace is aggressive.

Clients move fast. Ad accounts move faster. So do we.



What You’ll Actually OwnClient Strategy & Relationship Leadership

You will be the senior strategic voice on key accounts.

That means understanding each client’s business model, offer, funnel, and performance landscape, knowing what is working and failing in their account, and identifying where creative can become the growth lever.

Clients will often tell us what they think they need.

Your job is to identify the real problem underneath the ask and guide them toward the right solution.

You should be able to command trust quickly, pitch with confidence, and build relationships that make clients want to follow your lead.

Creative Performance Direction

You are responsible for ensuring the creative strategy is built to outperform.

This means:

building testing plans around real account opportunities,

identifying which hooks, offers, formats, and angles should be attacked next,

steering concepts toward performance over subjective preference,

and making sure every batch of work has a strategic reason for existing.

You are not approving ads because they look good.

You are approving ads because you understand why they should win.

The expectation is simple: our work should beat what the client was running before we got there.

Internal Team Leadership

You will lead internal creatives, editors, strategists, and producers with speed and clarity.

You must be able to take a messy client conversation, extract the strategic signal, convert it into actionable briefs, sharpen weak ideas, and keep production moving without bottlenecks.

You are the connective tissue between client expectation and final output.

Pitching, Selling & Expanding Trust

This role is highly outward-facing.

You should be able to present concepts persuasively, defend strategic choices, handle skepticism, and continually reinforce that we know how to make accounts perform.

Strong communication matters here as much as strong creative instinct.

Long-term retention often comes down to whether the client believes we see opportunities they do not.



Who This Is ForThis is for someone who:

understands performance creative deeply,

thinks strategically beyond what is asked,

can lead clients without becoming a yes-person,

can lead teams without babysitting,

can pitch with conviction,

and thrives in a fast, demanding environment.

This is not a clock-in, clock-out role.

Priorities shift. Problems appear. Speed matters.

The people who thrive here are the ones who know how to solve, adapt, and keep moving.

Who we are

Flow Pouch makes functional mushroom pouches. People use them as a clean alternative to nicotine pouches and energy products: no nicotine, no caffeine, no crash. We launched in 2024, we have grown quickly, mostly through subscriptions, and we manufacture in the US. We are a remote team of about 30 people globally.

Why we are hiring

Paid social is how we grow, and our creative team works in pods: a strategist owns an angle, writes the concepts, scripts and briefs, and works with dedicated AI-first editors who bring them to life. We are adding strategists to two pods, each owning one angle, so that every angle has one person who knows it better than anyone else.

You would report to your pod lead and work with our Head of Creative and our CMO, who reviews creative weekly.

What you will own

  • One angle inside a pod. Research, concepts, scripts and briefs for it, and the iteration loop with your editors.

  • Weekly output. Around five net-new concepts and ten iterations a week, briefed clearly enough that editors can execute without going back and forth.

  • The numbers for your angle. Hit rate and new-customer ROAS, read in Triple Whale, with a weekly summary of what you tested and what you learned.

  • Your editors' time. You decide what they make and in what order, and you give them feedback that makes the next version better.

What this role is not

This is not a media buying role, not a content or organic role, and not a video editing role. You write and direct; your editors produce. It is also not an agency seat: one brand, one angle, all the way down.

  • You want to be measured on results and you want a ladder that reflects them.

What is hard about this

We would rather you hear it now than in month three:

  • The weekly volume is the job. Five net-new concepts and ten iterations is the floor, not the ceiling.

Higgsfield AI is the fastest-scaling generative AI company in history, hitting $700M in annual revenue run rate, 30M+ users worldwide, 6M+ generations per day, and powering 390 of Fortune 500 brands. 

We're building at the absolute frontier of AI-powered video creation and next-generation creative tools. Joining Higgsfield means becoming part of a high-impact team shaping the future of AI-native experiences, at a company that isn't just moving fast, but rewriting what fast looks like.

About the role:

We’re looking for a Forward Deployed Creative Lead to sit at the intersection of generative AI, cinematic production, and enterprise customers.

You’ll turn customer briefs into exceptional demos and pilots, build production-ready AI workflows, and work directly with creative teams to bring Higgsfield into real-world production.

The creative bar is extremely high. You understand why a shot works — from lensing, lighting, and composition to camera movement, pacing, and edit rhythm — and know how to reliably achieve commercial-quality results with generative models.

What you'll do:

Own the technical and creative execution of enterprise demos, pilots, and deployments from brief through final delivery.

Direct and produce cinematic AI content, including shot design, generation, consistency, editing, and delivery.

Build repeatable production workflows using generative models, prompting systems, APIs, MCP, automation, and agentic workflows.

Reverse-engineer reference ads, film looks, and visual styles into reproducible Higgsfield workflows.

Lead live demos, workshops, and hands-on training for customer creative teams.

Partner directly with CMOs, creative directors, production leaders, and technical stakeholders.

Bring customer insights, product gaps, and emerging use cases back to Product, Engineering, and Research.

Stay at the forefront of image and video generation and continuously push what’s possible with Higgsfield.

Exceptional portfolio of cinematic AI work at commercial quality — portfolio first.

5+ years of experience in film, advertising, commercial, or creative production, including 2+ years hands-on with generative AI.

Deep fluency across image and video models, consistency techniques, VFX, motion, and AI production workflows.

Strong cinematic fundamentals across shot design, lighting, composition, storyboarding, camera movement, and editing.

Experience delivering customer-facing pilots, PoCs, or productions from brief through final output.

Comfortable presenting to executives and running live demos.

Ability to translate complex AI workflows for non-technical creative teams.

High agency, strong ownership, and the ability to move quickly in a startup environment.

Excellent communication skills.

The opportunity to work on ambitious AI products alongside a highly experienced, fast-moving, and international team.

Mit unserer einzigartigen Kombination aus Media, Customer Experience Management und Creative transformieren wir Geschäftsmodelle und ermöglichen nachhaltiges Wachstum für Marken, Menschen und die Gesellschaft.

jobs.title: Creative AI Lead (m|w|d)
jobs.description:
WIR SIND WIETHE

Wiethe gehört zu den führenden Content-Produktionsunternehmen Europas und ist Marktführer in Deutschland. Für internationale Marken wie adidas, Y-3, Tchibo, C&A, FC Bayern München und Peek & Cloppenburg entwickeln und produzieren wir Content auf höchstem Qualitätsniveau.

Mit rund 250 Mitarbeitenden an unseren Standorten Bremen und Osnabrück produzieren wir jährlich über 5 Millionen Bilder, mehr als 20.000 Filme und mehrere Tausend AI Assets.

Unsere Kompetenz verbindet Fotografie, Film, Generative AI und CGI. Was uns besonders macht: Wir denken Content nicht in einzelnen Kampagnen, sondern in skalierbaren, technologisch gestützten Produktionsprozessen – mit höchsten Ansprüchen an Qualität, Effizienz und Konsistenz.

Generative AI ist ein zentraler Bestandteil unserer Wachstumsstrategie. Wir investieren konsequent in neue Technologien, intelligente Workflows und die Weiterentwicklung unserer Produktionsmöglichkeiten.

Dafür suchen wir erfahrene Persönlichkeiten, die Verantwortung übernehmen, Teams führen, Kunden begeistern und unser weiteres Wachstum aktiv mitgestalten.

DEINE ROLLE

Als Creative AI Lead (m|w|d)
übernimmst Du eine zentrale kreative Rolle in unserem wachsenden AI-Bereich.

Du verantwortest die kreative Entwicklung anspruchsvoller AI-Projekte für führende internationale Marken und begleitest sie von der ersten Idee bis zum finalen Ergebnis. Dabei verbindest Du ein ausgeprägtes Gespür für Ästhetik, Bildsprache und Markenwelten mit fundierter praktischer Erfahrung im Umgang mit Generative AI.

Dein Fokus liegt auf der Entwicklung außergewöhnlicher visueller Konzepte, Bildwelten und kreativer AI-Lösungen, die Markenidentität, gestalterischen Anspruch und neue technologische Möglichkeiten miteinander verbinden.

Du bist kreative Instanz, fachlicher Lead, Sparringspartner unserer Kunden und Impulsgeber für die kreative Weiterentwicklung unserer AI-Projekte.

DEINE AUFGABEN

Kreative Konzeption: Entwicklung und fachliche Führung innovativer GenAI-Konzepte für Marken, Kampagnen und unterschiedliche Content-Formate.
AI Art Direction: Definition und Weiterentwicklung von Look & Feel, Bildsprache, visuellen Systemen und kreativen Qualitätsstandards für AI-gestützte Produktionen.
Hands-on AI Creation: Eigenständiges Testen und Kombinieren generativer AI-Tools und Modelle sowie deren gezielter Einsatz in Bild- und Bewegtbildproduktionen.
Markenübersetzung: Übertragung von Markenidentitäten, Briefings und kreativen Leitideen in eigenständige, reproduzierbare GenAI-Ansätze und Bildwelten.
Kreative Projektführung: Fachliche Führung und kreative Weiterentwicklung der AI-Projekte gemeinsam mit den beteiligten Kreativ-Teams aus AI Artists, Art Direction, Design, CGI, Foto, Motion und weiteren Disziplinen.
Kreative Qualität: Sicherstellung einer durchgehend hohen gestalterischen Qualität, einer starken visuellen Idee und konsistenter Markenwirkung – auch über größere Asset-Mengen und Kampagnen hinweg.
Kundenverantwortung: Souveräne Beratung und Betreuung nationaler und internationaler Kunden auf Senior-Level – von der kreativen und strategischen Beratung bis zur Präsentation und Umsetzung.
Creative Technology: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Production und Technology, um kreative Ideen in technisch belastbare und wirtschaftlich realisierbare Produktionsansätze zu übersetzen.
Innovation und Weiterentwicklung: Kontinuierliche Identifikation neuer Modelle, kreativer Technologien und visueller Trends sowie deren Übersetzung in neue Bildsprachen, Formate und Content-Konzepte.
Wissenstransfer: Aufbau und Weitergabe kreativer Best Practices und Standards für den professionellen Einsatz von Generative AI.

UNSERE ERWARTUNGEN

Was Du Mitbringen Solltest

Mehrjährige relevante Erfahrung in Art Direction, Creative Direction, Design, visueller Kommunikation, Creative Technology oder vergleichbaren kreativen Disziplinen.
Fundierte praktische Erfahrung mit generativer AI in professionellen kreativen Projekten und Content-Produktionen.WIETHE CONTENT / CAREERS
Creative AI Lead
Ein ausgeprägtes ästhetisches Gespür und einen sehr hohen Anspruch an Bildsprache, Komposition, Licht, Styling, Materialität und visuelle Qualität.
Ein überzeugendes Portfolio, das Deine kreative Handschrift, Dein Markenverständnis und den professionellen Einsatz generativer AI zeigt.
Erfahrung in der eigenständigen Konzeption und fachlichen Steuerung anspruchsvoller kreativer Projekte mit unterschiedlichen Beteiligten.
Die Fähigkeit, Markenanforderungen und kreative Briefings in eigenständige visuelle Konzepte und Bildwelten zu übersetzen.
Hands-on-Mentalität, Experimentierfreude und echte Begeisterung für neue kreative Technologien.
Souveränes Auftreten gegenüber anspruchsvollen Kunden sowie ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Präsentationsstärke.
Die Fähigkeit, kreative Entscheidungen klar zu treffen, zu begründen und innerhalb interdisziplinärer Projekte fachlich zu vertreten.
Sehr gute Englischkenntnisse; Deutschkenntnisse sind von Vorteil.
Bereitschaft zu regelmäßiger Präsenz an unserem Hauptstandort Bremen, da kreative Zusammenarbeit, Produktionen und Kundennähe wesentliche Bestandteile dieser Position sind.

Was Zusätzlich Von Vorteil Ist

Erfahrung mit AI-gestützter Bild- und Videogenerierung, Image-to-Image, Style Development, Character Consistency oder vergleichbaren generativen Verfahren.
Erfahrung mit hybriden Foto-, CGI-, Motion-, VFX- oder AI-Workflows.
Erfahrung mit internationalen Marken und anspruchsvollen Kampagnenproduktionen.
Kenntnisse aus Fashion, Lifestyle, E-Commerce, Werbung oder der Agenturwelt.
Erfahrung mit Kundenworkshops, Pitches, Mentoring oder kreativer fachlicher Leitung interdisziplinärer Projektteams.

UNSER ANGEBOT

Eine zentrale kreative Lead-Rolle mit großem Gestaltungsspielraum und direktem Einfluss auf die Weiterentwicklung unserer AI-Kreation.
Die Möglichkeit, die visuelle Handschrift unserer AI-Projekte maßgeblich mitzuprägen und neue Bildwelten für führende internationale Marken zu entwickeln.
Arbeiten in einem der größten und modernsten Content-Produktionsumfelder Europas – an der Schnittstelle von Generative AI, Fotografie, Film und CGI.
Modernste technologische Infrastruktur und die Freiheit, neue kreative Technologien nicht nur zu erproben, sondern in realen Produktionen einzusetzen.
Einen außergewöhnlich modernen, hochwertig gestalteten und bestens ausgestatteten Arbeitsplatz mit einem inspirierenden Arbeitsumfeld.
Ein erfahrenes, interdisziplinäres Team mit hoher Kompetenz in Kreation, Foto, Film, AI und CGI.
Flexible Arbeitsmöglichkeiten mit einem begrenzten Homeoffice-Anteil, abgestimmt auf die Anforderungen der Rolle und die Zusammenarbeit vor Ort.
Langfristige Perspektiven in einem etablierten, wirtschaftlich starken und technologisch zukunftsorientierten Unternehmen.
Attraktive Zusatzleistungen wie Corporate Benefits, Business Bike und betriebliche Altersvorsorge.

READY TO SHAPE THE NEXT LEVEL OF AI CONTENT PRODUCTION?

Du möchtest Generative AI nicht nur anwenden, sondern neue visuelle Möglichkeiten erschließen, außergewöhnliche Markenwelten entwickeln und den kreativen Einsatz von AI auf das nächste Level bringen?

Du verbindest ästhetischen Anspruch mit technologischer Neugier und hast Lust, gemeinsam mit starken Teams neue Maßstäbe für AI-gestützte Kreation zu setzen?

Dann möchten wir Dich kennenlernen.

Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung mit Angabe Deines frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermins und Deiner Gehaltsvorstellung. Besonders interessant ist für uns Dein Portfolio mit ausgewählten Arbeiten, AI-Projekten, Kampagnen oder visuellen Experimenten, die Deine kreative Handschrift und Deinen Umgang mit Generative AI zeigen.

jobs.description:
Job Description

What’s the role?

Own the creative for your product stream: Lead the creative response from initial concept through to delivered assets, working closely with Product Marketing to understand the customer, proposition and commercial objective.
Turn insight into ideas: Develop creative concepts grounded in customer understanding and business objectives, going beyond simply responding to a brief.
Strengthen the brief: Partner with Product Marketing early in the process to challenge, test and improve briefs before creative production begins.
Create personalised experiences: Design creative for specific audiences, lifecycle moments and channels rather than relying on one asset adapted everywhere.
Design for performance: Develop creative variants with clear testing objectives and use audience, channel and campaign performance insights to continually improve the work.
Build a creative learning loop: Use results from previous campaigns to inform future ideas, helping the team understand what worked, what didn’t and what to do differently next time.
Present and sell your ideas: Confidently present creative to teams and senior stakeholders, clearly explaining the thinking and commercial rationale behind the work.
Bring stakeholders on the journey: Involve stakeholders throughout the creative process, responding constructively to challenge while protecting the strength and intent of the idea.
Become part of the business: Work as an embedded member of your Product Marketing team, building deep knowledge of the product stream so you can contribute when the problem is being shaped, not only when the brief arrives.
Stay hands-on with the craft: Design work yourself and art direct through to delivery when specialist creative expertise or external production is required.
Design across channels: Create campaign and product creative across digital, social, web and landing pages, video, in-branch, print and colleague channels.
Direct specialist creative: Brief motion, video and copy specialists and provide clear, practical creative direction and feedback that strengthens the final work.
Use AI as part of the craft: Bring AI into your everyday creative workflow to explore ideas, generate variants and adapt work across formats and languages while maintaining strong creative judgement.
Build smarter AI workflows: Develop reusable prompts, references and creative set-ups that produce stronger, more on-brand output and share your learnings to help the wider team improve.
Protect the standard: Ensure creative meets Rakbank brand, accessibility, regulatory and Shariah requirements before release while contributing actively to creative critique.
Support creative talent: Help more junior designers develop through strong examples, constructive feedback and the sharing of creative knowledge.

What do you bring?

5+ years of experience in creative or design within an agency, in-house studio, or a combination of both.
A strong portfolio of campaign work spanning digital, social and video, demonstrating genuine concept development rather than execution alone.
Experience working directly with business stakeholders and the confidence to challenge and strengthen a brief constructively.
Strong art direction skills with the ability to guide specialist creative disciplines.
Confidence presenting creative concepts and their rationale to senior stakeholders.
Strong proficiency in Adobe Creative Cloud and Figma.
Practical experience using AI within your creative process and a genuine appetite to experiment with new tools and approaches.
Experience designing for digital and web alongside campaign and print creative.
An understanding of performance creative, including variants, structured testing and using results to improve future work.
The ability to work successfully as an embedded creative partner within a business team rather than operating from a central creative queue.
Strong ownership, taking creative work from the first conversation through to the final delivered asset.
Bilingual Arabic and English creative capability is a strong advantage.
Experience working within regulated or governed environments is an advantage.

Creative Concept Development
Senior Creative Design
Art Direction
Integrated Campaign Creative
Digital & Social Design
Web & Landing Page Design
Performance Creative
Creative Testing & Optimisation
Personalised & Targeted Creative
Adobe Creative Cloud
Figma
AI-Assisted Creative Production
Stakeholder Presentation & Influencing
Commercial & Customer Thinking
Brand & Creative Standards
Cross-Functional Collaboration

Why Rakbank?

Because the best creative doesn’t start with a brief. It starts with understanding the customer and the opportunity.

At Rakbank, you’ll work closely with the business, own the creative for your product stream and have the space to turn customer and commercial insight into work that makes an impact. You’ll experiment with new tools, including AI, develop ideas across multiple channels and help shape a creative function where technology handles more of the repetitive production so talented designers can spend more time on the thinking, craft and ideas that matter.

Your ideas. Your craft. Your impact.

Über uns

Kijimea – Aus der Forschung. Für Dein Leben.
Seit unserer Gründung im Jahr 2011 verfolgen wir eine klare Vision: Wir möchten das Potenzial der Mikrobiota (Bakterien) in unserem Darm gezielt nutzen für ein längeres und gesünderes Leben - für alle Menschen.
Ein erster großer Meilenstein auf diesem Weg gelang uns bereits 2013 mit der Entdeckung und klinischen Erforschung des einzigartigen Bakterienstamms B. bifidum MIMBb75 ( Kijimea Reizdarm
). Seitdem konnten wir das Leben von Millionen Reizdarmpatienten weltweit spürbar verbessern. Heute gehört B. bifidum MIMBb75 zu den am besten erforschten Bakterienstämmen weltweit. Seine Wirksamkeit und sein einzigartiger Wirkmechanismus wurden in zahlreichen klinischen Studien nachgewiesen und publiziert – u.a. in renommierten Fachzeitschriften wie The Lancet
.
Wir arbeiten mit führenden Forschungsinstitutionen wie der Charité Berlin zusammen, um die Zusammenhänge zwischen der Mikrobiota (Bakterien in unserem Darm) und Allergien, Hautkrankheiten und psychischen Störungen zu erforschen. Kurz gesagt: Wir untersuchen, wie die Bakterien in unserem Darm Einfluss auf ein längeres und gesünderes Leben nehmen.
Heute zählen wir zu den am schnellsten wachsenden Healthcare-Unternehmen weltweit. Unsere Kunden erreichen wir über verschiedenste Kanäle: über die direkte Kommunikation mit Ärzten und Apothekern sowie Print-, TV- und Digitalmarketing. Um unser stark wachsendes Geschäft in Europa weiter auszubauen, suchen wir herausragende Talente, die uns bei dieser Mission unterstützen. Unser Ziel ist klar definiert: Bis 2028 wollen wir Kijimea zur weltweit größten DTC-Probiotikamarke machen und damit jährlich über 50 Millionen Menschen ein besseres Leben schenken.
Für Dich klingt das spannend? Dann bewirb Dich jetzt! Wir freuen uns darauf, Dich kennenzulernen.

Deine Mission bei uns

Du willst in einem der am schnellsten wachsenden Healthcare-Unternehmen Europas mit überzeugenden Creatives dazu beitragen, die Brücke zwischen klinischer Forschung und überzeugenden Botschaften für Patientinnen zu schlagen? Dich treibt die Frage um, warum bestimmte Gesundheitsbotschaften wirken, und du bist bereit, Ownership für die Insights und Prozesse zu übernehmen, die unsere gesamte Creative-Pipeline optimieren? Dann bist Du bei uns genau richtig!
Wir suchen ab sofort einen Creative Strategist (w/m/d) für Kijimea. Du wirst Teil eines Teams, das Klarheit, Wissenschaft und Kundenverhalten konsequent in den Mittelpunkt stellt. Gemeinsam erschließen wir neue Wachstumschancen, indem wir kreative Konzepte systematisch testen und unsere Position als vertrauenswürdigste, datengetriebene Marke in der Kategorie Verdauungsgesundheit weiter ausbauen.

Du führst quantitative sowie qualitative Markt- und Zielgruppenanalysen durch, um Präferenzen, Motive und Bedürfnisse der Zielgruppen fundiert zu verstehen.
Du schreibst Direct-Response-Skripte für den Bereich Video-Content und nutzt dabei Storytelling-Elemente, um Aufmerksamkeit zu erzeugen und überzeugend zu argumentieren.
Du erstellst klare, datenbasierte Briefings für unsere Agenturpartner, damit überzeugender Content entsteht
Du tauchst tief in Performance-Daten ein und identifizierst, warum ein Creative gewonnen oder verloren hat – ob Hook, medizinischer Claim oder visuelles Format – und spielst die Learnings direkt in die Produktion zu-rück.
Du bringst proaktiv Ideen ein, die unsere Online-Kampagnenziele unterstützen und sich stringent in die Gesamtstrategie einfügen.

Dein Profil

Du hast ein Studium oder eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung z.B. im Bereich Kommunikationswissenschaften, Wirtschaftspsychologie, Journalismus oder Marketing.
Du konntest bereits mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrungen im Bereich Creative Strategy sammeln (idealerweise in einer Agentur oder in einem Start-/Scale-up) und möchtest deine Skills nun bei einem der am schnellsten wachsenden Healthcare Player weltweit einbringen und weiter ausbauen.
Du verstehst, dass Content auf Plattformen wie Meta oder Youtube ein entscheidender Performance Treiber ist und brennst dafür, neue Formate und Angles zu entwickeln und zu testen
Du arbeitest datenbasiert und gehst analytisch ins Detail; seien es kommerzielle KPI wie ROAS oder CPO, oder auch Klick-, Hook- oder Engagement Rates
Du arbeitest äußerst strukturiert, sorgfältig und zuverlässig.
Du verfügst über ausgezeichnete Deutschkenntnisse (mind. C1-Level) und gute Englischkenntnisse (mind. B2-Level).

Unser Versprechen

Unser innovatives Umfeld ermöglicht Dir Deine berufliche Entfaltung mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen, Verantwortung von Tag 1 an und den Freiraum, neue Wege zu gehen. jobs.title: Digital Marketing Specialist, FMCG
jobs.description:
An established UAE-based healthcare and wellness distribution company is looking for an experienced Digital Marketing Specialist, FMCG
to design, execute, and optimise digital media strategies across a diverse portfolio of international product brands.
This role combines strategic planning with hands-on execution, focusing on building brand visibility, reaching the right consumers, driving engagement, and converting digital marketing investments into measurable commercial results.
You will work closely with Brand Management, Sales, E-commerce, and external partners to develop brand-specific digital strategies aligned with commercial objectives, product launches, consumer behaviour, and market opportunities.

What You Will Own

Brand Digital Strategy:
Design and execute digital media strategies for individual product brands, translating brand positioning, target audiences, and commercial priorities into actionable plans.
Media Planning & Budgeting:
Develop digital media plans, recommend channel investments, allocate approved budgets, and monitor spending effectiveness across brands.
Paid Media & Campaign Management:
Plan, launch, manage, and optimise campaigns across Google Ads, Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn, and other relevant digital platforms.
Performance Marketing:
Improve campaign effectiveness through audience targeting, bidding strategies, A/B testing, remarketing, and conversion optimisation.
SEO & SEM:
Develop and implement search strategies that strengthen product visibility, generate qualified traffic, and support customer acquisition.
Analytics & Reporting:
Analyse performance using GA4, Meta Insights, and other reporting tools, measuring reach, engagement, conversions, customer acquisition costs, and ROI.
Brand Content & Social Media:
Develop brand-specific digital content plans, coordinate creative production, and ensure consistency across digital platforms.
CRM & Consumer Engagement:
Support targeted email campaigns, audience segmentation, customer journeys, and marketing automation initiatives.
Influencer & Digital Partnerships:
Coordinate influencer campaigns and digital collaborations, ensuring alignment with brand objectives and measurable outcomes.
E-commerce Integration:
Work with e-commerce teams to drive traffic, improve conversion rates, and support online sales through effective digital campaigns.
Innovation & Optimisation:
Identify emerging digital trends, AI-powered tools, and automation opportunities to improve marketing efficiency and effectiveness.
Compliance:
Ensure digital campaigns, advertising claims, and creative materials comply with applicable regulations and brand guidelines.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You can independently develop a digital media strategy and take ownership of its execution.
You understand how to adapt digital strategies to different brands, consumer segments, and commercial objectives.
You have personally managed advertising campaigns and digital media budgets.
You know how to translate performance data into practical decisions that improve campaign results.
You are commercially minded and understand how digital marketing supports brand growth and sales.
You combine creativity, analytical thinking, and hands-on execution.
You can effectively manage multiple brands, campaigns, stakeholders, and deadlines.

Must Have

Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Digital Media, Communications, or a related discipline.
5–7 years of progressive experience in digital marketing
, preferably in healthcare, nutraceuticals, wellness, consumer health, or FMCG.
Proven experience developing and executing digital media strategies across multiple brands or product categories.
Hands-on expertise in Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, paid social advertising, SEO, and SEM.
Demonstrated experience managing digital media budgets and optimising campaign performance.
Strong proficiency in Google Analytics 4 (GA4), digital performance reporting, and conversion analysis.
Experience with audience segmentation, remarketing, A/B testing, and customer acquisition strategies.
Working knowledge of CRM, email marketing, and automation platforms.
Strong analytical, project management, communication, and stakeholder coordination skills.

Nice to Have

Experience managing digital campaigns for healthcare, nutraceutical, wellness, or other regulated consumer products.
Exposure to e-commerce platforms such as Amazon, Noon, or Shopify.
Certifications in Google Ads, Meta Blueprint, HubSpot, or SEO.
Familiarity with Canva, Figma, Adobe Creative Suite, or similar tools.
Experience using AI-powered marketing and automation solutions.

Interested?

If you can combine digital strategy, creative thinking, and performance marketing to deliver measurable brand growth, we would like to hear from you.
Apply through LinkedIn with your updated CV. Candidates who can demonstrate successful digital media strategies, campaign results, and measurable business impact will be particularly encouraged to apply.

jobs.title: Creative Strategist (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Intro

Bei Arvana bauen wir die erste AI-native Go-to-Market-Firma in DACH. Seit 2024 sind wir auf über 5 Mio. € ARR und mehr als 30 Leute im Team gewachsen, und wir legen gerade erst richtig los. Über 200 Unternehmen wie Swisscom, monday.com, Enpal, Talkdesk und FreeNow setzen bereits auf uns.

Als Creative Strategist verantwortest du Design, Story und Messaging unserer Ad Creatives und Landingpages, also der Assets, über die monatlich sechsstellige Budgets in Paid Search und Paid Social laufen. Wir arbeiten zahlengetrieben und schnell, ohne lange Abstimmungsschleifen. Du triffst kreative Entscheidungen eigenständig und siehst in den Performance-Daten direkt, was deine Arbeit bewirkt. Unsere Kunden sind ausschließlich im B2B-Umfeld aktiv, mit erklärungsbedürftigen Produkten und anspruchsvollen Zielgruppen. Deshalb sind Messaging und Creative-Qualität bei uns der entscheidende Performance-Hebel. Starten kannst du ab sofort.

Aufgaben

Du übernimmst die kreative Verantwortung für Ad Creatives und Landingpages ganzer Kundenaccounts und entscheidest eigenständig über Design, Story und Messaging.

Du entwickelst Creative-Strategien für neue Kampagnen und arbeitest dich schnell in komplexe Branchen und erklärungsbedürftige B2B-Produkte ein.

Du konzipierst und gestaltest Creatives und Landingpages für Paid Search und Paid Social auf Google, Microsoft, Meta und LinkedIn, vom Messaging über das Design bis zum fertigen Asset.

Du behältst die Performance deiner Creatives im Blick und iterierst schnell, wenn du in den Daten Schwächen oder Potenziale siehst.

Qualifikation

Deutsch auf C2-Niveau:
Du sprichst und schreibst Deutsch sicher und überzeugend, denn unsere Kunden sitzen in DACH.

Erfahrung:
Du hast bereits Ad Creatives und Landingpages für Paid-Search- und Paid-Social-Kampagnen konzipiert und gestaltet, über die vier- bis fünfstellige Monatsbudgets gelaufen sind.

Arbeitsweise:
Du arbeitest kreativ, analytisch und lösungsorientiert. Du gestaltest nicht nur schön, sondern denkst in Conversion und Performance.

Motivation:
Du willst mit erfahrenen Leuten die Creatives bauen, über die führende B2B-Unternehmen fünf- bis sechsstellige Monatsbudgets skalieren.

Benefits

Coaching & Karriere:
Ab Tag 1 lernst du in 1:1-Coachings von erfahrenen Leuten. Und weil wir so schnell wachsen, entstehen laufend neue Fach- und Führungsrollen.

Nicht mehr kochen:
Jeden Abend ab 19 Uhr bestellen wir Essen fürs Team.

3+2 Hybrid Work:
Drei Tage arbeitest du mit dem Team im Office, bis zu zwei Tage remote.

Top Lage & Ausstattung:
Unser modernes Office liegt in Berlin-Mitte, zwischen Hackeschem Markt und Alexanderplatz. Du arbeitest mit erstklassiger technischer Ausstattung, inklusive MacBook.

Deutschlandticket inklusive:
Wir übernehmen die Kosten für dein Ticket.

Strategy-Offsites:
Regelmäßig nehmen wir uns als ganzes Team raus und arbeiten gemeinsam an der Strategie und Zukunft von Arvana.

Kostenlos trainieren:
Mit der Urban Sports Club M-Mitgliedschaft trainierst du ohne Zusatzkosten.

Bereit mit uns die deutsche B2B-Software Branche zu entwickeln?

Sneak Peek: So läuft dein Bewerbungsprozess bei Arvana ab

Kurzes Kennenlernen

Nach deiner Bewerbung melden wir uns schnell bei dir. In einem 20-minütigen Call lernen wir uns kennen und finden gemeinsam heraus, ob wir zusammenpassen.

Personal Fit

Im zweiten Gespräch, das ca. 30 bis 45 Minuten dauert, lernen wir dich richtig kennen und erfahren, was dich antreibt. Gleichzeitig zeigen wir dir, wie wir bei Arvana arbeiten, und beantworten all deine Fragen.

Case Study vor Ort & Meet the Team

Vorab bekommst du eine Case Study aus unserem Alltag, die du zu Hause vorbereitest und dann bei uns im Office in der Rosenstraße 17 vorstellst. Dabei lernst du unsere Gründer Arne und Mirco persönlich kennen und kannst mit dem Team quatschen. In ca. 90 Minuten nehmen wir dich mit in unsere Prozesse, unsere Mission und unseren Business-Plan. Danach melden wir uns innerhalb von 2 Tagen bei dir.

jobs.description:
What You'll Do
- Lead the data-driven strategic planning and development of creative concepts for platforms like Meta,
Google (YouTube), TikTok, Reddit, and emerging channels
- Oversee execution of creative projects and campaigns from concept through final delivery, partnering
closely with copywriters, designers and performance marketing team
- Systematically develop new creative concepts, angles, hooks, and storylines for each of these platforms,
and keep a steady pipeline of new winning creatives
- Write paid media video scripts and brief content creators, guiding hooks, pacing, and messaging to make
sure UGC and video ads land the strategy on camera
- Analyze the performance of live campaigns and creatives against KPIs, turning results into concrete
learnings for the next round of testing
- Track competitor and category creative trends across channels, including where creative fatigue is
setting in
- Work with the performance marketing team on incrementality and lift testing to figure out how much of a
result actually came from the creative versus targeting or bidding
- Keep an eye on new and emerging ad channels, and make the call on when it's worth building creative
strategy for one
- Build and maintain a framework connecting creative variables (hook type, format, messaging angle) to
CTR, CVR, CAC, and ROAS
- Deliver clear, actionable reports for stakeholders

Required Qualifications
- 3+ years in creative strategy, performance marketing, or similar, with ownership over the strategy, ideally
in B2C or D2C ecommerce
- Hands-on understanding of how platforms like Meta Advantage+ and Google Performance Max actually
score, learn from, and prioritize creative assets
- Strong portfolio or case studies demonstrating strategic thinking behind creative campaigns
- Solid grasp of creative testing methodology: statistical significance, test design, and knowing when a test
is underpowered
- Comfortable working directly with performance data (CTR, CVR, CAC, ROAS, frequency) to make and
defend creative decisions, and willing to drop a “great idea” when the numbers say otherwise
- English fluency required, with German being an added advantage

Preferred Qualifications
- Background in consumer electronics, gaming, or creator-economy brands
- Experience briefing and directing UGC creators
- Proven track record handling mid-to-high six-figure budgets and delivering strong ROI
- Fluent in the current AI creative toolkit (generative image/video, dubbing/localization) and AI-powered
bidding — enough to brief, direct, and quality-check the work, not necessarily to operate every tool
- Solid understanding of attribution, conversion tracking, and first-party data strategies

Who You Are
- You think about creatives systematically with a framework behind it. When someone asks why a piece of
creative is winning, your answer starts with a number. You're fine being the person who has to explain why
a test result doesn't mean what everyone in the room assumes it means. When AI can generate fifty
variants in an afternoon, you're the one who knows which three are actually worth running and which
ideas aren't worth making at all.

What's in It for You
- Ownership over the creative strategy for campaigns with meaningful budget and visibility across the
business
- Elgato is genuinely open to experimentation. We back bold ideas and aren't afraid to go a little off-script
when it makes sense.
- Our products are used and loved by millions of creators around the world.
- You'll be part of a well-resourced team within the Corsair Group, while still working at the speed of a
brand that moves like a startup.
- Competitive package, hybrid working in Munich, and gear discounts you'll actually use

jobs.title: AI Native Creative Strategist - EdTech (French fluent )
jobs.description:
**What if your next playground was to build a global, iconic Brand, with a creative machine that never sleeps, and compounds?**

Then you’ll love this.

We’re not looking for a "Social Media Manager" to follow a calendar. We’re looking for an AI-native Creative Strategist (Brand & Content).

Someone who understands that to win today, you don’t just need "content", you need a Movement.

**This isn’t another content job.** Most content teams use AI to write captions faster. That’s the 99%. We want to be in the 0.1%: a media where AI runs the creative loop, from the signal to the hook, the cut, the post and the lesson. Every day, on every platform, in French and in English. You bring the taste. The machine you build brings the scale.

Here’s the bet: a company that learns by itself grows in a way a company of people alone can’t. We aim for $10M in revenue with 10 people, each of them running a dozen agents.

**WHAT AI-NATIVE CONTENT MEANS AT PARADOX**
-------------------------------------------

Paradoxically, the more AI runs our content, the more human it has to feel. AI doesn’t make more of what everyone makes. It makes more of what only we can make.

Our creative machine has to be able to:

**1. Read the signals.** Comments, DMs, retention graphs, saves, shares, search trends, objections from sales calls, and what the best creators and advertisers in the world are publishing right now.

**2. Hold the full context of Paradox.** Our DNA, years of interviews, lives and courses, member stories, and every past post with what it taught us, in one shared company brain.

**3. Generate in our voice.** Hooks, scripts, shorts, carousels, cuts, thumbnails and captions, in French and in English.

**4. Ship.** Format, schedule, publish and answer, on every platform.

**5. Measure with real KPIs.** Retention, shares, saves, follower growth, and the followers who become leads and members. Not likes.

**6. Learn and loop on its own.** Double down on what works, kill what doesn’t, write the lesson back into the brain, and start the next cycle without waiting for a meeting.

This is already real. An ads library of thousands of creatives feeds our creative research. Agents cut ads from long-form content and wire Instagram comment-to-DM automations. And our product is AI-native too: Athena, our AI coach, works with members every day.

**OUR MISSION**
---------------

At Paradox, we are convinced that greatness is trainable, and we believe self-help is broken.

Most learning platforms are used the same way: consuming generic theories, getting quick highs, ending with no real change.

People deserve more: a system that knows them, one that adapts, challenges, and grows with them.

That’s why we want to empower people at scale, by leveraging cutting edge technologies like AI, and crafting user experiences with outstanding aesthetics.

We do that by merging:

* Human Intelligence (coaches, peers, and mentors)
* Structured Intelligence (protocols, mental models, rituals)
* Technological Intelligence (AI personalization, feedback loops, adaptive journeys)

To create one seamless ecosystem: Paradox OS.

**Short history**

Paradox was founded by David Laroche, a creator followed by over 2 million people and known for his interviews with icons like Tony Parker, Mike Horn, Richard Branson and Gad Elmaleh. We started in French. We’re building for the world.

**YOUR MISSION**
----------------

You lead the Content Factory not by management, but with creativity.

Your goal is to produce content that is so good, unique, and aligned with our values that people would cry if they had to unsubscribe.

In a classic content team, people do the work and AI helps. Here it’s the other way round: agents do the volume, you design the machine, set the bar and make the calls. Humans do what no machine can: taste.

**YOUR 5 MAIN MISSIONS**
------------------------

### **1. Architect the "Dual-Brand" Strategy**

* Build a symbiotic strategy where David Laroche’s personal brand and Paradox’s company brand reinforce each other without cannibalization.
* Implement radical new formats (documentaries, conceptual shorts) that shatter the boring codes of the "Self-Help" industry.
* Define distinct, sharp editorial lines for each platform: Depth & Search for YouTube, Aesthetic & Vibe for Instagram, and Authority & Authenticity for LinkedIn.
* The old way: a strategy deck written once a year, and a calendar filled by habit.
* At Paradox: agents watch every platform, every competitor and every comment continuously. They tell you which angle is rising, which format is tiring and which story our audience asks for. The strategy updates every week, on evidence.

### **2. Radical Concepting & End-to-End Delivery**

* Take responsibility for the entire production chain from hooks to storyboarding the narrative, and ensuring the final cut matches the vision.
* Own the packaging: titles, thumbnails and the first 3 seconds. You test variants every week and know your click-through and retention numbers by heart.
* Deliver what you pitch.
* The old way: one shoot becomes one video and a handful of posts.
* At Paradox: one shoot, one live or one interview becomes dozens of hooks, shorts, carousels and ad cuts by the next morning, in both languages. Concepts are tested with AI-generated drafts before we spend a day shooting them.

### **3. Build the Content Factory: humans and agents**

* Your taste becomes the eval. You write down what makes a great hook, a great cut, a great carousel and a great story, in rules and examples the agents check themselves against. Each time you reject something, the reason goes back into the rules.
* Act as the final quality check: nothing gets published if it doesn’t meet the "Paradox Standard" of aesthetics and storytelling, whether a person or an agent made it.
* The old way: a creative team briefs an editor, waits three days and gets two versions.
* At Paradox: agents draft, cut, caption, translate and schedule. You keep

Description: 
 PETA’s Video Lab is a team of creative problem-solvers and storytellers behind some of the organization’s most talked-about animal rights videos on social media. From provocative, hilarious content that taps into the cultural conversation to emotionally powerful stories that motivate people to act, the Video Lab creates work that consistently cuts through the noise. Videos produced by PETA’s Video Lab generate roughly 100 million views each year, offering an extraordinary opportunity to experiment with emerging creative technology and make work that has a meaningful impact on animals.


  Position Description:


 PETA’s social channels reach millions of people every week—and this role sits at the center of that impact. As an AI Creative Producer — Social Video, you’ll create visually striking, culturally relevant, and emotionally powerful videos for PETA’s social platforms, with a strong emphasis on AI-assisted animation, original visual storytelling, and self-filmed content.


 Your work will help make PETA’s animal liberation message compelling, shareable, and impossible to ignore—whether through humor and provocative commentary or powerful stories that build empathy for animals and inspire people to take action.


 We’re looking for a highly creative, chronically online producer with strong creative instincts and a genuine connection to PETA’s mission. You should be excited to experiment with emerging AI tools and develop work that can be bold, funny, unexpected, heartbreaking, or moving, all via a new creative medium. Above all, you should understand that technology is a tool for telling great stories and helping people see animals as individuals.


  Position Objective:


 Leverage AI tools to create bold content, appear on camera, create skits, commentary, explanatory videos, and more


  Primary Responsibilities and Duties:


 
  Create high-impact videos for Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, X, YouTube, and emerging social channels, from concept through final delivery
  Develop scripts and creative concepts that balance humor, cultural relevance, emotional resonance, and provocative storytelling
  Use AI tools such as Midjourney, Runway, Higgsfield, Veo, and similar platforms to create animations, characters, visual effects, and other elements that elevate storytelling
  Experiment with emerging AI-powered video, animation, and creative technologies to develop innovative content and formats
  Combine AI-generated elements with traditional editing, animation, self-shot footage, and other production techniques to create the strongest possible story
  Create characters for comedic skits, commentary, explanatory videos, and other original formats that bring PETA’s bold and distinctive voice to life
  Develop emotionally compelling stories that build empathy for animals, help audiences see them as individuals, and motivate people to take action
  Self-film content when needed, using an iPhone or similar equipment, taking ownership of lighting, sound, props, set design, and overall production quality
  Direct and produce formal shoots as needed
  Collaborate closely with Video Lab team members and the social media team to develop timely, engaging content
  Ensure all video content meets quality standards and complies with legal and brand guidelines
  Stay current on social media trends, platform updates, internet culture, and advancements in AI creative tools
  Requirements: 
 
  Degree in a related field, relevant professional experience, or a portfolio demonstrating exceptional creative ability

  Demonstrated experience using AI tools for video generation, animation, visual effects, or video enhancement
  Strong understanding of visual storytelling and all stages of video production, from concept development through post-production
  Excellent video-editing skills using Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, CapCut, or comparable tools
  Familiarity with video, lighting, and photography equipment
  Excellent creative instincts and enthusiasm for bold, unconventional ideas, balanced with the judgment and empathy needed to tell sensitive and emotionally powerful stories
  Strong understanding of social media and what makes audiences stop, watch, feel, and share
  Curiosity about emerging creative technology and enthusiasm for experimenting with new tools and techniques
  Knowledge of animal rights issues and familiarity with PETA campaigns preferred
  Professional appearance and commitment to a healthy vegan lifestyle
  Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills

For photographers, visual storytellers, art directors, and creative minds shaping the future of AI.



Aurify LLC — part of a global technology community with 60+ million followers worldwide — is looking for exceptional creative minds to help redefine how people create, transform, and experience photography with artificial intelligence.



We're not building another image generator. We're building a technology that understands why images matter — the emotion, meaning, composition, and creative decisions behind a photograph — so that millions of people can become part of extraordinary visual experiences.



This is not a traditional design role. This is a chance to help build the future of photography in the age of AI.



About The Project: Character Transfer

Unlike traditional face-swap technology, we're not just replacing one face with another.



We're building a system that understands the complete visual story of an image — why a moment feels special, what emotion it communicates, what makes the composition powerful, and what must stay unchanged for the image to keep its meaning.



The goal: when a new person enters an existing scene, it should feel as if they were truly there when the photograph was taken.



Not inserted. Not copied. Belonging.



Who We're Looking For

We need a rare combination of creative intelligence and technical curiosity — someone who sees beyond pixels and can read the emotional core, hidden story, and creative intention behind a photograph.



You may come from photography, filmmaking, advertising, fashion, VFX, digital production, or creative technology. Your background matters less than your ability to understand visual language.



Your Mission

You'll help build the intelligence behind our Character Transfer Engine, focused on three areas.



1. Teaching AI to Understand Visual Stories




Every photograph has creative DNA.
For each template, you'll define:
the story being told
its emotional purpose
the relationship between people and environment
visual hierarchy
what must be preserved
what can adapt


Example




A romantic image isn't just "two people looking at each other" — its true value is connection, anticipation, vulnerability, intimacy, trust.
A travel image isn't just "someone near a landmark" — it's discovery, freedom, adventure, achievement, memory.
AI has to understand that difference.


2. Designing Scalable AI Creative Systems

We're not looking for someone who manually perfects one beautiful image — anyone can do that.



We need people who can help build a system that delivers consistently excellent results across:

thousands of templates




millions of users
every age
every appearance
every body type
every culture
every photography condition


You'll contribute to:




AI workflow design
creative instructions
prompt architecture
transformation logic
quality standards
edge-case analysis
evaluation frameworks


3. Evaluating AI Results Through a Creative Lens

You'll help define what high quality really means by evaluating whether results preserve:




Identity — does the person still feel authentic?
Story — do they naturally belong in the scene?
Emotion — does their expression and body language match the moment?
Physical Reality — lighting, shadows, perspective, camera characteristics, skin texture, anatomy, natural imperfections
Artistic Value — does this look like a real moment that actually happened?


Ideal Background (One or More)

Photography & Visual Storytelling

Professional, commercial, or fashion photographers, photo editors, creative/art directors, cinematographers who understand composition, lighting, emotion, directing people, and visual communication.



Advertising, Fashion & Brand Creative

Experience with advertising campaigns, fashion or luxury brands, creative studios, or commercial productions.

You know great images don't just look beautiful — they communicate ideas.



VFX & Digital Production

Compositing, CGI, motion design, digital production pipelines.

Especially valuable: experience maintaining visual quality across large-scale production.



AI Creative Technology

AI image generation/editing workflows, multimodal AI systems, diffusion models, ComfyUI workflows, advanced prompting, creative automation.

Note: pure prompt-writing experience alone isn't enough — we need people who understand visual intelligence.



What Makes Someone Exceptional Here




The strongest candidates think in multiple dimensions at once.
A photographer asks: "Why does this image create emotion?"
A filmmaker asks: "What story is happening in this moment?"
An art director asks: "What should the audience feel?"
A technologist asks: "How can we make this repeatable at scale?"
The ideal person combines all four.


Who This Role Isn't For

This isn't for someone who only creates attractive AI images or experiments with prompts, or who optimizes a single result manually.



We're looking for people who understand creativity, build systems, and help AI learn the principles behind great photography.



Hiring Challenge

Candidates may be asked to analyze a collection of original photo templates and explain:




what makes each image emotionally powerful
the core story of the image
which elements must be preserved vs. adapted
how to design a system capable of maintaining quality across 500+ different people
The goal isn't one impressive image — it's designing the thinking behind thousands of successful ones.


Why Join Aurify

Your work will be experienced by a global audience of 60+ million people, shaping how they create, share, and experience visual memories.



Most AI tools today generate images from text.



We're building something fundamentally different:



A system that understands existing human creativity and lets anyone become part of meaningful visual stories.



You'll help define how AI understands:




human emotion
visual storytelling
photography
identi

At Forbes Advisor, our mission is to help readers turn their aspirations into reality. We arm people with trusted advice and guidance so they can make informed decisions they feel confident in and get back to doing the things they care about most.

We are an experienced team of industry experts dedicated to helping readers make smart decisions and choose the right products with ease. Forbes Advisor boasts decades of experience across dozens of geographies and teams, including Content, SEO, Business Intelligence, Finance, HR, Marketing, Production, Technology and Sales. The team brings rich industry knowledge to Forbes Advisor's global coverage of consumer credit, debt, health, home improvement, banking, investing, credit cards, small business, education, insurance, loans, real estate and travel.

Forbes Advisor is hiring an AI Creative Lead to own the generative stack that turns approved scripts and storyboards into finished, on-brand video and static ads. This person is two things at once: a creative with a deep understanding of direct-response marketing, and a hands-on operator who lives in the AI tools daily. You run the back half of our pipeline, from character-locked stills through AI video, lip-sync, and voiceover to editor-ready footage, and you treat every step as a creative call as much as a technical one: what serves the story, what sells, and what will read as a real ad in the feed.

The role reports into the Head of Creative Production and partners with our Creative Directors and Editor/Designers. You know what makes a DR ad work, the hook, the pacing, the proof, and the turn to the offer, and you know which model(s) to use and why. You can hold character, wardrobe, and continuity across a whole spot, debug a broken render instead of re-rolling, and get renders through touchy platform filters. Responsibilities



Own generation end-to-end for paid social and native creative: character-locked stills, AI video, lip-sync, and clean generated voiceover, from approved script and storyboard to editor-ready footage. Lock base characters first, then build a still per beat that references them, holding character, wardrobe, prop, and continuity consistency across an entire spot. Pick the right model for each job (hero vs. volume, native-audio vs. img-to-video) and keep a live view of a fast-moving tool stack, pinning exact model versions at build time. Scout, test, and onboard new models and tools as the stack evolves, and retire the ones that fall behind, so the team is always working with the best available. Get renders through platform and category filters. Diagnose and auto-fix a broken render once, then escalate, and keep a running swipe of safe phrasings and prompt patterns that pass. Operate and lightly orchestrate the tooling (fan-out, scheduling, asset movement) so many jobs run in parallel without a person babysitting each one. Own the generative-side handoff into post: deliver organized, tagged, editor-ready clips into the DAM to the production team's standards. Feed the shared learnings file (format, copy, render, and legal notes per job) and read it back at the next job's start so the system compounds instead of repeating mistakes. Partner with the Creative Directors and copywriters to keep generated output on-voice, on-persona, and matched beat-for-beat to the script (AV sync). Bring a direct-response creative eye to every job: push each render toward what sells, the hook, the pacing, the proof, and the turn to the offer, not just what looks good. Operate inside compliance rails for our regulated categories: no better-drug or results claims, coverage/qualify framing, required disclosures, and honest routing. Hold generation to the same gate as the rest of the pipeline. Manage generative tooling spend against render volume, and give the Head of Creative Production a real monthly cost model as volume scales. Build reusable assets (prompt libraries, character references, templates, and workflow docs) that let editors and strategists self-serve the routine work. 

Requirements

4+ years in creative production, motion, VFX, or content, with at least the last 1 to 2 years hands-on in generative AI video and image production for real deliverables. A real grounding in direct-response creative. You understand how a DR ad is built (hook, problem, mechanism, proof, offer, and CTA) and can judge whether a cut will convert, not only whether it looks polished. Demonstrated generative craft: a reel or portfolio of AI-generated or AI-assisted video and stills, with an honest account of what you made vs. what the model made, and (ideally) how it performed. Deep, current fluency with the generative stack: multi-subject-consistency image models, AI video (native-audio and img-to-video), lip-sync, and AI voiceover. You have opinions on trade-offs, not just tool names. Character and continuity discipline: you can hold a consistent character across many shots and beats, not just generate one good frame. Prompt and troubleshooting fluency: you can diagnose why a render broke or a character drifted and fix it deliberately, rather than re-rolling until something lands. Comfort building light automation/orchestration around the tools (e.g. n8n, Gumloop, or comparable) to fan out and move assets. You don't need to be an engineer, but you're not afraid of the glue. A finishing eye: you know when AI output reads as a real ad vs. a tech demo, and you hold the line on craft. Demonstrated speed and volume in a performance, DR, or high-output content environment. jobs.title: AI Creative Technologist (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Voy is a healthcare platform led by clinicians. We support people managing long-term health conditions with treatment plans backed by real evidence.

Founded in 2018, we started as MANUAL, focusing on hair loss, weight loss and men’s health. As we grew, we realised we could help more people. In 2025, we became Voy and expanded into more areas of health, including female hair loss, testosterone, menopause, dermatology and diagnostics with Do Health.

Today, Voy has around 750,000 active customers and has treated more than 2 million people since we began. We work across the UK, Germany, Brazil and India to make a new future of healthcare a reality. We’re approaching $1bn in ARR and have grown more than 100% year on year, every year since inception. At Voy, we let the evidence do the talking. In a published study of over 100,000 people, those who reached 12 months in the Voy programme and stayed engaged lost up to 24% of their body weight.

Our vision is simple: to make 100 years of healthy living within reach for everybody. Our mission is to bring quality care to everyone, at scale.

As our AI Creative Technologist, you drive the visual world of our brands across our digital channels (web, CRM and paid social), including product and lifestyle imagery for both Derma and Weight Loss. You also design and build the AI-native production pipelines that let us produce on-brand work at the speed our growth needs. You are a hybrid of creative and engineer: someone with strong visual taste and judgment who uses AI to explore more and ship faster, and who builds pipelines rather than just writing prompts, without letting the work look generic.

This is a new role for the company. As you automate repetitive production work, you will help us rethink how responsibilities are shared across the team.

You will work closely with Brand, Performance Marketing and CRM, with a clear say on quality and compliance for AI-assisted work. Success means faster concept-to-launch, more assets from fewer hours, and consistently on-brand quality.

What You'll Be Doing

Digital Brand Systems: Build and maintain the expression of the FORMEL SKIN and VOY brands: components, templates, imagery and motion principles that carry our core identity into all digital channels, and keep both brands distinct, premium and consistent.
AI-Native Production Pipelines & Workflows: Design, document and maintain repeatable workflows for imagery, copy variants, resizing, versioning and localisation across channels and markets. This includes style references, prompt libraries, templates and, where it makes sense, brand-conditioned models, so machines and teammates can execute against our guidelines.
Build end-to-end pipelines (not just prompts) that connect tools such as Claude and Figma, so one approved campaign creative can be reproduced in many variants, formats and languages. Extend these pipelines to AI video and motion content, avoiding "AI slop".
Quality Standards & Review: Define the quality bar and review standards for digital and AI-generated creative (including typography and packaging details, which AI often gets wrong), and review AI, agency and non-designer work against it, including whether agency work is compliant. Partner with the brand and creative team on campaign direction, while you own the standards and guardrails for digital and AI-assisted production.
Concept to Launch, Fast: Turn campaign and launch concepts, including the creative team's, into launch-ready digital assets quickly, with many directions and variants to test across paid social, CRM and web.
Enablement: Turn your workflows into tools and templates that can be used by the whole marketing team (not only Brand), so people become more self-sufficient, and train the team to use them.
Creative Testing & Performance: Use campaign data and customer insight to decide which directions to push, refine or retire, working closely with the Paid team to produce many variants and learn from them. Build lightweight testing tools (concept scoring, variant testing, dashboards) to judge whether creatives work before and after launch.
Tool Scouting: Track the AI creative stack, test new tools critically and recommend what we adopt or skip.
Compliance & Responsible Use: Work with Legal and Regulatory teams to define where AI may be used and where we are limited in using it, and build those rules into the workflows. Act as the internal owner of these rules and keep them up to date as regulation changes.

What You Need To Shine

5+ years of professional experience working in agencies, AI content/video platforms or in-house creative teams, preferably with a background in creative technology or design systems, ideally in lifestyle consumer, beauty, e-commerce or health brands, with a portfolio that shows premium craft and strong taste. The work has to look good as design, not just "good for AI".
Deep fundamentals in typography, colour, composition, photography and imagery, layout and brand systems, and the ability to explain creative decisions.
Expert-level proficiency in AI image generation, with production-quality work to show, including prompting, reference and image-to-image workflows, editing and upscaling, ideally from replacing traditional photo or content production with AI-generated imagery. Docplanner's Paid Marketing team - a B2B function focused on acquiring doctors and clinics - is looking for a Senior Specialist in Creative Strategy & Performance to own the full creative lifecycle for paid media: from strategy and briefing, through asset production management, to performance intelligence and testing. This is a hybrid strategist/operator role - half creative thinking, half process and data discipline.

You'll be the bridge between performance data and creative output - turning what's working (and what isn't) across our nine markets into sharper briefs, faster production cycles, and a continuously improving testing roadmap.

We are looking for a person with a Performance Marketing background that has hands-on experience in campaigns management and targets delivery. If you are a performance marketer who loves testing and can turn insights into repeatable creative performance, read on!

How will you make an impact?

Creative Strategy

Define the creative strategy and testing roadmap for paid campaigns across all markets and ad platforms, aligned with performance goals
Translate campaign objectives and audience insights into clear, actionable briefs
Partner with local market teams to adapt global creative direction to local nuances - language, culture, and regulatory requirements

Build and maintain a repeatable process - briefing templates, naming conventions, approval workflows - to reduce bottlenecks and rework

Creative Intelligence & Testing

Run structured A/B and multivariate tests across Meta and other paid channels, defining hypotheses, success metrics, and test cadence
Build creative performance reporting (Meta Ads, Tableau, Amplitude) that identifies which elements - format, hook, messaging, visual style - drive results

Tracking & Measurement

Ensure creative-level tracking is implemented and tagged correctly, in partnership with the tracking/tech team, so performance can be attributed accurately

Team Flexibility

4+ years in performance marketing with a proven track record in creative strategy, or a media buying background with hands-on experience in paid social creative (Meta Ads required; TikTok, Google, LinkedIn, or Bing a plus)

Demonstrated experience managing creative production across multiple stakeholders - designers, agencies, local teams - at scale
Strong analytical skills - comfortable pulling and interpreting creative performance data independently, not relying on assumptions

Strong project management and cross-functional communication skills - this role touches Paid Ads, Design, Local Marketing, and Data Analytics teams
Fluent English required; Spanish and/or Portuguese a strong plus given our market footprint
Comfortable operating across multiple markets and cultures simultaneously

Familiarity with Amplitude, Tableau, or HubSpot or Creative Intelligence tools
Experience with creative automation or dynamic creative optimization (DCO) tools
Background in healthcare, marketplace, or subscription business models

Usersnap is building AI-driven capabilities into the core of the product, from automated setup to intelligent surveys, contextual analysis, and reporting that generates itself based on connectors. We're looking for a hands-on AI Lead / Engineering Manager to lead the small engineering team that ships these capabilities, and to set the technical direction while doing it.

This is a player-coach role. You'll write and review code, make architecture calls, and define what "good" looks like for AI-native development. You'll also own team coordination, delivery timelines, workload allocation, and follow-through, so that work planned is work shipped, reliably and at production quality.

This is a full-time, engineering-led role. It is not combined with product management: the technical leadership scope is substantial on its own, and you'll partner with Product rather than absorb it.

AI capability is becoming core to Usersnap's product and go-to-market, especially as we move upmarket. You'll be the person who makes sure it ships well.

- Brand and corporate communications

- Presentations and pitch decks

- Video, motion graphics, and short-form content

Generative AI

Professional Creative Tools
