jobs.title: Creative Strategist
jobs.description:
Creative Strategist (French & English), Dubai, on-site

Short is a creative agency specialised in short-form video. We create content and campaigns for brands: performance ads, brand and awareness campaigns, product and venue launches, organic content. We find the idea, write it, shoot it and measure what it does. Our team in France doubles in size every year, and we are now building our Dubai team.
Our Dubai clients are French-speaking founders and international brands, and our core team works in French. Fluent French and fluent English are both mandatory for this role.

The role in one sentence

You own a portfolio of client accounts end to end: you build the creative strategy, produce the concepts and scripts for both performance and brand campaigns, lead the client relationship, and make the client want to renew.

What you will do

Build the creative strategy for each client, whatever the goal: sales, awareness, a brand campaign, a product or venue launch, organic growth.
Produce the creative: concepts, scripts, shooting briefs and iterations, for ads as well as brand and social content.
Read results across channels (Meta, TikTok, YouTube, organic) and turn them into the next creative decision.
Lead the client: run their meetings, present results, and defend your creative choices.
Manage your batches: keep statuses up to date and deliver concepts and scripts within 3 business days.
Drive renewals: client re-engagement is the number one KPI of our creative team.

You report to Julien, our Head of Creative. On every account you work with a Project Manager, who runs production, and an Account Manager, who handles the commercial side (contract, negotiation, upsell).

What success looks like after 12 months

You run a portfolio of around 10 accounts.
50% or more of your clients renew.
100% of your batches are delivered on time.

Must-haves

Professional or native French and English, written and spoken.
Real experience in creative strategy, content or campaigns, agency or brand side. Show us results: reach, spend, ROAS, launch numbers, volume of content produced.
You can create beyond paid ads: brand campaigns, awareness campaigns, launches, social content.
You have written scripts in volume: ads, social videos, brand films.
At ease with data and ad platforms (Meta Business Manager, TikTok Ads Manager): you read results and turn them into a decision.
You use AI tools in your daily workflow.
You can lead a client call on your own and defend a creative choice against the client's opinion.
Based in Dubai (or relocating), and happy to work on-site in a fast, high-volume startup environment.

Nice to have

Accounts spending more than $50,000 per month.
A brand, product or venue launch you led from idea to results.
You have turned around a difficult client situation: an unhappy client won back, or an account relaunched after a drop.
Experience in sectors we work with: real estate, e-commerce, SaaS/apps, hospitality, info products.
Hands-on content skills: directing on set, framing, editing basics.

What does not matter to us

Your degree, or your number of years for its own sake. What matters is that your ideas deliver, whether the goal is sales, awareness or a launch.

What this role is not

It is not a project management role. You will not chase production teams: you think, write, analyse and lead the client.

What we offer

A full-time position in Dubai, on-site with the team, with your UAE work visa sponsored.
Open to freelance profiles too: tell us in your application.
A package defined with you, based on your level.
Real ownership of your accounts in an agency that doubles every year.

Our hiring process (about 2 weeks)

Application review
45-min video interview
Live case study: you get 72 hours to prepare, then present it on a 45-min call
Reference calls
1-hour final interview on-site in Dubai with Clément Vannier, General Manager of Short Dubai
Decision and offer

How to apply

Apply with Easy Apply and answer the screening questions. Add to your CV or message a link to ads you have scripted or strategised. A short video introduction is a real plus.

jobs.title: Lead Digital Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Job Purpose

We are looking for a Lead Digital Marketing Manager to join our Marketing team and play a key role in shaping how we invest, measure and maximise the impact of our paid media spend.

As a Lead Digital Marketing Manager, you will take ownership of Ounass's cross-channel paid media investment strategy, ensuring our marketing budgets are allocated effectively to drive sustainable growth, customer acquisition and commercial performance.

Reporting to the Director of Marketing, you will be responsible for defining budget allocation frameworks, establishing measurement standards, leading incrementality testing and owning the paid media forecast across our six GCC markets.

Working closely with our Paid Search, Paid Social, Influencer Marketing and other channel leads, you will set the investment direction, performance expectations and measurement frameworks that guide their execution.

This is a highly analytical and commercially focused role requiring someone who can translate complex marketing data into clear investment decisions, challenge existing measurement approaches and confidently present recommendations to senior leadership and Finance.

What You'll Be Doing

Paid Media Investment & Budget Allocation

Own and manage the cross-channel paid media budget across Paid Search, Paid Social, Display, Programmatic, Affiliates and Influencer Marketing, covering the UAE, KSA, Kuwait, Qatar, Oman and Bahrain.
Define investment allocation frameworks, marginal efficiency targets, growth expectations and customer acquisition cost (CAC) thresholds to guide channel-level decisions.
Lead the budget reallocation process through weekly pacing reviews, monthly investment rebalancing and quarterly resets aligned with business forecasts.
Analyse channel and market performance to identify opportunities to optimise investment, improve returns and support business growth.
Partner with Finance and Retail Media to distinguish brand-funded investment from Ounass-funded spend, ensuring accurate reporting of Net DM.
Balance short-term performance efficiency with longer-term upper-funnel investment, assessing the commercial impact, expected returns and payback periods.
Apply marginal economics and diminishing-returns analysis to inform investment decisions across performance marketing channels.

Marketing Measurement & Incrementality

Establish and own the measurement framework used to evaluate paid media performance and guide budget allocation decisions.
Lead the incrementality testing programme across key marketing channels, including geo holdout experiments, conversion lift studies and other testing methodologies.
Partner with BI and Data teams to design experiments, interpret results and translate findings into actionable investment recommendations.
Own the application and interpretation of Marketing Mix Modelling (MMM) insights, identifying opportunities to improve channel allocation and overall marketing effectiveness.
Bring together insights from platform attribution, GA4, app measurement platforms such as Adjust, and MMM to create a consistent view of marketing performance.
Develop and interpret diminishing-returns curves across channels and markets to understand where additional investment generates incremental value.
Work with Technology, BI and Data teams to ensure measurement accuracy across server-side tracking, consent management, app attribution and SKAdNetwork.
Challenge attribution discrepancies and investigate data quality issues that could affect investment decisions.

Forecasting & Strategic Planning

Own the weekly, monthly and annual paid media forecasts across channels and markets, with accountability for forecast accuracy.
Lead the paid media planning process, providing accurate investment assumptions and performance projections for annual budgets and business reforecasts.
Build investment scenarios that demonstrate the commercial impact of increasing, reducing or reallocating marketing budgets.
Work with channel leads to establish market and channel-level performance targets aligned with overall business objectives.
Partner closely with Finance to ensure marketing forecasts are commercially sound, measurable and aligned with business planning.
Present and defend investment recommendations, forecasts and assumptions to senior leadership.

Performance Reporting & Commercial Insights

Own the paid media performance narrative for the VP Marketing, Finance and other key stakeholders, clearly communicating performance drivers, risks and recommended actions.
Partner with BI to develop a consistent source of truth for marketing performance reporting, reducing fragmented reporting and ensuring alignment across teams.
Translate complex performance data into clear, actionable recommendations that support investment and commercial decisions.
Provide category-level and brand-level investment insights to Commercial and Retail Media teams.
Support key trading moments, including Ramadan, Eid, private sales and peak trading periods, through investment planning, performance analysis and forecasting.
Develop concise, decision-focused reporting that allows leadership and channel teams to act quickly and confidently.

AI, Automation & Marketing Effectiveness

Identify opportunities to automate performance reporting, budget pacing alerts, forecasting and investment allocation recommendations.
Use AI and automation tools to improve analytical efficiency, streamline workflows and reduce manual reporting.
Establish appropriate guardrails and measurement frameworks for platform-led automation, assessing performance against manual approaches.
Continuously explore emerging technologies, analytical tools and measurement methodologies to improve marketing effectiveness.
Measure and demonstrate the efficiency gains achieved through AI and automation.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Governance

Work closely with channel leads, Finance, BI, Data, Growth, Commercial and Retail Media teams to ensure alignment on investment priorities and performance expectations.
Manage and coordinate measurement initiatives involving Marketing Mix Modelling, lift studies and external marketing platform measurement teams.
Establish and document clear standards for budget allocation, experiment design, forecasting and reporting.
Ensure marketing investment decisions remain aligned with Ounass's luxury positioning, brand standards and long-term business objectives.
Challenge investment opportunities or placements that may deliver short-term efficiency but compromise brand perception.

What We're Looking For

Experience & Expertise

8+ years of experience in performance marketing, with proven ownership of significant multi-channel paid media budgets, ideally within a scaled e-commerce or consumer business.
Strong experience developing cross-channel investment strategies, allocating budgets across markets and demonstrating measurable commercial returns.
Proven hands-on experience designing, evaluating and acting on incrementality studies, including geo holdouts and conversion lift experiments.
Experience working with Marketing Mix Models (MMM), interpreting model outputs, challenging assumptions and translating findings into investment decisions.
Demonstrated ownership of marketing forecasts, with accountability for forecast accuracy and commercial performance.
Strong analytical capabilities, including proficiency in SQL and a solid understanding of statistical testing, sample size, statistical power, significance and experiment design.
Working knowledge of GA4, mobile measurement platforms such as Adjust or AppsFlyer, including SKAdNetwork, and BI tools such as Tableau or Looker.
Hands-on experience with Google Ads and Meta at scale, alongside a strong understanding of Snapchat and TikTok advertising platforms.
Ability to challenge channel-level bidding strategies, campaign structures, attribution methodologies and optimisation approaches.
Experience managing investment across multiple markets, ideally including KSA and UAE, with exposure to both web and app performance.
Strong commercial understanding of key marketing and business metrics, including GMV, CAC, customer lifetime value (CLV), contribution margin, marginal returns and payback periods.
Experience partnering with Finance, Commercial, BI and Data teams to support investment decisions and business planning.
Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to translate complex analysis into clear recommendations for senior leadership.
Practical experience using AI tools to improve productivity, automate analysis and deliver measurable efficiencies.
A degree in Marketing, Economics, Statistics or another quantitative discipline, or equivalent professional experience.

It Would Be Great If You Also Have

Experience within luxury, fashion, beauty or premium e-commerce, particularly across GCC markets.
Arabic language skills and a strong understanding of UAE and KSA consumer behaviour.
Proficiency in Python or R, alongside exposure to modern data environments such as dbt, Athena or BigQuery.
Experience building dashboards and analytical reporting solutions in Tableau, Looker or Looker Studio.
Experience preparing structured investment recommendations and decision documents for senior leadership.
Exposure to brand-funded marketing, co-op investment, Retail Media or partner-funded advertising, including reporting and commercial accountability.

creative direction, research, angles and briefing across your assigned accounts.

the standard of what ships — briefs that are clear and on-strategy, with authority to send back work that isn't right.

making sure creative decisions are shaped by what the data says is working and failing, in partnership with Growth.

planning, launching and learning from tests, so every iteration is intentional and learnings are captured.

briefs moving cleanly through to production, working directly with editors, designers and coordinators, on time.

building and improving the tools that make creative work faster and better.

dig into brands, audiences, competitor ads, customer reviews and cultural trends to find new angles and opportunities.

spot what's already working in an account and reuse, adapt or combine assets into fresh variations.

manage timelines with editors and designers so work is delivered on time and to a high standard.

capture what works into repeatable frameworks, briefs and SOPs in Notion.

AI ability - you've built or used AI tools to speed up real work & create leverage for yourself
Clear, confident communication with both clients and teammates
Organisation and reliability across multiple projects and deadlines

led by performance insight — testing is structured, learnings are captured, and iterations have a reason.
A smooth creative workflow
— briefs and feedback are clear and actionable, and revisions are kept to a minimum.
Better ads, better accounts
— your creative measurably improves performance over time, which means happy clients.
This role is ideal for someone who wants to work with fast-growing DTC brands and take pride in ads people actually want to watch.

Твоя місія:

Створювати постери, які піднімають CTR історій у каталозі: яскраві, контрастні, з центрованою композицією, що читається в маленькому розмірі на темному фоні.
Доводити AI-генерації до фінальної якості: ретуш, виправлення анатомії й артефактів, Face Swap, світло, кольорокорекція, upscale. Сирі AI-картинки в роботу не йдуть.
Розробляти Title Design і композицію постера так, щоб назва й арт читалися разом
Тримати консистентність героя й локації на основі наданих матеріалів серіалу
Генерувати кілька варіантів і A/B-гіпотез на один постер, обговорювати разом з креативною та продуктовою командою і швидко вносити коригування.

Початковий темп роботи — 3–6 постерів на тиждень.

___________________________________________________________________________

Для цього знадобляться такі навички та досвід:

Просунутий AI-промптинг і генерація (Midjourney, Krea, Higgsfield, Leonardo) — точні промпти під емоцію, композицію, план і кінематографічне світло з перших ітерацій. Уміння витягати фотореалізм із сучасних моделей (Nano Banana, Seedream тощо).
Глибоке володіння Adobe Photoshop — маски, колажування, детальна ретуш, виправлення AI-артефактів і анатомії, Face Swap, кольорокорекція.
Title Design і типографіка — виразні, читабельні назви й текстові плашки, які гармонують із фоновим артом.
Розуміння mobile-first композиції: акцент на емоції обличчя (close-up), контраст, колірні тригери, фокусні точки для швидкого захоплення уваги
Портфоліо з реалістичними постерами або обкладинками. Плюс, якщо в кейсах видно твій пайплайн, а не лише фінальні картинки.
Буде перевагою: 3D (Blender, Daz Studio) для побудови референсних сцен і поз під подальшу генерацію.
Базове володіння Figma — це наш спільний файл-хаб

___________________________________________________________________________

Що отримаєш від нас:

Швидке професійне зростання. Ми будуємо середовище, де розвиток — норма: лекції, бібліотеки, хакатони, школи. Компенсуємо профільне навчання й вивчення будь-якої мови, зокрема української.
Формат роботи на твій вибір. Можеш працювати вдома, в офісі на київському Подолі чи у Львові (генератори, укриття, обіди, снеки — all inclusive), або ж за кордоном — маємо кілька офісів і там.
Техніку та сервіси. Все, що треба для роботи.
Відпочинок. 20 днів відпустки + на офіційні свята та безлімітні лікарняні.
Турботу про тіло та менталку. Компенсуємо спорт, медстрахування в Україні (після випробувального), послуги корпоративного лікаря і підтримку ментального здоров’я&

___________________________________________________________________________

Чому з нами класно?

Реальний вплив. Твої рішення впливають на 100+ млн користувачів — їхній досвід, емоції та час, який вони проводять у продукті.
Жива культура. Ми створюємо середовище, де можна експериментувати й пробувати щось нове. Середня оцінка відповіді на питання «Наскільки тобі подобається працювати в HOLYWATER?» за результатами eNPS — 9,23/10.
Автономність. Ми довіряємо рішенням команди: мінімум мікроменеджменту, максимум простору для ініціативи й впливу.
Сильні люди поруч. Ми постійно челенджимо статус-кво та досягаємо нових вершин. Думати інакше й прагнути більшого — тут це підтримають.

Можливо, це — твій шанс стати нашим наступним big name?

___________________________________________________________________________

Хочеш більше про HOLYWATER TECH? Чекни це:

Як працює HOLYWATER TECH — на Vector Media

Інтерв’ю со-CEO Богдана Несвіта про партнерство FOX Entertainment для Forbes

Як ми створюємо вертикальні серіали — у подкасті на DOU

Про вертикальні серіали, які змінюють індустрію — у Детектор медіа

Наші Instagram та LinkedIn — щоб бути в курсі всього, що в нас відбувається

Хочеш творити історію разом із нами в HOLYWATER TECH?

Відгукнися на вакансію! Надішли портфоліо й коротко опиши, як ти працюєш із генерацією і постобробкою. Далі — тестове: два постери за двома брифами, з референсами персонажів і локацій від нас. Потім співбесіда з командою.

jobs.description:
Lane Group is a diversified group with interests in real estate development, private investments, philanthropy and a portfolio of operating businesses. The Group is seeking a Content & Social Lead to manage its digital presence and communications across these businesses, including content creation, channel management, brand guidelines and marketing strategy.

The Content & Social Lead will define and execute the digital strategy for Lane Group and each of its businesses, setting a distinct brand voice for each while maintaining a consistent standard across the Group. This includes determining which channels each business should use and how it should be positioned on them.

The role holder will plan, produce and publish content on a regular basis, including short-form video, carousels, LinkedIn posts, articles and newsletters, and will cover events, site visits and launches in person, including travel to Spain and Jordan. AI tools are expected to form a core part of the workflow, from ideation and copywriting to image and video production.

The role also carries responsibility for governance and performance, including:

•   Brand and social media guidelines for each business, covering voice, visual style and templates
•   A content calendar, approval workflow, asset library and account access controls
•   An AI use policy and a crisis and escalation process
•   Compliance with local advertising regulations, including property advertising permits
•   Monthly reporting on reach, engagement, audience growth and leads

For the Group's operating and incubated businesses, the role will take a more active part, leading audience research, positioning, launch campaigns and creator partnerships. The role holder will also coordinate the Group's existing agencies and sales partners, manage freelancers and photographers, and oversee the marketing budget.

The ideal candidate will have 3-6 years' experience creating content or managing social media for a brand, agency, start-up or their own channels, supported by a strong portfolio across video, design and copy. They will be fluent in AI tools and current creative software, closely attuned to platform trends, and able to judge what suits a premium brand.

We are looking for someone who takes full ownership of their work, who drives projects independently, is accountable for results and is organised enough to build processes that last.

Excellent written English, discretion with confidential information and willingness to travel to Spain, Jordan and other countries are required.

Experience in any of the following would be an advantage:

•   Working alongside creative, PR or sales agencies
•   Real estate, hospitality, F&B, lifestyle or consumer brand launches
•   Photography, on-camera presence, paid social or basic web and SEO

The role offers a competitive salary with other benefits and a budget for tools, equipment and freelancers. The successful candidate will work directly with leadership, take ownership of a new function within the Group and have a clear path to building a team as it grows.

We've raised over $200M from top-tier investors including Balderton, Lakestar, Accel, Creandum, Lowercarbon, Ribbit, 20VC, Hummingbird and Collaborative Fund, alongside strategic angels including Nico Rosberg and GPs behind Meta, Revolut, Spotify and Uber.

3+ years as a producer, with real strategic curiosity, a range of produced video and campaigns, and strong management of crews, vendors and agencies

jobs.description:
Company Description

At Docplanner Group, we’re on a mission to help people live longer, healthier lives. As the world’s largest healthcare platform, each month, we connect 24 million patients with 280k doctors across 13 countries (through brands like ZnanyLekarz, Doctoralia, MioDottore, DoktorTakvimi, and jameda). Our marketplaces, SaaS and AI tools simplify daily tasks and help doctors, clinics and hospitals work more efficiently, so they can focus on what really matters: caring for their patients.

Learn more about our products here: pro.doctoralia.es

Why join us?

📊 Real impact – We help doctors help patients. Your work truly makes a difference.

📈 At scale, yet agile – 3,000+ employees, but still fast, flexible, and hands-on.

✨ Shape the future, sustain growth – Make a difference now and build for long-term success.

Job Description

Docplanner's Paid Marketing team - a B2B function focused on acquiring doctors and clinics - is looking for a Senior Specialist in Creative Strategy & Performance to own the full creative lifecycle for paid media: from strategy and briefing, through asset production management, to performance intelligence and testing. This is a hybrid strategist/operator role - half creative thinking, half process and data discipline.

You'll be the bridge between performance data and creative output - turning what's working (and what isn't) across our nine markets into sharper briefs, faster production cycles, and a continuously improving testing roadmap.

We are looking for a person with a Performance Marketing background that has hands-on experience in campaigns management and targets delivery. If you are a performance marketer who loves testing and can turn insights into repeatable creative performance, read on!

How will you make an impact?

Creative Strategy

Define the creative strategy and testing roadmap for paid campaigns across all markets and ad platforms, aligned with performance goals
Translate campaign objectives and audience insights into clear, actionable briefs
Partner with local market teams to adapt global creative direction to local nuances - language, culture, and regulatory requirements

Asset Preparation & Coordination

Own the end-to-end production workflow: brief - content and design coordination - review - localization - trafficking
Coordinate with in-house designers and freelancers to keep timelines predictable
Build and maintain a repeatable process - briefing templates, naming conventions, approval workflows - to reduce bottlenecks and rework

Creative Intelligence & Testing

Run structured A/B and multivariate tests across Meta and other paid channels, defining hypotheses, success metrics, and test cadence
Build creative performance reporting (Meta Ads, Tableau, Amplitude) that identifies which elements - format, hook, messaging, visual style - drive results
Maintain a creative intelligence repository documenting what's worked, by market and format, to inform future briefs

Tracking & Measurement

Ensure creative-level tracking is implemented and tagged correctly, in partnership with the tracking/tech team, so performance can be attributed accurately
Monitor creative fatigue and flag refresh cycles proactively, before performance declines

Team Flexibility

Step into hands-on campaign management when needed - covering colleagues' absences or supporting new market initiatives.

What We're Looking For

4+ years in performance marketing with a proven track record in creative strategy, or a media buying background with hands-on experience in paid social creative (Meta Ads required; TikTok, Google, LinkedIn, or Bing a plus)
Hands-on experience in paid media performance, including campaign set-up and management - able to step into hands-on campaign management when team capacity is stretched
Demonstrated experience managing creative production across multiple stakeholders - designers, agencies, local teams - at scale
Strong analytical skills - comfortable pulling and interpreting creative performance data independently, not relying on assumptions
Experience designing and running structured creative tests, not ad hoc experimentation
Strong project management and cross-functional communication skills - this role touches Paid Ads, Design, Local Marketing, and Data Analytics teams
Fluent English required; Spanish and/or Portuguese a strong plus given our market footprint
Comfortable operating across multiple markets and cultures simultaneously

Nice to Have

Familiarity with Amplitude, Tableau, or HubSpot or Creative Intelligence tools
Experience with creative automation or dynamic creative optimization (DCO) tools
Background in healthcare, marketplace, or subscription business models

What To Expect From Our Hiring Process

We like to keep things transparent and efficient! Here’s what the process usually looks like (though it might vary slightly depending on the role):

1️⃣ Intro Chat
– A first call with our Talent Partner, to explore mutual fit around relevant skills, value alignment, and motivation.

2️⃣TestGorilla –
(SHL numerical reasoning assessment).

3️⃣Hiring Manager Interview
– A deeper conversation about your background, aspirations, and experience with the hiring manager and your potential manager in this role .
Take this chance to ask anything on your mind—it’s just as much about making sure we’re the right fit for you, too.

4️⃣ Business Case –
A take-home exercise incl. a few days' preparation time, designed to understand how you approach real-life problems. You’ll then walk us through your approach in a collaborative discussion with the hiring manager and the team to discuss your thoughts and findings.

5️⃣ Additional/ Final Interview (Optional)
– A final conversation with another senior leader from our Global Team.

6️⃣ References & Offer!

Why You’ll Love It Here

💙 Global Benefits –
No matter where you are, you’ll have access to:

Healthcare insurance – so you can focus on what matters.
Wellness that works for you – from gym memberships to mental health support, we’ve got you covered.
Time off that counts – whether it’s a vacation, your birthday, or just a day to recharge, we believe in balance.

📍 Local Perks –
Depending on your location, you will be entitled to local benefits like meal vouchers (ticket restaurant), transport allowances, or extended parental leave.

🚀 Career Growth –
We’re growing, and so can you! You’ll find lots of chances to learn, develop, and explore new paths—whether within your team or through cross-functional projects.

🌎 A Truly Global Team –
Work with talented people from all over the world in a diverse and inclusive environment.

⏳ Flexibility That Works for You –
Remote work and flexible hours aren’t just buzzwords here. While the extent of flexibility depends on your role and team, we value results over rigid schedules. Prefer an office setting? You're welcome at any of our hubs in Barcelona, Warsaw, Curitiba, Rio de Janeiro, Mexico City, Bogotá, Munich, Rome or Bologna.

Please note: At this time, we are not able to sponsor visas for this position. To apply, you must already have the legal right to work in your country of residence or the location of the role.

What We Believe In

At Docplanner, our values guide everything we do:

📊 Focus on results –
we're here to make an impact.

🧠 Think like an owner –
take responsibility, drive outcomes.

✂️ Keep it simple, keep it lean –
smart solutions over complexity.

🔊 Be respectful and radically honest –
openness builds trust.

📚 Learn and be curious –
growth is part of the job.

Don’t just take our word for it—check out our Glassdoor to hear what our people say!

_________________________________________________________________________

We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. We welcome applicants from all walks of life, regardless of gender, disability, or background, and are dedicated to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute.

Define the creative strategy and testing roadmap for paid campaigns across all markets and ad platforms, aligned with performance goals
Translate campaign objectives and audience insights into clear, actionable briefs

Asset Preparation & Coordination

Own the end-to-end production workflow: brief - content and design coordination - review - localization - trafficking

Creative Intelligence & Testing

Run structured A/B and multivariate tests across Meta and other paid channels, defining hypotheses, success metrics, and test cadence

jobs.title: Creative Producer (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Kurz und knapp

Bist du ein Organisationstalent mit einem Auge für Kreativität? Hast du Lust darauf, unsere Kampagnen in der App so richtig strahlen zu lassen? Während unsere Fotografen im Studio alles geben und die Visual Editors den Bildern den letzten Schliff verpassen, hältst du im Hintergrund die Fäden in der Hand.

In dieser Rolle bist du das Organisations-Genie
: Du sorgst dafür, dass hinter den Kulissen alles rund läuft. Von den passenden Requisiten über die Produkte bis hin zu den Backdrops - du stellst sicher, dass jedes Shooting ein Erfolg wird. Außerdem brainstormst du gemeinsam mit unseren Art Directors an der visuellen Richtung für unsere nächsten großen Kampagnen. Das ist deine Chance, dein Planungsgeschick mit deinem kreativen Talent zu verbinden!

Das erwartet dich

Produktionsleitung für Photoshoots: Du übernimmst die Regie bei unseren Kampagnen-Shoots - von der ersten Vorbereitung bis zum Einsatz direkt am Set.
Daily Operations im Studio: Du steuerst das Tagesgeschäft in unserem Studio und priorisierst Kapazitäten so, dass wir jede Deadline rocken.
Projektmanagement: Du jonglierst verschiedene kreative Projekte gleichzeitig - von Kampagnen bis hin zu Rezept-Shootings.
Zusammenarbeit: Du arbeitest eng mit Fotografen, Visual-Designern, dem Commercial-Team und externen Partnern zusammen, um High-Quality Content pünktlich zu liefern.
Prozessoptimierung: Du hast ein Auge für Details und verbesserst unsere Produktionsabläufe kontinuierlich, um unseren Output und die Effizienz aufs nächste Level zu heben.
Brainstorming: In kreativen Sessions bringst du deine Ideen ein, um unseren Content aufs nächste Level zu bringen.

Das bringst du mit

Ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Bachelorstudium in Marketing, Kommunikation, BWL oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich
Du bringst mindestens 2 Jahre Erfahrung im Bereich Produktion oder Projektmanagement mit
Projektmanagement ist deine absolute Stärke
Du hast eine echte „Can-do“-Mentalität und gehst Herausforderungen mit viel Energie an
Erfahrung in der Kampagnenproduktion ist ein großes Plus!
Reisebereitschaft
Fließende Deutsch- und sehr gute Englischkenntnisse

Darauf kannst du dich freuen

Erlebe die dynamische Atmosphäre eines innovativen Scale-ups und werde Teil eines Teams, das gemeinsam Großes erreicht
Arbeite in einem motivierten, internationalen Team und freue dich auf unvergessliche Team-Events
Genieße kostenfreies Mittagessen, Snacks und Getränke an all unseren Picnic-Standorten – immer frisch und lecker
Mit 30 Urlaubstagen pro Jahr (bei einer 40-Stunden-Woche) sorgst du für den perfekten Ausgleich zwischen Arbeit und Erholung
Wir stellen dir einen Picnic Laptop und ein Smartphone zur Verfügung
Freue dich auf eine Vielzahl an Rabattaktionen, Gutscheinen und weiteren Benefits, die dir das Leben versüßen
Reise durch ganz Deutschland mit deinem von Picnic bezuschussten Deutschlandticket
Bleib fit und voller Energie - mit Lease-a-Bike kommst du nachhaltig, gesund und flexibel zur Arbeit

Schick uns deine Bewerbung gern auf Englisch, wenn du schon eine englische Version parat hast!

MEFITPRO & QOOAH | Dubai, UAE | Full-Time

About Us

MEFITPRO is an established leader in the Middle East's fitness industry, providing commercial fitness equipment, professional fitness education, sports nutrition solutions, and industry events.

QOOAH is our consumer-facing fitness and wellness retail brand, offering a curated range of fitness equipment, sports nutrition, recovery products, and wellness essentials through e-commerce and retail channels.

As we strengthen our digital growth capabilities, we're looking for a commercially driven Performance Marketing Specialist
to own and optimise paid acquisition across both businesses.

The Role

You'll be responsible for planning, executing, and optimising paid advertising campaigns that generate qualified leads for MEFITPRO and profitable online sales for QOOAH.

This is a hands-on, performance-driven role requiring strong analytical skills, technical platform expertise, and a clear understanding of how advertising investment translates into business results.

You'll work closely with marketing leadership, the social media team, e-commerce, and commercial departments to build scalable acquisition systems across both brands.

We're looking for someone who understands that successful advertising isn't measured by clicks or impressions, but by the commercial outcomes it produces.

Key Responsibilities

1. Paid Media Strategy & Campaign Management

Plan, launch, manage, and optimise paid advertising campaigns across Meta Ads, Google Ads, and other relevant platforms.
Develop distinct acquisition strategies for MEFITPRO's B2B business and QOOAH's B2C e-commerce operations.
Manage campaign budgets, audience targeting, bidding strategies, creative testing, and performance optimisation.
Build full-funnel acquisition campaigns covering awareness, consideration, conversion, and remarketing.
Continuously identify opportunities to improve acquisition efficiency and scale successful campaigns.
Maintain structured campaign naming conventions, reporting dashboards, and testing documentation.

2. MEFITPRO: B2B Lead Generation

Develop lead generation campaigns targeting gym owners, fitness operators, hospitality groups, developers, and commercial fitness facilities.
Generate qualified enquiries for commercial fitness equipment, facility solutions, and relevant business services.
Build targeted campaigns for professional fitness certifications, educational programmes, and workshops.
Develop campaign structures based on customer segments, business lines, geography, and commercial objectives.
Collaborate with sales teams to track lead quality, qualification rates, pipeline progression, and conversion into customers.
Optimise campaigns based on cost per qualified lead and commercial outcomes, not lead volume alone.
Support targeted campaigns for industry events, product launches, and strategic partnerships.

3. QOOAH: E-commerce Growth & Customer Acquisition

Manage performance campaigns designed to generate online sales across fitness equipment, sports nutrition, recovery, and wellness categories.
Develop and optimize Google, and Meta sales campaigns.
Manage product catalogue advertising, dynamic product ads, and remarketing audiences.
Analyse performance by product category, campaign, audience, and customer segment.
Collaborate with the e-commerce team to align advertising with product availability, pricing, promotions, and margins.
Improve return on advertising spend (ROAS), customer acquisition cost (CAC), and contribution profitability.
Identify high-potential products and categories that can be scaled profitably.
Support seasonal campaigns, new product launches, and promotional initiatives.

4. Tracking, Attribution & Analytics

Implement, monitor, and troubleshoot conversion tracking across advertising platforms.
Work with Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, Meta Pixel, Conversions API, and relevant e-commerce tracking tools.
Ensure accurate measurement of leads, purchases, revenue, and other key conversion events.
Collaborate with the web and e-commerce teams to resolve tracking, landing page, and conversion issues.
Build clear performance dashboards showing advertising investment, acquisition costs, conversion rates, and revenue contribution.
Analyse campaign performance using platform data, analytics, CRM data, and actual sales outcomes.
Identify tracking discrepancies and communicate their impact on reporting and decision-making.

5. Creative Testing & Conversion Optimisation

Work closely with Social Media & Content to develop high-performing advertising creatives.
Prepare clear creative briefs based on audience insights, customer objections, campaign performance, and product opportunities.
Run structured A/B tests across messaging, creative formats, audiences, offers, and landing pages.
Identify opportunities to improve landing page conversion rates and reduce acquisition costs.
Analyse competitor advertising, market trends, and emerging platform opportunities.
Maintain a continuous testing and learning process to improve performance.

6. Budget Management & Performance Reporting

Monitor daily campaign spending and ensure budgets are allocated efficiently.
Prepare weekly performance updates and monthly reports with clear commercial insights.
Track performance against agreed KPIs, targets, and acquisition budgets.
Recommend budget reallocations based on performance, profitability, and growth opportunities.
Present actionable recommendations to marketing leadership and relevant commercial teams.
Flag underperforming campaigns early and take corrective action.

Required

What We're Looking For

3–4 years of hands-on experience managing performance marketing campaigns.
Proven experience with both Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads.
Demonstrable success generating qualified leads and/or scaling e-commerce sales.
Strong working knowledge of Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, conversion tracking, and attribution.
Experience managing meaningful advertising budgets with clear performance accountability.
Strong analytical capabilities and confidence working with spreadsheets, dashboards, and performance data.
Ability to independently build, launch, optimize, and troubleshoot campaigns.
Understanding of customer acquisition economics, conversion rates, CAC, ROAS, and marketing ROI.
Excellent organisational skills, attention to detail, and ownership of results.
Strong English communication skills.
Based in Dubai or willing to relocate.

Highly Desirable

Experience managing both B2B lead generation and B2C e-commerce advertising.
Previous experience in fitness, wellness, sports nutrition, consumer retail, or related industries.
Experience with Shopify, WooCommerce, or similar e-commerce platforms.
Experience with CRM-integrated lead generation and offline conversion tracking.
Familiarity with Google Merchant Center, product feeds, and catalogue management.
Experience advertising across UAE, Saudi Arabia, and wider GCC markets.
Understanding of contribution margins, customer lifetime value, and e-commerce unit economics.
Arabic language skills are an advantage.

What Success Looks Like

Within your first 90 days, we expect you to:

Complete a full audit of existing paid advertising accounts, conversion tracking, and campaign performance across both businesses.
Establish reliable reporting and measurement frameworks for MEFITPRO and QOOAH.
Implement structured acquisition campaigns aligned with each brand's commercial priorities.
Improve the quality and efficiency of MEFITPRO's lead generation.
Identify and scale QOOAH's strongest-performing product categories and campaigns.
Establish a consistent creative testing and optimisation process.
Demonstrate clear ownership of budgets, performance, and commercial results.
Present a data-backed growth roadmap for the following quarter.

Why Join Us?

You'll have the opportunity to manage performance marketing across two complementary businesses operating in the Middle East's growing fitness and wellness industry.

From B2B commercial fitness solutions and professional education to consumer e-commerce and premium wellness products, you'll work across multiple acquisition models, customer segments, and growth opportunities.

You'll have direct exposure to marketing leadership, meaningful commercial objectives, and the opportunity to build scalable acquisition systems that contribute directly to business growth.

Superside is hiring an AI Creative Technologist to turn the requests our customers keep coming back with into automations and agents that run. You'll work directly with customers on live work from inside our studios, in close collaboration with Product.

The right profile pairs creative judgment with a builder's instinct: you know what good output looks like, and you ship it. Success means customers end up with systems they can run, not only assets, and what you build is documented so every studio can reuse it.

What You'll Do

  • Partner with customers on live work to scope, build, and ship custom automations and agents, embedded in their team and tools or on our platform.

  • Define what good looks like for each automation, including the human quality check around it.

  • Feed customer needs and reusable pieces back to Product, and bring platform capabilities into customer work.

  • Explain each system to the customer and train their team to run it.

  • Document everything you build and share it through show and tell, so every studio can reuse it instead of rebuilding it.

What You'll Need To Succeed

  • 5+ years of professional experience working in agencies or in-house creative teams, preferably with a background in design systems or creative technology.

  • Strong creative judgment: you know what good output looks like and can set the quality bar for an automation.

  • Hands-on experience building with AI tools and agents in real work, including workflows, agents, prompts, and integrations, with evidence of things shipped, not only experiments.

  • A generalist builder's range: you can brief, make, build, and ship, rather than specializing in one format or channel.

  • A habit of documenting and sharing what you build, so others can use it.

  • A self-driven approach: you move from idea to finished output without handoffs and are comfortable working without a playbook.

  • A collaborative mindset, working closely with Product and your studio team.

  • Excellent English verbal and written communication skills.

  • Bonus: Experience working directly with customers: scoping a need, explaining the system, and training their team to run it.

jobs.title: Senior Creative Strategist
jobs.description:
Company Description

Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.

Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.

Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.

As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.

For everyone, everywhere.

Job Description

More about our mission
and what we offer
.

At Wise, we build and launch truly amazing products designed to give our customers smart & impactful solutions to their international money challenges. But creating ground-breaking products is only half the battle - we need everyone to know about them, understand them, and feel genuinely inspired to use them.

As a Senior Strategist, you will have strong creative judgement to help our target audience understand how Wise solves their international money problems. You will make sense of complex marketing & business problems, bringing together business priorities with customer & market insights to identify where creative can support business growth. You will write excellent, focused & inspiring creative briefs, and work closely with creative teams to deliver campaigns spanning channels such as Paid Social, Paid Display, Audio and more from idea to final execution.

What You’ll Be Doing

Bring clarity to complex marketing problems: Work with product, marketing and regional teams to unpack broad or ambiguous challenges. Ask the right questions, connect the available evidence and establish priorities, defining the problem we need to solve and the role creative can play.
Find the insight that unlocks the creative: Bring together customer research, market context and performance learnings to identify the motivations, tensions and barriers our communications need to address. Turn these into a clear strategic direction and the change we want to make.
Write creative briefs that inspire great work: Translate customer & market insights, and creative performance insights into focused, compelling creative briefs with clear objectives, audience insight and proposition. Giving creative teams a clear & inspiring starting point from which to develop bold, distinctive ideas.
Raise the quality of the work through creative critique: Assess creative concepts and executions against creative briefs - ensuring alignment to insights, and market priorities. Articulate what’s working, what isn’t and why, giving specific, constructive feedback that improves the work while preserving the strength of the idea.
Reinvent & own customer comms: Lead the strategic direction and storytelling of our quarterly "Mission Update" customer comms - turning company & product updates from functional comms into bold, engaging & memorable moments for our customers.
Connect data to creative impact: Interpret channel performance data across media channels into clear creative recommendations on what to test, refine, or scale, ensuring every creative asset drives measurable results.

What You’ll Bring To The Role

A proven track record in creative strategy, alongside broader marketing experience. You understand how customer needs, product messaging, media placement and commercial objectives come together, and can apply that to defined creative projects.
A knack for turning functional product messaging into fun, engaging narratives that will get customers using our products.
Strong creative judgement and an excellent ability to critique work. You can explain why an idea or execution will connect with its audience and deliver on the brief, identify where it falls short, and give actionable feedback grounded in strategy.
Comfortable interpreting channel performance metrics (i.e. CTR / CPA / conversion ... etc) to understand which creative narratives resonate best, and iterating for maximum impact.
Excellent collaboration and influencing skills, with the ability to unite product, creative, and performance media teams around bold creative ideas.
A self-starter attitude - comfortable identifying comms gaps & pushing initiatives through to completion
The ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-moving environment.

What’s in it for you?

You’ll be part of a team of exceptionally talented marketers who consistently break new ground in the way they engage customers.

Within Wise we operate in a flat structure, you’ll be in charge of your own workload and focus areas, giving you the chance to have a huge impact in one of the UK’s fastest growing & most successful startups.

Additional Information

For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.

We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.

Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.

If you want to find out more about what it's like to work at Wise visit Wise.Jobs.

Keep up to date with life at Wise by following us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

jobs.title: AI Video Editor & Creative Content Producer
jobs.description:
**Company:** PurpleBox  
**Location:** Dubai, UAE  
**Job Type:** Part-time

**About the Role**

PurpleBox is looking for a highly creative **AI Video Editor & Content Producer** who understands both traditional video production and the new generation of AI-powered creative tools.

We are **not looking for a basic video editor** who only cuts footage, adds music, captions and transitions.

We want someone who can take an idea or story and turn it into highly engaging, visually impressive social media content by combining:

* Real actors and actresses
* Real footage filmed at our locations
* AI-generated scenes
* AI-generated images and video
* Visual effects
* Creative transitions
* Sound design
* Motion graphics
* Strong storytelling

Our objective is to produce social media advertisements and organic content that make people stop scrolling, watch, engage and remember the PurpleBox brand.

**AI Experience Is Important**

The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience with **Higgsfield** and/or other leading AI creative platforms.

Experience with tools and models such as the following is highly valued:

* Higgsfield
* Kling
* Veo
* Sora
* Runway
* Midjourney
* Nano Banana / Gemini image tools
* Adobe Firefly
* Other emerging AI image and video generation tools

You should actively follow developments in AI video production and be interested in experimenting with new tools as they become available.

**What You Will Create**

You will work with our marketing team, actors and content creators to produce:

* Instagram Reels
* TikTok-style short-form videos
* Meta advertisements
* YouTube Shorts
* Brand films
* Promotional videos
* Story-driven advertisements
* Cinematic social media content
* Product and service advertisements

The content will primarily promote **PurpleBox Storage and PurpleBox Moving**.

**Your Responsibilities**

You will be responsible for taking content from **concept to final video**.

This includes developing creative concepts and storylines, reviewing scripts, planning shots, editing real footage, creating AI-generated scenes and assets, integrating AI footage naturally with live-action footage, adding motion graphics and visual effects, performing color grading and sound design, and delivering finished content optimized for social media.

You should also be able to look at ordinary footage and think:

**“How can I turn this into something people actually want to watch?”**

We want someone who can transform a simple idea into a story.

For example, instead of producing a standard video showing movers packing boxes, you should be able to build a story around the customer, the problem they are experiencing, the moving process, and the final result—using real footage where appropriate and AI-generated scenes where they improve the story.

**What We’re Looking For**

The successful candidate should have:

* Strong professional video-editing skills
* Excellent understanding of pacing, hooks and short-form storytelling
* Strong experience with Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve or equivalent professional editing software
* Practical experience using AI video and image-generation tools
* Ability to create consistent characters, environments and visual styles using AI
* Understanding of prompting and AI creative workflows
* Strong sense of cinematography, composition, lighting and camera movement
* Ability to integrate AI-generated footage with real footage convincingly
* Strong sound-design and music-selection skills
* Understanding of social media advertising and attention retention
* Ability to work quickly and produce multiple creative variations
* Strong creative judgment and attention to detail

**What We Are NOT Looking For**

We are not looking for someone whose experience is limited to:

* Basic CapCut editing
* Adding subtitles to existing footage
* Using templates
* Simple transitions
* Cutting long videos into short clips
* Completely AI-generated videos with little creative direction

AI should be used as a **creative production tool**, not as a replacement for creativity, storytelling or real production.

**Portfolio Requirement**

**A portfolio is mandatory.**

Please include examples of your best:

* Short-form social media advertisements
* AI-generated video work
* Videos combining AI with real footage
* Cinematic or story-driven content
* Commercial/brand advertisements

Applications without a relevant portfolio may not be considered.

We care more about the **quality of your work, creativity and ability to tell stories** than the number of years you have worked in the industry.

**Application Question**

When applying, please answer:

**Which AI video and image-generation tools do you currently use, and briefly explain how you would combine real actors, real footage and AI-generated scenes to create a 30-second advertisement for a storage or moving company.**

If you are constantly experimenting with new AI creative tools and believe the future of advertising is a combination of **real production + AI + strong storytelling**, we would like to see your work.

Pay: AED30.00 - AED60.00 per hour

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Dubai (Dubai)

Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.

What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.

OUR CULTURE

Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.

We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.
Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.
Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory.

If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.

THE ROLE

Senior Creative Strategist

The Sr. Creative Strategist for UK/EU is a performance-minded, market-savvy leader who bridges global creative output with the nuances of European consumer behaviour. This person excels at identifying what's working in the US market and translating it for UK and German/French audiences; while also building the infrastructure to test, learn and scale independently. This person is energized by solving complex business problems, making high-judgment decisions in ambiguous environments, and turning insights into scalable, revenue-driving creative strategy.

Success in this role looks like:

Consistently identifying high-performing US creative and adapting it to drive customer acquisition and revenue growth in UK & DE/FR markets
Owning the experimentation framework that enables the EU/UK team to move fast, document learnings, and scale winners while maintaining strong alignment with brand identity
Serving as the primary creative liaison between UK & DE/FR market needs and the US creative and production teams
Improving win rates and spend efficiency through a rigorous, data-backed testing cadence
Acting as a strategic partner to the Director of Paid Social UK & DE/FR and cross-functional brand, design, and marketing teams
Leveraging data to inform strategic direction
This role is critical to establishing Paid Social as a core growth engine in the UK, Germany and France.

This role will be onsite 4-days a week based in London, Madrid, or Berlin.

Responsibilities

Creative Adaptation & Briefing

Audit US creative performance regularly to identify high-potential concepts for UK & DE/FR adaptation
Brief the US creative team on market-specific adaptation needs; adjusting copy, tone, cultural references, pricing, and product focus for UK & DE/FR audiences
Commission net-new creative concepts where US assets are insufficient or market-specific angles are required
Write clear, detailed high converting ad briefs for video, static, UGC, and other ad formats with UK & DE/FR market context embedded
Ensure all adapted and net-new creative aligns with brand identity while resonating locally
Provide strategic feedback to designers and execute on feedback from leadership

Experimentation & Performance

Build and own a structured experimentation framework for UK & DE/FR paid social; covering hypothesis formation, test design, documentation, and results reporting
Prioritise and manage a live test pipeline across Meta (and other channels) to continuously improve creative performance
Analyse performance data in Meta Ads Manager, TikTok Ads Manager, and Looker; translate findings into clear strategic recommendations
Conduct consumer, competitor, and trend research specific to UK & DE/FR markets to inform creative direction
Identify winning patterns and codify them into repeatable brief templates and creative playbooks

Cross-functional Collaboration

Serve as the EU/UK creative point of contact for the US production and strategy teams
Partner with the Director of Paid Social EU/UK on channel strategy, creative priorities, and growth planning
Collaborate with Brand, Design, and broader Marketing teams to align creative output across channels including affiliate, CRM, and PR

Qualifications

Required:

Bachelor’s degree required
5+ years of relevant creative and marketing experience
Paid Social and/or Direct Response experience required, with strong Meta expertise
Demonstrated experience working across markets; ideally including UK and/or DACH, with an understanding of how to adapt creative for different audiences
Strong analytical mindset with the ability to interpret data and make confident creative decisions
Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to write compelling briefs and copy across formats
Experience managing creative testing frameworks and reporting on results
Strong project management skills with the ability to juggle multiple briefs, markets, and workstreams simultaneously
Comfortable working across Google Suite (Docs, Sheets, Slides, Gmail)
Fluency in English required; German/French language skills a plus
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment
Strong collaboration skills across creative and marketing teams

Preferred:

Familiarity with TikTok, YouTube, Snapchat, or other paid platforms
Experience briefing and working with UGC creators
Background in DTC, fashion or e-commerce brands

All posted ranges are reflective of base salary and may vary depending upon experience level and location. Bonus and equity may also be provided for eligible roles.

jobs.title: Senior UA Creative Strategist - Mobile Games
jobs.description:
The Role

We are looking for a sharp, highly curious UA Creative Strategist to help us decide what advertising creatives we should make and why.

This is not primarily a video editing or art production role. Your job is to stay ahead of the mobile games advertising market, spot emerging creative opportunities, understand what is working and what is becoming stale, and turn those insights into strong concepts and clear production briefs.

You will sit at the intersection of creative, user acquisition, games and data.

We want someone who watches the market closely, studies competitors, understands internet culture and short-form video, experiments aggressively, and is constantly asking:

“What should we test next?”

You will work with our UA team and with internal and external creators, editors, artists, AI tools and production partners to turn those ideas into ads.

What You’ll Do

Own Our UA Creative Direction

  • Develop a continuous pipeline of new video ad concepts, hooks, formats and creative hypotheses.
  • Decide which ideas are worth producing and testing based on market trends, player psychology, competitor activity and our own performance data.
  • Build a weekly creative roadmap rather than waiting for production requests.
  • Push beyond obvious variations of existing ads and actively search for new creative angles.

Hunt for Trends and Creative Opportunities

  • Constantly research mobile game advertising across TikTok, Meta, YouTube, AppLovin, Google, Unity, Mintegral and emerging channels.
  • Study successful ads from both direct competitors and completely different genres and industries.
  • Deconstruct winning creatives by looking at the hook, pacing, storytelling structure, gameplay, visual treatment, sound, creator style, emotional trigger and CTA.
  • Track broader TikTok, Reels, Shorts, creator and internet culture trends and identify which ones can be translated into performance advertising.
  • Maintain a living library of interesting ads, formats, hooks and creative patterns.

Turn Insights Into Things We Can Actually Make

  • Write clear, production-ready creative briefs, scripts, storyboards and references.
  • Explain not just what to make, but the hypothesis behind the idea and what we are trying to learn.
  • Give strong creative direction and feedback to video editors, motion designers, game capture teams, UGC creators, AI creators and external agencies.
  • Help producers and artists understand the intent of a concept without prescribing every frame.
  • Review work in progress and push execution until the original creative idea comes through clearly.

Build a Modern Creative Testing Machine

  • Work closely with UA managers to understand CTR, IPM, CVR, CPI, ROAS, retention and other creative performance signals.
  • Identify why a creative worked rather than simply declaring it a winner.
  • Turn winning ads into structured families of new hypotheses rather than endless minor variations.
  • Kill weak directions quickly and double down aggressively when a concept shows promise.
  • Watch for creative fatigue and ensure the pipeline always has genuinely fresh ideas entering testing.

Use AI Aggressively, but Intelligently

  • Stay current with AI image, video, voice, scripting and editing tools.
  • Use AI to prototype ideas, explore concepts and generate variations rapidly.
  • Understand where AI production is good enough, where human production is better, and when the two should be combined.
  • Experiment with AI-native formats and workflows rather than treating AI only as a cheaper production tool.
  • Help us continuously evaluate new creative tools, platforms and production partners.

jobs.title: Senior Creative Strategist
jobs.description:
ABOUT QUINCE

Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.

What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.

OUR CULTURE

Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.

We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.
Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.
Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory.

If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.

THE ROLE

Senior Creative Strategist

The Sr. Creative Strategist for UK/EU is a performance-minded, market-savvy leader who bridges global creative output with the nuances of European consumer behaviour. This person excels at identifying what's working in the US market and translating it for UK and German/French audiences; while also building the infrastructure to test, learn and scale independently. This person is energized by solving complex business problems, making high-judgment decisions in ambiguous environments, and turning insights into scalable, revenue-driving creative strategy.

Success in this role looks like:

Consistently identifying high-performing US creative and adapting it to drive customer acquisition and revenue growth in UK & DE/FR markets
Owning the experimentation framework that enables the EU/UK team to move fast, document learnings, and scale winners while maintaining strong alignment with brand identity
Serving as the primary creative liaison between UK & DE/FR market needs and the US creative and production teams
Improving win rates and spend efficiency through a rigorous, data-backed testing cadence
Acting as a strategic partner to the Director of Paid Social UK & DE/FR and cross-functional brand, design, and marketing teams
Leveraging data to inform strategic direction
This role is critical to establishing Paid Social as a core growth engine in the UK, Germany and France.

This role will be onsite 4-days a week based in London, Madrid, or Berlin.

Responsibilities

Creative Adaptation & Briefing

Audit US creative performance regularly to identify high-potential concepts for UK & DE/FR adaptation
Brief the US creative team on market-specific adaptation needs; adjusting copy, tone, cultural references, pricing, and product focus for UK & DE/FR audiences
Commission net-new creative concepts where US assets are insufficient or market-specific angles are required
Write clear, detailed high converting ad briefs for video, static, UGC, and other ad formats with UK & DE/FR market context embedded
Ensure all adapted and net-new creative aligns with brand identity while resonating locally
Provide strategic feedback to designers and execute on feedback from leadership

Experimentation & Performance

Build and own a structured experimentation framework for UK & DE/FR paid social; covering hypothesis formation, test design, documentation, and results reporting
Prioritise and manage a live test pipeline across Meta (and other channels) to continuously improve creative performance
Analyse performance data in Meta Ads Manager, TikTok Ads Manager, and Looker; translate findings into clear strategic recommendations
Conduct consumer, competitor, and trend research specific to UK & DE/FR markets to inform creative direction
Identify winning patterns and codify them into repeatable brief templates and creative playbooks

Cross-functional Collaboration

Serve as the EU/UK creative point of contact for the US production and strategy teams
Partner with the Director of Paid Social EU/UK on channel strategy, creative priorities, and growth planning
Collaborate with Brand, Design, and broader Marketing teams to align creative output across channels including affiliate, CRM, and PR

Qualifications

Required:

Bachelor’s degree required
5+ years of relevant creative and marketing experience
Paid Social and/or Direct Response experience required, with strong Meta expertise
Demonstrated experience working across markets; ideally including UK and/or DACH, with an understanding of how to adapt creative for different audiences
Strong analytical mindset with the ability to interpret data and make confident creative decisions
Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to write compelling briefs and copy across formats
Experience managing creative testing frameworks and reporting on results
Strong project management skills with the ability to juggle multiple briefs, markets, and workstreams simultaneously
Comfortable working across Google Suite (Docs, Sheets, Slides, Gmail)
Fluency in English required; German/French language skills a plus
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment
Strong collaboration skills across creative and marketing teams

Preferred:

Familiarity with TikTok, YouTube, Snapchat, or other paid platforms
Experience briefing and working with UGC creators
Background in DTC, fashion or e-commerce brands

All posted ranges are reflective of base salary and may vary depending upon experience level and location. Bonus and equity may also be provided for eligible roles.

Pay Range: £92,000 GBP - £101,000 GBP

WHY QUINCE?

Joining Quince means being part of a mission-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & HIRING INTEGRITY

Quince provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applications for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran or military status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

jobs.title: Senior Performance Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
About Us

We are an established Dubai-based retail group operating two growing brands: Sand Dollar Dubai
, a premium multi-brand fashion and resortwear retailer , and Heart Cottage Lane
, a homeware and lifestyle destination.

With multiple retail locations, established e-commerce platforms and ambitious growth plans, we are looking for a highly experienced, results-driven Senior Performance Marketing Manager
to take full ownership of our paid digital advertising.

We currently work with an external advertising agency but are looking to bring this expertise in-house as our advertising investment and business continue to grow.

The Role

This is a hands-on, senior position for someone with extensive experience managing substantial Meta advertising budgets and delivering measurable, profitable results.

You will be responsible for developing, executing, monitoring and continuously optimising our paid advertising campaigns across Facebook and Instagram, targeting both domestic and international markets.

We are not looking for someone who simply boosts posts or follows standard advertising templates. We want a strategic thinker who understands customer behaviour, knows how to scale campaigns profitably and can identify opportunities to improve performance.

Key Responsibilities:

Meta Advertising & Campaign Management

- Take full ownership of Meta advertising across Facebook and Instagram.
- Demonstrate expert knowledge of Meta Ads Manager, Business Manager/Business Suite, Events Manager and Commerce Manager.
- Plan, launch, manage and optimise campaigns across multiple brands and markets.
- Develop sophisticated audience targeting, retargeting, prospecting and customer acquisition strategies.
- Manage regional campaigns across the UAE, GCC and international markets.
- Allocate budgets strategically to maximise profitability and return on advertising spend.
- Recommend and test different campaign objectives, structures, placements and advertising formats.
- Manage Meta Pixel, Conversions API, catalogue advertising and product feeds.
- Stay ahead of Meta algorithm changes, platform developments and advertising best practices.

Analytics, Reporting & Performance

- Demonstrate advanced practical knowledge of Google Analytics 4 (GA4), including e-commerce tracking, attribution and conversion analysis.
- Analyse Meta Ads Manager, GA4 and Shopify data to understand advertising performance.
- Track ROAS, cost per acquisition, customer acquisition cost, conversion rates and overall campaign profitability.
- Identify underperforming campaigns and take proactive steps to improve results.
- Provide clear weekly and monthly reports with actionable recommendations.
- Understand attribution differences between Meta, Google Analytics and Shopify.
- Identify opportunities to increase customer lifetime value and maximise return from advertising investment.

Strategy & Business Growth

- Develop comprehensive advertising strategies for both brands.
- Recommend the most effective campaign types for product launches, new collections, seasonal promotions, clearance campaigns and customer acquisition.
- Build effective advertising funnels covering new customer acquisition, retargeting and repeat purchases.
- Recommend market expansion opportunities based on campaign data and performance.
- Work closely with our marketing and content teams to develop high-converting advertising creatives.
- Conduct structured A/B testing of creatives, audiences, messaging and landing pages.
- Advise management on advertising budgets, opportunities and growth strategies.
- Continuously identify new methods of improving online revenue and advertising efficiency.

Essential Requirements

- Minimum 5 years of hands-on experience
in Meta performance advertising, ideally within fashion, retail or e-commerce.
- Proven experience independently managing substantial monthly advertising budgets.
- Expert-level proficiency in Meta Ads Manager and Meta Business Manager.
- Advanced working knowledge of Google Analytics 4.
- Strong understanding of Shopify e-commerce tracking, conversion funnels and attribution.
- Demonstrable success managing profitable regional and international campaigns.
- Strong analytical skills and the ability to interpret data to make commercial decisions.
- Experience with dynamic product ads, catalogue campaigns, retargeting and audience segmentation.
- Confidence presenting performance results, strategies and recommendations directly to business owners.
- Ability to work independently and take full accountability for results.
- Excellent written and spoken English.

What We're Looking For

We want someone who is genuinely passionate about performance marketing and understands that successful advertising is measured by profitable sales, not simply clicks, impressions or engagement.

You must be proactive, analytical, commercially minded and confident enough to challenge existing strategies and recommend better approaches.

This is not a social media content creation or community management position. It is a specialist, performance-focused advertising role.

What We Offer

- Full-time, in-house position based in Dubai.
- Opportunity to manage advertising for two established retail brands.
- Direct involvement in strategic business and marketing decisions.
- Significant scope to develop, test and scale campaigns.
- Competitive salary commensurate with experience and proven results.

How to Apply

Please submit your CV along with:

1. Details of the advertising budgets you have personally managed.
2. Examples of successful Meta advertising campaigns, including ROAS and performance improvements.
3. Your experience advertising across UAE, GCC and international markets.
4. Your level of experience with GA4, Shopify and Meta advertising platforms.

**Applications without demonstrable hands-on Meta advertising experience will not be considered.**
