Je werkt nauw samen met creatieve teams, account leads, producers en klanten aan geïntegreerde campagnes op het gebied van merk, digitaal, social, content en earned media. Je bent van nature nieuwsgierig naar cultuur en consumentengedrag, maar hebt ook een passie voor sterke ideeën, merkbouw en de rol die creativiteit speelt bij het oplossen van zakelijke uitdagingen.

Strategieontwikkeling & Planning

Vertalen van bedrijfsdoelstellingen naar heldere strategische aanbevelingen en communicatie-aanpakken.

Kansen identificeren voor merken om relevant te zijn door middel van cultuur, consumenteninzichten en creativiteit.
Concepten en creatief werk beoordelen op basis van strategische doelstellingen en campagnedoelen.

Onderzoek, Consumenteninzichten & Culturele Intelligentie

Monitoren van consumentengedrag, categorieontwikkelingen, culturele verschuivingen en opkomende kansen.
Analyseren van onderzoek, campagneprestaties, doelgroepdata en marktinzichten.

Ondersteunen van workshops, stakeholderinterviews en insight-generatie sessies.

Cross-functionele Samenwerking

Nauw samenwerken met creatieve, accountmanagement-, productie-, media- en datateams.
Deelnemen aan klantworkshops, presentaties en strategische discussies.
Ondersteunen bij het ontwikkelen van strategische verhalen en klantpresentaties.
Helpen om bedrijfsdoelstellingen, strategisch denken en creatieve oplossingen gedurende projecten op één lijn te houden.

Qualifications

Je bent native Dutch speaker en communiceert vloeiend in het Engels, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk
Minimaal 3 jaar ervaring in strategie, planning, brand strategy, communications planning of creative strategy binnen een creatief, advertising, digitaal of geïntegreerd bureau.
Ervaring met geïntegreerde campagnes die verder gaan dan alleen social media.
Kennis van merkbouw, consumentengedrag, communicatieplanning en creatieve ontwikkeling.
Ervaring met het ontwikkelen van inzichten, strategische frameworks en creatieve briefs.
Een afgeronde bacheloropleiding in Marketing, Communicatie, Bedrijfskunde, Psychologie, Mediastudies of een vergelijkbare richting is een pré.

Wat jij meebrengt

Sterk strategisch en analytisch denkvermogen.
Passie voor creativiteit en de impact van sterke ideeën op bedrijfsresultaten.
Nieuwsgierigheid naar mensen, cultuur, merken en consumentengedrag.
Het vermogen om inzichten te ontdekken en deze te vertalen naar krachtige strategische richtingen.
Uitstekende storytelling- en presentatievaardigheden.
Zelfvertrouwen om samen te werken met zowel creatieve teams als klantenteams.

jobs.title: Lead AI Producer
jobs.description:
Sobre MITO
MITO es una plataforma colaborativa y nativa en IA que está reinventando cómo se hacen películas, anuncios y videoclips. Trabajamos entre San Francisco y Madrid y combinamos los mejores modelos de imagen, vídeo y audio con herramientas profesionales de edición agéntica, en un canvas multijugador en el navegador.
MITO Films es nuestro estudio. Aquí producimos piezas reales para marcas, agencias y productoras usando nuestra propia tecnología, y aquí se demuestra lo que la IA puede hacer cuando la dirige gente que sabe contar historias.
Nos fundaron Iñaki Berenguer (MIT, PhD Cambridge, 5 veces fundador: Pixable, CoverWallet, iPronics), Danny Saltaren (diseñador de producto en dos unicornios, Premio Nacional de Diseño) y Arantxa Barcia (cineasta premiada). Nos respaldan Lightspeed, Bessemer, Kibo Ventures, K Fund, scouts de Sequoia y a16z, y fundadores de cinco unicornios.
El rol
Buscamos un perfil senior que lleve proyectos audiovisuales de principio a fin: desde el brief del cliente hasta la entrega final. Serás la persona que convierte una idea en una pieza terminada, que coordina a artistas y editores, y que sabe meterse en la herramienta cuando hace falta. No es un puesto solo de gestión ni solo de creación. Es las dos cosas.
Qué harás
Llevar proyectos completos: brief, propuesta creativa, planificación, producción, revisiones con el cliente y entrega.
Dirigir y generar contenido con herramientas de IA (vídeo, imagen, voz y música) dentro de MITO y fuera de ella.
Coordinar a un equipo de artistas IA, editores y freelances, y asegurar plazos, presupuesto y calidad.
Montar y dar acabado a las piezas, o supervisar a quien lo haga.
Revisar la calidad de cada pieza antes de que llegue al cliente. Eres el último filtro.
Trabajar con ventas en presupuestos y propuestas, y ser el punto de contacto creativo del cliente: presentar y defender las propuestas en inglés y en español, saber decir qué no se puede hacer y ofrecer una alternativa.
Contar al equipo de producto qué funciona, qué falla y qué necesitamos. Serás uno de sus mejores usuarios.

Qué buscamos
Formación en cine o comunicación audiovisual.
Mínimo 5 años de experiencia en producción o postproducción de publicidad y/o ficción.
Uso real de herramientas de IA generativa (Runway, Kling, Veo, Midjourney, Flux, ElevenLabs, ComfyUI o similares), con piezas que puedas enseñar.
Dominio de al menos una herramienta de edición o post (Premiere, DaVinci, After Effects, Avid).
Capacidad para gestionar varios proyectos a la vez, con clientes y plazos exigentes.
Inglés y español a nivel profesional: presentarás y defenderás propuestas ante clientes en ambos idiomas.
Criterio visual y narrativo: sabes distinguir cuándo una pieza funciona.
Muy valorable: experiencia con agencias o productoras, o haber liderado equipos pequeños.

Qué ofrecemos
Trabajar directamente con el equipo fundador, en un estudio que está definiendo cómo será la producción con IA.
Acceso a los modelos y herramientas más avanzados antes que nadie.
Proyectos para marcas y agencias internacionales.
Modalidad: remoto en España, con horario de España.

Sicherer Umgang mit AI-Tools im Creative-Kontext

100 % remote, 100 % selbstbestimmt. Starke Performance wird erwartet. Wann und wo du dir die Zeit dafür nimmst, entscheidest du selbst. Egal, wo du gerade in Europa bist.

jobs.title: Art Director (Brand and Visual)
jobs.description:
Deep Knowledge Group runs a portfolio of longevity and health-tech brands, from research and media platforms to membership and card products. We are looking for an Art Director to give them a visual identity that feels deliberate, consistent and credible.
The situation

Dozens of our websites and platforms were built at different times, by different people, mostly on Wix, custom HTML and application frameworks. Many began as temporary solutions and stayed. Later products and branches inherited the look of the one before, so the inconsistencies compounded. Nobody has owned the visual system across the portfolio. You will.
The role

You will set the visual direction across several projects at once. Your first project is the Longevity Club and Card pilot, which means a bounded visual and messaging kit and one approved journey. After that, other products come through our request intake, one at a time. You will have real authority to audit legacy design, decide what stays, and rebuild it properly.
You work AI-first: you find references, brief AI tools and freelancers, review the options, then choose, merge and approve the final result. You are accountable for what ships. Taste and judgement are the job, not hands-on production.
What you will do

Audit current visuals and propose an order for fixing them
Define the visual system, guidelines and templates for each product
Direct AI image, page and video production, and approve the final result
Brief, manage and review freelancers and agencies
Approve the look of websites, product UI and video together with Product and Front-end
Report on requests, decisions and progress in writing, regularly

What the environment is like

We are a research organisation, so the look we want is serious, clear and trustworthy, closer to a credible institution than a wellness brand. The work runs through a structured intake and review process, with regular written reporting. If you like clear priorities and see structure as a way to get good work shipped, you will fit in well.
The MarTech team is growing, and the roles around you (product, front-end, marketing operations) are still being filled, so you would help shape how design works here. The team moves fast and has no technical limits on tooling.
What we are looking for

A strong portfolio and demonstrable taste: you can explain why something works and what to change
Agency or studio experience handling several brands or clients at once
Experience bringing order to an inconsistent or inherited brand or product line
Fluency with current AI image, design and video tools, and clear brief-writing for them
Experience commissioning and reviewing work from freelancers or agencies
Resourcefulness: you find a way, and you bring initiative into the process
Comfort with written reporting and a structured review process

💼 Description du poste

DotWorld est un Venture Builder et SaaS Studio en forte croissance, opérant plusieurs produits SaaS par abonnement à l'international. Notre acquisition payante repose aujourd'hui largement sur Google, et notre diversification passe par Meta et TikTok. Sur ces canaux, le facteur limitant n'est pas le ciblage : c'est le débit et la qualité créative.

Aujourd'hui, le montage est assuré en interne par une seule personne, les media buyers briefent au fil de l'eau, et personne ne possède la stratégie créative ni le vivier de production. Résultat : une matrice d'angles limitée, pas de cadence tenue, pas de boucle d'apprentissage entre la performance d'une créa et le concept suivant. Et surtout, aucun liant avec les studios créatifs et les acteurs UGC.

C'est pour ça que nous créons le poste de Creative Strategist. Tu deviens le point de convergence entre nos media buyers (Google, Meta, TikTok), notre montage interne, et un écosystème de production externe que tu construis toi-même.

Ta mission : posséder la chaîne créative de bout en bout, sur l'ensemble du portefeuille et sur tous les marchés - recherche audience, angles, briefs, production, mise en ligne, analyse, itération. Livrer un flux constant, prévisible et mesuré de créas qui font baisser le CPA, dans plusieurs langues et plusieurs cultures.

👥 Description de l'équipe

Tu rejoindras l'équipe Growth & Acquisition, pilotée par Bastien BRICOUT, notre Chief Growth Officer, qui sera ton manager direct. Tu travailleras au quotidien avec nos media buyers Google, Meta et TikTok - dont Caroline AUDEBERT, notre Experte SEA - ainsi qu'avec notre monteur interne. L'équipe est full remote, orientée performance, avec une culture de l'autonomie et du résultat.

📂 Tes responsabilités

Stratégie créative et personas

  • Recherche audience structurée par marché : reviews produit, tickets support, verbatims, communautés locales, commentaires ads, retours des media buyers

  • Construction et maintien des personas par produit et par marché - un persona US n'est pas un persona FR traduit

  • Matrice d'angles par produit, par marché et par niveau de conscience

  • Veille concurrentielle internationale : Ad Library sur plusieurs pays, formats émergents, patterns qui montent sur un marché avant d'arriver sur les autres

  • Priorisation des hypothèses créatives à tester

Pilotage du vivier de production

  • Sourcing et casting de créateur(rice)s et acteur(rice)s UGC sur toutes les langues ciblées - le vivier est à construire, il n'existe pas encore

jobs.description:
Job Description: Creative Strategist

Role summary

YAMU Media is hiring a Creative Strategist to own the creative side of paid media for a pod of 5 to 8 clients. You decide what gets made, write and direct it, and use what the ads do in market to decide what gets made next.

This is a hands-on role. You write the scripts (using AI to draft at volume, then editing by hand), find and brief the talent, give direction on raw footage, and guide the editors and designers. You also read the performance data yourself and set the priority list for new creative, so the work stays tied to results.

What you'll own

  • Write scripts. Turn the creative angle, customer research and past winners into hooks and full video scripts for each client. Write every hook, re-hook and call to action, and make each script easy for talent to deliver and easy for an editor to cut.
  • Source talent. Find, vet and book the creators and on-camera talent each client needs, and keep a bench of proven people so new concepts can start quickly.
  • Direct talent. Brief talent before the shoot, give clear direction on delivery and on-camera performance, and give specific notes on the takes you receive.
  • Direct raw footage. Review raw footage, choose the usable takes and moments, and tell editors which hooks, lines and sections to build the cut around.
  • Direct the creative team. Brief editors and designers with a clear goal, reference and success measure for each asset, and give written feedback that gets to a finished ad in as few rounds as possible.
  • Analyze creative performance. Read ad-level results for each client, work out why ads won or lost (hook, angle, format, talent, offer), and write down what to repeat, iterate or retire.
  • Set creative priorities. Decide what the team makes next for each client and in what order, balancing iterations on proven ads against new concepts, and keep that list current as results come in.

Using AI to write scripts at volume

You will use AI to draft far more scripts than one writer could produce by hand, and you will be the editor who decides what is good enough to shoot. AI is the first draft. You are the final say.

  • Draft in volume. Use AI to generate many hooks and script variations from the creative angle, customer research, offer and past winning ads.
  • Vary on purpose. Ask for different angles, hook types, formats and lengths, not many copies of one idea, so each batch gives the pod something real to test.
  • Edit every script by hand. Nothing goes to talent or the client without a human read. You cut, rewrite and sharpen each draft so it sounds like a real person talking, fits the brand and is easy to perform.
  • Check every claim. AI can invent facts, results and testimonials. You verify each claim, number and promise against the client's own materials, and you keep scripts within platform ad policy and any client or legal rules.
  • Build the system. Maintain the prompts, reference documents (research, personas, offer, past winners) and script templates your pod uses, and improve them based on which drafts get approved and which ads perform.
  • Close the loop. Label each script by angle and hook type, so performance data shows what to ask AI for next.
  • Know when not to use it. Some concepts, especially ones that depend on a personal story or a delicate topic, are better written by you from scratch.

Writing modular scripts

Every script you write is built from interchangeable sections, so one shoot can produce many ad variations and we can test one element at a time.

  • Write in blocks

jobs.title: Creative Technologist
jobs.description:
TL;DR
- We're seeking an exceptional Design Engineer to build the tooling that makes AI-native brand production actually work at scale. You might call yourself a design engineer, creative technologist or even a full-stack product engineer who cares about craft. Here you’ll be someone who builds real infrastructure specifically in service of brand and creative output, working alongside brand designers who owns taste and direction.

Why Lovable?

Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.

We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.

Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.

What You'll Do

In one sentence: build the front-end surfaces and the AI-generation systems that let Lovable’s brand team produce at scale without losing its taste.

Build pipelines connecting image/video generation APIs, internal tooling, and the systems brand and marketing already use (Lovable, Design tools, CMS, the marketing site, Slack)
Build internal apps for the brand team - plausibly on Lovable itself, which is both a good dogfooding story and just the fastest way to do it
Own reliability and versioning for the AI-generation system so brand output doesn't silently drift in quality or style over time
Work closely with a Brand Designer who owns taste and direction - you're building the system that lets their judgment scale, not just executing tickets
Constantly evaluate new models, APIs, and generation tooling as the landscape moves, and rebuild pipelines when something better comes along

What We're Looking For

Solid engineering fundamentals - you have a track record of building, shipping, and maintaining real full-stack software
Genuine interest in AI generation systems (image/video models, fine-tuning, prompt pipelines) as a technical problem, not just as a user; you’ve built something with these APIs, even if only for yourself
Experience translating scrappy explorations into production-ready systems
Some design sensibility is a strong plus - you don’t need to be a designer, but you can tell when output is off-brand without it being spelled out, and you enjoy working closely with people who have strong taste
Comfortable building for a function with no internal precedent - you'll be making calls with no playbook to lean on
You’ll push the boundaries of what's possible with generative pipelines the way our Design Engineers push the boundaries of the web

Nice to have

Experience with Lovable or similar AI-native building tools
Prior work on marketing sites, design systems or brand tooling
Portfolio or side projects that show both craft and curiosity

Our tech stack

Lovable is built with tools that both humans and AI love:

Frontend: React, Tailwind
Backend: Golang and Rust
Cloud: Cloudflare, GCP, AWS, many LLM and generation providers
DevOps & Tooling: GitHub Actions, Grafana, OTEL, infra-as-code (Terraform)

And always on the lookout for what's next, especially in image/video generation APIs and pipelines. You’ll build custom tools in chorus with Lovable, while also contributing to Lovable upstream.

How We Hire

Fill in a short form then jump on an intro call with a recruiter.
Show us some of your work you're really proud of.
Show us how you approach problems during several technical interviews.
In some cases, we may opt to do paid trial work.

About Your Application

Please submit your application in English. It's our company language so you'll be speaking lots of it if you join.
We are prioritizing candidates who are based in London or Stockholm, or those willing to relocate.
We treat all candidates equally and if you're interested please apply through our careers portal.

We're looking for a brilliant Design Leader to take on the next chapter of Treatwell's creative and brand design across Europe.

We're entering an exciting new phase, filled with fresh energy, bold ideas and ambitious plans for the next generation of the Treatwell brand and the industry around it.

We've built an in-house Creative Studio to match that ambition, and now we're looking for a Creative Design Lead to help take its work to the next level.

Requirements

The role

Sitting with the Global brand team, you'll be the most senior designer within our in-house Creative Studio. You'll lead the design team, set the visual standard and remain deeply hands-on in creating the work.

This isn't a traditional Design Lead role where you'll direct from a distance. You'll be a practising designer who loves developing concepts, getting into the detail and turning ideas into beautifully crafted, effective creative.

Working across 13 European markets, you'll lead design for major brand campaigns, product launches, paid and organic social, CRM, content and digital experiences. You'll balance strong creative instincts with commercial thinking, ensuring our work is distinctive, relevant and built to perform.

You'll help us evolve how Treatwell shows up in the world, while developing a talented team and creating the conditions for them to do the best work of their careers.

You Will Be Responsible For

Leading design across the brand: Setting the creative and visual direction across integrated campaigns, launches, content, paid media, CRM, internal communications and other key brand touchpoints.
Creating exceptional work: Personally concepting, designing and delivering high-priority creative alongside the team. You'll remain close to the tools, the craft and the detail from the first idea through to final execution.
Leading and developing the design team: Managing, mentoring and upskilling designers and motion designers, providing clear direction and constructive feedback that raises the quality of the team's work.
Owning our biggest creative briefs: Leading major campaigns and cross-functional projects from concept to delivery, including work across TV, OOH, digital and social.
Setting and protecting the design standard: Ensuring every piece of work feels distinctive, cohesive and unmistakably Treatwell, while continuing to evolve our visual identity and design systems.
Connecting creativity with performance: Understanding when exceptional craft will build the brand and when platform-native creative will drive attention, engagement and action.
Designing for digital channels: Creating and guiding work across paid social, organic social, CRM, web and other digital formats, with a strong understanding of how design needs to flex across platforms and objectives.
Connecting product and brand: Working closely with Product and Marketing to build a stronger visual connection between the Treatwell brand, app and wider customer experience.
Collaborating across the business: Partnering with Brand, Marketing, Product, Performance and local market teams to turn strategic and commercial objectives into compelling creative work.
Improving how the studio works: Helping the team prioritise effectively, give and receive better feedback, use new tools intelligently and deliver high-quality work at pace.

About You

You have 7+ years of experience in senior design roles, with experience leading or managing designers in a fast-moving, high-growth environment.
You're an exceptional, hands-on designer with a portfolio that demonstrates strong visual thinking, original ideas and beautifully crafted execution.
You have significant experience developing and delivering integrated brand campaigns across channels such as TV, OOH, digital, social and CRM.
You're confident taking a project from an early strategic brief through concept development, design and final delivery.
You've successfully led and developed in-house designers, raising both individual capability and the overall standard of creative output.

You understand how to build a distinctive brand while creating digital and performance-led work that delivers against commercial goals.
You can bring clarity, structure and calm to a busy studio without compromising ambition or creative quality.
You're confident collaborating with senior stakeholders and explaining the thinking behind your creative decisions.
You're curious about new technology and how AI and emerging tools can improve creative development and production without compromising craft.

Portfolio Required

Please make your own contribution to each project clear. We want to understand the role you played across strategy, concept, design and execution.

Benefits

We're a team of 700 passionate and brilliantly talented people across Europe. jobs.title: Performance Creative Strategist - Germany
jobs.description:
We're the world's leading consumer healthcare platform, supporting millions of patients across the US, Australia, the UK, Germany, Japan, Spain and Canada.

We're driven by the belief that good health should last a lifetime, and that to get there we need to deliver the personalised, high quality and empathetic care that the traditional system cannot support.

You'll partner with our care teams of prescribers, nurses, health coaches, pharmacists and dietitians to support patients across preventative health, weight management and specific women's and men's health conditions.

We joined Hims & Hers so that you can do all of the above on a bigger scale, with more ambition, a stronger global brand and the resources to deliver care to patients in dozens of countries.

We're looking for people who appreciate and are excited by the enormity and uniqueness of this challenge, and want to work in the most ambitious, smart, fast moving and positive sum environment of their lives to transform how healthcare is delivered globally.

We hope that's you.

About The Role

As a Performance Creative Strategist (f/m/d)
, you'll own creative strategy as a core performance growth lever for the German market, with a strong focus on Meta and paid social.

Following Hims & Hers’ acquisition of Eucalyptus, we’re bringing together two digital healthcare businesses with a shared ambition to make high-quality, personalised healthcare more accessible. As part of this integration, you’ll play an important role in shaping how our brands and products show up in Germany — helping translate local customer insight into creative that resonates, performs, and scales.

Sitting at the intersection of consumer psychology, creative development, and performance marketing
, you’ll own the creative strategy and experimentation roadmap for Germany. You’ll identify the messages, formats, and ideas most likely to resonate with customers, translate them into compelling briefs and scripts, and use performance data to guide what we create next.

This is a hands-on role
for someone who is equally comfortable developing a new advertising concept, refining a script, and investigating why one creative outperformed another. You’ll work closely with designers, editors, creators, media buyers, and cross-functional teams across Eucalyptus and Hims & Hers to build a creative engine that gets smarter and more effective over time.

Your work will sit at the heart of the Eucalyptus × Hims & Hers integration in Germany
, giving you the opportunity to help shape how we bring together customer insights, creative capabilities, and performance expertise across both organisations.

What You'll Do

Translate customer insights, market trends, and performance data into clear, execution-ready creative briefs for paid social (Meta-first, with TikTok and YouTube in scope).
Build and manage creative testing frameworks: message hierarchies, testing roadmaps, and iteration plans that continuously improve performance.
Partner closely with performance marketers to analyse creative performance (CTR, CVR, CPA, ROAS, hook rate, hold rate) and turn insights into new testable ideas.
Scale what works: take winning concepts and spin them into multiple angles, formats, and variations for systematic testing.
Brief, manage, and iterate with UGC creators, designers, and agencies, ensuring output is optimised for performance - not just aesthetics.
Balance strategy and execution: reviewing performance dashboards in the morning, briefing creators and designers throughout the day, and refining hypotheses as results come in.
Work at speed in a high-volume, experiment-driven environment where learning and iteration matter more than polish.

About You

You're a performance-minded creative strategist who thrives at the intersection of paid social, customer insight, and creative execution, with a deep understanding of the German market.

Experience in creative strategy, growth marketing, or performance creative, with deep exposure to Meta and paid social.
Proven ability to write exceptional creative briefs that designers and copywriters can execute against, and that consistently unlock winning ads.
German fluency (B2+), with a strong understanding of German customer behaviour and cultural nuance, and hands-on experience creating or localising campaigns for German-speaking audiences.
Fluent in performance marketing metrics: you understand how creative impacts CTR, CVR, CPA, and ROAS across the funnel.
Comfortable working with UGC creators and performance-led content, from briefing and iteration through to reviewing results.
Highly collaborative, pragmatic, and comfortable with ambiguity. You thrive in fast-moving environments where priorities shift based on performance data.
Experienced in systematic creative testing, by building frameworks, message hierarchies, and structured experiments rather than one-off ideas.
Bonus: experience in DTC, subscriptions, health-tech, or high-growth startups where speed and efficiency matter more than perfection.

Why Join Us

Make a real impact: help thousands of patients in Germany improve their health and quality of life
High-performing, mission-driven team: join a team building Germany's leading digital healthcare brand
Flexible hybrid working: we work 3 day a week in Berlin
Equity: a real stake in the business through our employee stock program

At Eucalyptus, we value individuals from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we embrace the unique qualities each person brings. When you apply, please let us know of any reasonable adjustments you may need during the interview process. We use AI-assisted tools across our business to help our teams work more efficiently, including within our recruitment process. These tools support our team — all hiring decisions are made by real people, and every application is reviewed by a member of our recruitment team.

COMPANY : FLIGHTSTORY

REPORTING TO : HEAD OF CONTENT OPERATIONS

YOUR MISSION

To bring executional and creative excellence to everything FlightStory’s Central Production team works across, making sure every shoot, edit and IP moment is produced with precision and delivered to Flight’s editorial and technical standards.
You’ll work alongside creative & commercial teams to turn ideas into shoots that land, taking ownership through post-production to final delivery. You’re someone who makes things happen - self-sufficient, full of initiative and bringing a creative eye to everything we make.
While you’ll be the steady, skilled hand behind the Central Production team’s branded content output, you’ll be equally at home with longform production, editorial packaging or a social shoot. The driving force behind every project, your focus will be on getting the creative made, and made well.

DAY TO DAY

CREATIVE & COMMERCIAL PRODUCTION

Own the execution of commercial and branded productions from brief to delivery, making sure the creative idea survives contact with the shoot.
Work alongside creative teams and directors to turn briefs, scripts and storyboards into shoot plans that are both ambitious and achievable.
Act as a production check on what’s written, flagging early where an idea needs rethinking from a practical, editorial or technical point of view.
Be the producer on the ground on shoot days: keeping the day on track, working with talent, crew, and making the right calls when plans change.
Help set and protect the creative and technical standard across shoots, contributing craft that raises the bar for the wider team.

POST-PRODUCTION

Build and own post-production timelines for commercial projects in collaboration with delivery managers and creative editors, from rushes through to final delivery.
Work with editors, designers and motion teams to keep the edit moving, running feedback rounds and getting sign-off on time.
Manage feedback from internal stakeholders and brand partners with clarity, keeping versions and deliverables organised.
Spot risks to deadlines early and find a way through them without compromising quality.

EXECUTIONAL SUPPORT ACROSS LONGFORM SHOWS

Stay close to each longform show’s workflow, ready to provide production, technical or editorial support wherever a gap opens up.
Build fluency across IP and formats to support all of central production’s flagship shows without a long ramp-up, and to inform the creative & delivery of each show’s branded content output.
Creatively support on longform show packaging and act as a thinking and executional partner for the show’s producers.

CRAFT, CONTINUOUS IMPROVEMENT & AI

Keep a pulse on industry and platform trends, formats and production techniques, and bring new thinking back to the team.
Stay curious about AI tools coming into production. Test what’s promising, be honest about what isn’t, and bring the useful ones into how we work.
Spot process gaps or inefficiencies across our production workflow and help build the fixes rather than just flagging them.
Contribute to the development of new shows and formats, bringing a producer’s eye to early-stage ideas.
Be a driver and advocate for continuous improvement across Central Production and encourage the team to follow suit.

COMPETENCIES

Hands-On Producer
- Comfortable producing editorially and technically across longform and commercial shoots, with the versatility to lead a shoot or run a studio session without hand-holding.
Creative Collaborator
- Turns a creative brief into a shoot that actually works, bringing scripting and production instinct to commercial output.
Self-Sufficient
- Works independently, owns projects end to end and doesn’t hesitate to get things done.
Data-Literate
- Comfortable digging into performance and spend data, and confident using it to make and defend decisions.
Organised
- Keeps timelines, feedback and deliverables tight across several projects at once.
Post-Production Savvy
- Understands how an edit comes together and can plan realistic timelines that protect quality.
Industry-Aware
- Keeps a pulse on platform trends, formats and production techniques and AI tools, and brings new thinking back to the team.
Clear Communicator
- Confident briefing hosts, guests and talent, and communicating clearly across creative, commercial and production stakeholders.
What Success Looks Like

Commercial productions are delivered on time, on brief and to a standard the creative team and brand partners are proud of
The creative team trust you as the person who gets their ideas made properly
Post-production runs to a clear timeline, without last-minute scrambles on delivery
Longform producers know they can lean on you and get the support they need, when they need it
Decisions on formats, packaging and resourcing are routinely backed by data you’ve brought to the table
You bring new ideas and techniques to the team and help raise the bar on how we make things

You'll Thrive Here If You

Think like a producer and a creative, and know how to get an idea from the page to the screen
Are equally comfortable on set and in the edit
Take ownership and enjoy making things happen without being asked
Stay calm and resourceful when a shoot or deadline doesn't go to plan
Care about craft, and see branded content as a chance to make something people actually want to watch

High-profile clients and international brands.

Brand Aid Group is a marketing execution platform for the Middle East. We design, produce and deliver point-of-sale materials, in-store visibility, fit-outs, events, activations and exhibitions for the region's biggest consumer brands.

1,200 people. 9 markets across the Gulf, Egypt and the Levant. 11 production facilities. Over the last 18 months we rebuilt the company on one ERP, one structure and one way of running every market. The infrastructure is in place. Now we want to put AI to work inside it.

THE ROLE
You will be our first AI hire, reporting to the Group CEO. Your mandate: take the Studio, our costing and our client service to a different level using AI. Not a lab. Not a pilot deck. Working tools used every day by designers, estimators and account managers.
You get a tools budget, direct access to the CEO and the authority to change how things are done.

Location: Dubai or Cairo, with regular time in our other markets.

WHAT YOU WILL DO
• Studio: put AI into briefing, concepting, adaptation across markets and languages, and asset management. Give every country manager a live view of designer workload and utilisation.
• Costing: build estimation tools that learn from thousands of past jobs in our ERP, so a standard quote goes out in hours, not days, and margins stop surprising us.
• Client service: faster brief intake, automatic status updates and reporting, quicker answers to clients.
• Fix the data first: clean job, cost and pricing data in the ERP.
• Buy before build: pick, negotiate and integrate tools. Build only where nothing fits.
• Set the rules: client IP, data security, what goes into which model and what never does.
• Train people and measure adoption, not demos.
• Report results to the CEO monthly: hours saved, margin protected, turnaround cut.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE
6 months: one tool live and in daily use in each of the three areas, clean job cost data in our two largest markets, and a written AI playbook.
12 months: quote turnaround cut from days to hours, Studio output up with the same headcount, client reporting automated for top accounts, and a roadmap for the next phase.

WHO YOU ARE
• 5+ years shipping software, automation or data products inside an operating business.
• 2+ years putting LLMs and AI tools into real workflows used daily by non-technical people.
• Hands-on with AI APIs and no-code/low-code tools, and able to connect them to an ERP. Odoo experience is a strong plus.
• Experience near creative production, marketing services, agencies or manufacturing.

• Comfortable in a fast, multi-country business, and happy to spend time in Cairo, Riyadh and Erbil.
• You ship. Small, early, imperfect, then better.

NOT FOR YOU IF
You want to research models rather than put them to work, you need a big team before you can start, or you think the hard part is the technology. Here the hard part is 1,200 people changing how they work.

HOW TO APPLY
Apply through LinkedIn with your CV and one page on something you automated that people still use today: what it was, who uses it, and what changed because of it. No cover letter.

jobs.title: Generative AI Artist Fashion  - Freelance
jobs.description:
INDG is expanding the way high-volume visual content is produced: from CGI and 3D pipelines into AI-assisted image generation, editing, and content orchestration. This role exists to help turn generative AI from an experimental layer into a reliable production capability.

As a Generative-AI Artist (freelance), you will build and run image generation workflows that support real client production: fashion, sportswear, product imagery, talent visuals, campaign adaptations, and asset variation at scale. You will work inside the tension that defines this role: fast-moving AI models, production deadlines, visual realism, brand consistency, and systems that other people can actually use.

INDG has spent 20+ years building visual production systems for global brands. Grip extends that heritage into AI-orchestrated content production. Your work will help teams generate, edit, refine, and scale imagery while keeping outputs sharp enough for enterprise brand use.

What You Will Do

Build and Maintain Generative Image Workflows

Set up, configure, and troubleshoot custom ComfyUI workflows for image generation, image editing, inpainting, outpainting, upscaling, relighting, variation generation, and controlled composition.

You will connect models, nodes, prompts, masks, ControlNet inputs, LoRAs, reference images, and post-processing steps into repeatable workflows. The goal is not a one-off good image. The goal is a workflow that can produce consistent, usable outputs across many assets.

Apply AI to Production Content Problems

Use generative AI techniques against real production needs: adjusting apparel/footwear/accessories/equipment imagery, refining fashion/sportswear product shots, extending scenes, improving model consistency, generating controlled variations, or supporting creative teams with rapid image exploration.

You should understand that production images are judged on details: skin texture, garment fit, fabric behavior, seams, logos, lighting direction, pose plausibility, background continuity, and whether the image still feels brand-correct after generation.

Adapt Quickly as Models and Tools Change

Work confidently across diffusion-based models, LoRAs, ControlNet, IP-Adapter-style workflows, segmentation tools, inpainting models, outpainting methods, face and identity consistency techniques, and emerging image-generation systems.

You will test new models, identify where they improve or break the pipeline, and help the team decide when a tool is production-ready. You do not need every new release to be perfect. You need to know how to evaluate it, isolate failure modes, and translate it into a usable workflow.

Support a Pipeline Used by Artists and Production Teams

Document workflows clearly enough for artists, producers, and technical teams to reuse them. Package settings, prompts, node graphs, model dependencies, and output criteria in a way that reduces guesswork.

You will work with CGI artists, creative technologists, production leads, and platform teams to connect creative intent with operational execution. When something fails, you trace the system: model choice, conditioning input, prompt structure, mask quality, render reference, node configuration, or post-process step.

Requirements

Who You Are

You live at the intersection of image-making and systems-building. You care about the final image, but you also care about the workflow that created it.

jobs.title: Senior Creative Director
jobs.description:

With a legacy of innovation spanning over 45 years, TAIT has grown from pioneering in rock ‘n’ roll concert staging to setting the global standard for extraordinary live events and experiences through cutting-edge technology, precision engineering, and creative design. **Position Purpose**

This position includes managing the original creation of new creative material for the Company’s projects, participating and contributing in brainstormings & charrettes, contributing to already developed concepts by others and acting as creative lead on all projects.

This position may include the participation and preparation of other non-project specific assignments, such as speech and editorial writing and preparation, marketing materials copywriting, RFQ/RFP positioning statements, white papers and other writing as deemed necessary by the Company. Participation will be required in presentations, meetings, production meetings, field trips, research and other projects as necessary. The Senior Creative Director will act as a representative of the Company to clients, professional organizations, and the media.

The Senior Creative Director will set and communicate the creative direction for major, multidisciplinary guest experiences—articulating the big picture in an inspiring way and leading from pitch through final installation. They will drive concepts (including major IPs) in complex stakeholder environments; mentor and manage creative teams; align with business and brand strategy; and ensure operational, financial, and experiential feasibility. jobs.title: Senior Creative
jobs.description:
Most creatives get handed a product and a deadline. Here, you get handed a lab pass.

We are looking for a Senior Creative to join the Dyson Creative Studio in London: an in-house department built to approach creativity in a way that does justice to our iconic products.

You’ll have the chance to sit next to the engineers and scientists inventing the technology, and the designers working on colours, materials and finishes. You will find the detail nobody else noticed and turn it into work the world remembers.

About The Studio

The Dyson Creative Studio is based at Pear Tree Court in Clerkenwell, London, and led by Pablo González de la Peña, Global Head of Creative. It works alongside Dyson's product creative teams in Malmesbury, home of our UK headquarters, and at our global headquarters in Singapore.

We are a creative resource for the whole company, not just marketing. Our work can influence product creation, portfolio strategy and the way Dyson explains its technology to the world. We start at the very beginning, in the lab, so creativity is baked in from day one rather than added at the end.

In its first year, the studio has brought to life Dyson CameraJet, our biggest launch of the last decade, alongside Dyson HushJet MiniCool and Dyson Supersonic Travel. And with the pipeline of new technology coming, there is a lot more to do.

About The Role

As a Senior Creative, you will lead ideas from the first spark in the lab to launch campaigns seen around the world. Your job is to make the invisible visible: to take complex science and turn it into ideas people understand, feel and remember.

You will join the UK creative team, reporting to the Head of Creative, and work every day with creative strategists, designers, producers and the engineers behind the products. Forget the endless layers of approval that slow work down and kill good ideas by a thousand cuts. Here, you will present your ideas directly to Dyson's leadership, including James and Jake Dyson.

What you'll do

Connect with engineering and research teams early in development, investigating everything they do to find the detail that could become a compelling story
Create big, ownable ideas for global product launches and brand campaigns, across film, social, OOH, retail, digital and whatever channel the idea needs
Apply creative thinking and lateral problem solving to real business challenges beyond marketing, from product naming and portfolio strategy to how we explain new technology
Present and sell work with confidence to senior stakeholders and Dyson's leadership
Partner with production to craft work to the highest standard, staying close to the details from idea to delivery
Collaborate with teams in Malmesbury and Singapore to bring ideas to life in markets around the world
Raise the creative bar of the studio and help shape its culture as it grows

About You

An outstanding creative thinker (copywriter or art director) with a portfolio of work that made people stop, think and talk
Senior experience at a leading creative agency or in house team, with a record of launching ideas at global scale
Endlessly curious about how things work. You would rather spend an afternoon in a lab than in a meeting room
Brilliant at simplifying the complex without dumbing it down
Comfortable working across disciplines and media, from a hero film to a single line of product copy
A natural collaborator who can hold a room, take a challenge and build on other people's ideas
Restless, ambitious, positive, resilient and allergic to the obvious answer

Awards are welcome but not required. We care most about ideas, craft and the thinking behind them.

The team you'll join

You will work alongside talent from some of the most respected agencies and brands in the world, including BBH, Wieden+Kennedy, adam&eve, BBC Creative, Accenture Song, Canva, Logitech, Converse and Beats by Dre.

Benefits

At Dyson, Reward goes beyond just salary and bonuses. Through a comprehensive package of Financial, Lifestyle, and Health Benefits, we provide support tailored to every stage of life and the moments that matter most.

Working policy

At Dyson, our vibrant campus culture is built on in-person collaboration, creativity, and shared learning. Working side by side not only fuels our innovation, but also creates a strong sense of belonging. To nurture this dynamic and inclusive environment, we do not offer a regular hybrid working arrangement.

Dyson is an equal opportunity employer. We know that great minds don’t think alike, and it takes all kinds of minds to make our technology so unique. We welcome applications from all backgrounds and employment decisions are made without regard to race, colour, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other any other dimension of diversity.

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
About WPP Production

We are WPP Production - the unified global production company that brings together all of WPP's content producers, studios and craft experts into one connected organisation. We combine world-class human craft with next generation technology to originate, design, and deliver multi-channel content systems at scale. Built for borderless collaboration and powered by deep craft expertise, we are the production engine designed for today's always on, AI driven marketing world.

About WPP

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.

Account Manager

The Company:

WPP Production is a leading creative production company, producing advertising and marketing content for many of the world’s most famous brands, across all media around the world. WPP Production was founded over 10 years ago and has grown from a start-up to over 4,000 people, across 28 cities worldwide and is now part of the WPP family. Our rapid growth continues to drive us forward making WPP Production an exciting place to work and a great place to achieve your career ambitions.

The Role

Reporting to the Senior Account Manager, the Account Manager will be a key part of the dedicated WPP Production team supporting JLR regional and retailer campaign activity.

Act as the day-to-day contact for JLR retailer and regional stakeholders, agency partners and WPP Production teams.
Work with the Senior Account Manager and Delivery Lead to sense-check incoming briefs, confirm scope, deliverables, timings, markets, approvals and production dependencies before work begins.
Coordinate the end-to-end production process: imagery sourcing and selection, master asset development, spec sheet validation visavis available asset toolkit , adaptation and localization, quality control and final delivery.
Manage approval stages for imagery, master assets and adaptations; capture feedback clearly, manage agreed feedback rounds and communicate any impact on scope or timing.
Coordinate closely with creative, studio, transcreation, digital and media teams to ensure all production dependencies are planned and tracked.
Build and maintain clear production plans, status reports, action logs, contact reports and agendas; ensure stakeholders have visibility of progress, risks and next steps.
Manage delivery against agreed WPP Production SLAs, proactively chasing delayed inputs, specifications and approvals, and escalating risks to the Senior Account Manager, Delivery Lead or Business Director where required.
Support workload triage across the team, ensuring straightforward work is appropriately handed over and complex or high-risk jobs are escalated early.
Ensure master and adapted assets meet agreed brand, technical and market requirements before delivery.
Develop strong, trusted relationships with client and agency stakeholders while maintaining a calm, solutions-focused approach to fast-moving campaign requirements.

Requirements

Automotive experience is essential; experience supporting JLR, premium automotive brands, retailer marketing or regional automotive accounts is highly desirable.
Proven experience in an account management, integrated agency or production role delivering multi-channel campaigns across print, digital, broadcast and/or retail environments.
Experience managing production workflows involving master creative, imagery selection, local market adaptations and transcreation/localisation.
Comfortable working across international accounts and multiple markets, ideally five or more, with numerous client, agency and production stakeholders.
Strong understanding of client approval processes, production specifications, asset delivery and the dependencies between creative, media, digital and production teams.
Excellent project-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple jobs, work to tight deadlines, maintain accurate trackers and identify risks before they affect delivery.
Clear, confident written and verbal communication skills in English and Arabic.
Highly organized, detail-oriented, proactive and client-focused, with the resilience to work effectively under pressure.

Why work here:

At WPP Production, you’ll help shape the future of content production at a truly global scale. We bring together world-class talent, cutting-edge studios, and advanced technology to solve some of the most complex creative and production challenges in the industry. You’ll work in a collaborative, borderless environment where craft excellence is valued, innovation is encouraged, and AI and next-generation tools are used to amplify not replace human creativity. With access to diverse projects, global career opportunities, and the backing of WPP’s unmatched network, this is a place where you can grow your skills, make real impact, and create work that performs for every audience, across every channel, at every moment.

Inclusion and Impact

WPP is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

Data

We rely on legitimate interest as a legal basis for processing personal information under the GDPR for purposes of recruitment and applications for employment. When you click the "Submit Application" button at the bottom of this page, this will send all the information you have added to WPP Production. Before you do this, we think it's a good idea to read through our Privacy statement. This explains what we do with your personal data when you apply for a role with us, and, how you can update the information you have provided us with or how to remove it.
